title_zh: 课前闲聊：关键词文献推送订阅
title_en: Pre-lecture chat: keyword-based literature alerts

points.zh: 老师推荐一个纯免费的文献 alert 网站，按 keyword 自动追踪新发表的文献。
points.en: The teacher recommends a free literature alert service that tracks newly published papers by keyword.

points.zh: 使用方式是先建关键词组合，例如 SARS-CoV-2 加 RdRp，再点评估。
points.en: You first build a keyword set, e.g. SARS-CoV-2 plus RdRp, then run the evaluation step.

points.zh: 评估页会显示每个 keyword 每月大约会命中多少篇文献，用来判断词是太宽还是太窄。
points.en: The evaluation page shows roughly how many papers each keyword returns per month, telling you if it is too broad or too narrow.

points.zh: 系统建议至少设 5 个 keyword，靠多词交叉来提高推送的相关性。
points.en: The service suggests at least five keywords; relevance comes from crossing several terms.

points.zh: 推送频率可选，老师设的是每周 (weekly digest)，固定时间发到邮箱。
points.en: The frequency is configurable; the teacher uses a weekly digest delivered to his inbox at a fixed time.

points.zh: 邮件里只列出这一周里与关键词组合最匹配的几篇，不是全部检索结果。
points.en: The email lists only the best matches of that week, not the full search result set.

points.zh: 固有局限：一篇文章基本只在它发表的那一周被推送，之后不会再出现，所以回溯旧文献仍要手动检索。
points.en: Built-in limitation: a paper is normally pushed only in its publication week and never again, so older literature still needs a manual search.

points.zh: 闲聊背景：学生计划做 Ebola 相关工作，实验室有 BSL-3 条件。
points.en: Chat context: the student plans Ebola-related work, and the lab has BSL-3 facilities.

extra.zh: 同类功能不必依赖第三方网站：PubMed 的 My NCBI 可以把任意检索式存成 Saved Search 并开启 email alert，数据直接来自 MEDLINE，完全免费。
extra.en: The same function needs no third-party site: PubMed's My NCBI can save any query as a Saved Search with an email alert, drawing straight from MEDLINE, free of charge.

extra.zh: 这类 alert 底层是布尔检索加字段限定（title/abstract、MeSH term）。词太宽会被无关文献淹没，太窄会漏掉换了说法的同类工作，实践中常用 NOT 排除已知的高噪声主题。
extra.en: These alerts are boolean queries with field limits (title/abstract, MeSH terms). Too broad and you drown in noise; too narrow and you miss work that phrases it differently. In practice a NOT clause is used to strip known noisy topics.

extra.zh: 文献 alert（新发表文献推送）和 citation alert（自己的文章被引用时提醒）是两套不同的订阅，前者盯领域，后者盯自己。
extra.en: A literature alert (new papers in a field) and a citation alert (notification when your own paper is cited) are two different subscriptions: one watches the field, the other watches you.

quiz.q_zh: 老师演示的这类文献订阅服务，其推送逻辑是什么？
quiz.q_en: How does the literature subscription service demonstrated in class decide what to send?

options.zh: 每周把你文献库里未读的文献发到邮箱
options.en: Emails the unread papers sitting in your library weekly

options.zh: 每周把合作者新上传的文献发到邮箱
options.en: Emails papers newly uploaded by your collaborators weekly

options.zh: 每周把匹配关键词的新发表文献发到邮箱
options.en: Emails newly published papers matching your keywords weekly

options.zh: 每周把该领域被引最多的文献发到邮箱
options.en: Emails the most highly cited papers in the field weekly

quiz.explain_zh: 订阅是按 keyword 命中新发表文献来推送的。按被引量排序属于文献计量检索，未读条目提醒是 reference manager 的功能，合作者上传提醒属于共享文库通知，都不是 alert 的工作方式。
quiz.explain_en: The alert fires on newly published papers matching the keywords. Ranking by citation count is a bibliometric search, flagging unread items is a reference-manager feature, and collaborator uploads are shared-library notifications; none of these is how the alert works.

quiz.q_zh: 这类每周订阅的一个固有局限是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is a built-in limitation of such a weekly subscription?

options.zh: 只在文章发表当周推送，之后不再出现
options.en: Pushes a paper only in its publication week, never again

options.zh: 只推送开放获取文献，订阅期刊一律跳过
options.en: Pushes only open-access papers, skipping subscription journals

options.zh: 只推送英文文献，其他语种一律跳过
options.en: Pushes only English papers, skipping every other language

options.zh: 只推送综述文献，研究论文一律跳过
options.en: Pushes only review articles, skipping research papers

quiz.explain_zh: 老师查不到几周前发表的那篇，正是因为推送以「本周新增」为单位，错过的窗口不会补。是否开放获取、语种、文献类型都不是它的筛选依据，需要时可以在检索式里另行限定。
quiz.explain_en: The teacher could not find the paper from a few weeks earlier precisely because the digest covers only what is new that week, and a missed window is not backfilled. Open-access status, language and article type are not its filtering criteria, though they can be added to the query.

title_zh: 课前闲聊：Zotero 文献管理与划词翻译
title_en: Pre-lecture chat: Zotero reference management and pop-up translation

points.zh: 老师强推 Zotero 作 reference manager，另一个常见选择是 EndNote，但用的人相对少。
points.en: The teacher strongly recommends Zotero as a reference manager; EndNote is the other common choice but less widely used here.

points.zh: 最大的好处是与 Word 无缝衔接：装插件后在正文里 add citation，参考文献表自动生成并随文更新。
points.en: The main benefit is seamless Word integration: with the plugin you add a citation in the text and the bibliography is generated and kept in sync automatically.

points.zh: citation style 可以整套切换，各期刊样式（例如 PNAS）可直接在样式库里搜到并安装。
points.en: The whole citation style can be swapped at once; journal styles such as PNAS can be searched for and installed from the style repository.

points.zh: 中文社区另有国内期刊和学位论文的样式，老师写毕业论文时就是套用现成样式。
points.en: The Chinese-language community maintains styles for domestic journals and theses; the teacher used a ready-made one for his own dissertation.

points.zh: 库的组织方式：左侧按 collection 分区，条目可加 tag 或图标标记是否读过、重要级别。
points.en: Library organisation: collections in the left pane, with tags or icons on each item marking whether it has been read and how important it is.

points.zh: 阅读策略：不必每天精读；平时少读，需要用时集中读，主要看 conclusion 和实验方法。
points.en: Reading strategy: no need to read closely every day. Read little routinely, then read intensively when needed, focusing on conclusions and methods.

points.zh: 辅助工具：有道翻译桌面版可整段划词翻译，用于快速略读英文页面。
points.en: Supporting tool: the desktop Youdao translator does pop-up translation of a whole selected passage, useful for skimming English pages fast.

points.zh: 老师本人的用法是先划段速读，只有描述不清或特别关键的段落才回去看英文原文。
points.en: His own practice is to skim via translation and go back to the English original only for passages that are unclear or critical.

extra.zh: 「引用样式」在 Zotero 里是 CSL (Citation Style Language) 的 XML 文件，从 Zotero Style Repository 下载。换刊投稿时换一个 CSL 文件即可，正文引文和文末列表会一起重排，这正是手工排版最费时的部分。
extra.en: A citation style in Zotero is a CSL (Citation Style Language) XML file pulled from the Zotero Style Repository. Resubmitting to another journal means swapping one CSL file, and both in-text citations and the reference list reflow together, which is exactly the part that costs the most by hand.

extra.zh: Zotero 本地库容量不受限，受限的是云同步空间；PDF 附件多时可改用 WebDAV 自建同步或购买扩容，而条目元数据本身很小。
extra.en: Zotero's local library is unlimited; only cloud sync storage is capped. With many PDF attachments you can point sync at your own WebDAV server or buy more space, since the item metadata itself is tiny.

extra.zh: 机器翻译适合判断「这段要不要细看」，不适合作为结论依据。否定句、条件从句和专业术语最容易被译反，凡是要写进自己文章的数据和结论都必须回原文核对。
extra.en: Machine translation is fine for deciding whether a passage deserves close reading, but not as the basis for a conclusion. Negations, conditional clauses and technical terms are the most likely to flip, so any datum or conclusion you will cite must be checked against the original.

quiz.q_zh: Zotero 与 Word 集成最直接解决的是什么问题？
quiz.q_en: Which problem does Zotero's Word integration most directly solve?

options.zh: 按语义检索 PDF 全文的内容
options.en: Searching the full text of PDFs by semantic content

options.zh: 按版本管理实验原始数据文件
options.en: Version-controlling the raw experimental data files

options.zh: 按作者合并稿件的修订痕迹
options.en: Merging tracked changes from multiple manuscript authors

options.zh: 按期刊要求整体切换引用格式
options.en: Switching the entire citation style to a journal's requirements

quiz.explain_zh: 插件把引文与样式文件绑定，换刊时换样式即可让全文引用和参考文献表一起重排。全文语义检索、数据版本管理、修订痕迹合并分别属于检索工具、版本控制系统和字处理器的协作功能，都不是 reference manager 的职责。
quiz.explain_en: The plugin binds citations to a style file, so changing journals reflows every in-text citation and the whole reference list. Semantic full-text search, data version control and merging tracked changes belong to search tools, version-control systems and the word processor's collaboration features respectively, not to a reference manager.

quiz.q_zh: 老师描述的自己读文献的方式是？
quiz.q_en: How does the teacher describe his own way of reading the literature?

options.zh: 平时少读，用时集中读结论与方法
options.en: Reads little routinely, then binges conclusions and methods

options.zh: 每天精读全文，逐段做笔记与复述
options.en: Reads full texts daily, taking notes paragraph by paragraph

options.zh: 只读综述，原始研究论文一律不读
options.en: Reads only reviews, never primary research articles

options.zh: 只读中文译本，英文原文一律不开
options.en: Reads only Chinese translations, never English originals

quiz.explain_zh: 他说大部分时候不读，需要时狂读，而且不细读，先看结论和实验方法。每天精读全文他明确认为低效；他并没有排斥原始论文，也说过遇到特别好或描述不清的地方会回看英文原文。
quiz.explain_en: He says he mostly does not read, then reads intensively when he needs to, and even then skims for conclusions and methods. He explicitly calls daily close reading inefficient, and he neither avoids primary papers nor refuses the English original, which he returns to when a passage is unclear or unusually good.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：今日安排与米氏方程的形式
title_en: Review: today's plan and the form of the Michaelis-Menten equation

points.zh: 今天的目标是把酶这一章讲完，并给维生素开个头。
points.en: Today's goal is to finish the enzyme chapter and make a start on vitamins.

points.zh: 老师提醒维生素一章几乎没有内在逻辑，各维生素功能互不相干，以硬记为主。
points.en: He warns that the vitamin chapter has almost no internal logic: each vitamin does its own thing, so it is largely memorisation.

points.zh: 维生素与 coenzyme 辅酶 / prosthetic group 辅基 的对应关系是那一章的重点接口。
points.en: The mapping of vitamins onto coenzymes and prosthetic groups is the key interface of that chapter.

points.zh: 酶动力学被单独复习，因为它最贴近现代科研：酶学论文里仍常见米氏方程的实际应用。
points.en: Enzyme kinetics gets its own review because it is closest to modern research: papers on enzymes still apply the Michaelis-Menten equation.

points.zh: 按底物浓度，酶促反应速率分成三段：低 [S] 段、过渡段、高 [S] 的饱和段。
points.en: By substrate concentration the reaction rate falls into three regimes: low [S], a transition, and saturation at high [S].

points.zh: 推导过程、假设和代换可以不背，但米氏方程的形式必须写对，这是绝对不能错的。
points.en: The derivation, assumptions and substitutions need not be memorised, but the form of the equation must be written correctly; that part is non-negotiable.

points.zh: 正确形式：分子是 Vmax 乘以 [S]，分母是 Km 加上 [S]，即 v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S])。
points.en: The correct form has Vmax times [S] on top and Km plus [S] below: v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]).

points.zh: 老师自述博士入学考试时差点把分母的加号记成乘号，这是最常见的记混点。
points.en: He recalls nearly writing the denominator as a product rather than a sum in his own doctoral entrance exam; this is the classic slip.

extra.zh: 一级动力学与零级动力学的分界由 [S] 与 Km 的相对大小决定，不是由「底物分子数超过酶分子数」决定。[S] << Km 时分母≈Km，v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S]，与 [S] 成正比，是一级；[S] >> Km 时分母≈[S]，v → Vmax，与 [S] 无关，是零级。
extra.en: The first-order/zero-order boundary is set by [S] relative to Km, not by substrate molecules outnumbering enzyme molecules. When [S] << Km the denominator is essentially Km and v ≈ (Vmax/Km)[S], proportional to [S] and therefore first order; when [S] >> Km the denominator is essentially [S] and v → Vmax, independent of [S] and therefore zero order.

extra.zh: 把 [S] = Km 代入方程立刻得到 v = Vmax/2，这就是 Km 的操作定义，也说明 Km 必须是浓度单位、可以直接在 [S] 轴上读出。
extra.en: Substituting [S] = Km gives v = Vmax/2 at once. That is the operational definition of Km, and it also shows Km must carry concentration units and can be read straight off the [S] axis.

extra.zh: 米氏方程描述的是初速度 v0，实验上要求底物消耗小于约 10%、没有产物抑制、酶在测定时间内不失活；用整条进程曲线的平均速率去拟合会低估 Vmax。
extra.en: The equation describes the initial velocity v0. Experimentally that requires less than roughly 10% substrate turnover, no product inhibition and no enzyme inactivation over the assay window; fitting an average rate from a full progress curve underestimates Vmax.

quiz.q_zh: 米氏方程的正确形式是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which is the correct form of the Michaelis-Menten equation?

options.zh: v = Km[S] / (Vmax + [S])
options.en: v = Km[S] / (Vmax + [S])

options.zh: v = Vmax[S] / (Km + [S])
options.en: v = Vmax[S] / (Km + [S])

options.zh: v = Vmax[S] / (Km × [S])
options.en: v = Vmax[S] / (Km × [S])

options.zh: v = Vmax(Km + [S]) / [S]
options.en: v = Vmax(Km + [S]) / [S]

quiz.explain_zh: 分母是 Km 与 [S] 相加。写成 Km 与 [S] 相乘会让 [S] 约掉、速度反而随底物增加而下降；把 (Km+[S]) 放到分子上得到的是随 [S] 减小的曲线；把 Km 当分子系数、Vmax 放进分母则量纲就不对，饱和值会变成 Km。
quiz.explain_en: The denominator is Km plus [S]. Making it a product lets [S] cancel and the rate would fall as substrate rises; putting (Km+[S]) on top gives a curve that decreases with [S]; using Km as the numerator coefficient with Vmax in the denominator breaks the units and makes the saturating value Km.

quiz.q_zh: 酶促反应在什么条件下表现为零级动力学 (zero-order)？
quiz.q_en: Under what condition does an enzyme reaction show zero-order kinetics?

options.zh: [S] 远小于 Km，酶几乎全是游离形式
options.en: [S] far below Km, so the enzyme is nearly all free

options.zh: [S] 远大于 [E]，底物分子数超过酶分子数
options.en: [S] far above [E], so substrate molecules outnumber enzyme

options.zh: [S] 远小于 [E]，酶分子数超过底物分子数
options.en: [S] far below [E], so enzyme molecules outnumber substrate

options.zh: [S] 远大于 Km，酶几乎全被底物饱和
options.en: [S] far above Km, so the enzyme is nearly saturated

quiz.explain_zh: 只有当 [S] 远大于 Km 时分母≈[S]，v 趋近 Vmax 而与底物浓度无关，这才是零级。[S] 远小于 Km 对应一级段。「底物分子数超过酶分子数」是几乎所有酶测定都满足的常规条件，本身并不能保证饱和：Km 很大时 [S] 已远超 [E] 仍处在一级段。酶多于底物的情形则完全谈不上饱和。
quiz.explain_en: Only when [S] far exceeds Km does the denominator reduce to [S], so v approaches Vmax independently of substrate: that is zero order. [S] far below Km is the first-order regime. Substrate outnumbering enzyme holds in virtually every assay and does not by itself guarantee saturation, since with a large Km the reaction is still first order even though [S] vastly exceeds [E]. Enzyme in excess of substrate is nowhere near saturation at all.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：米氏方程的推导与稳态假设
title_en: Review: deriving the equation and the steady-state assumption

points.zh: 反应模型写成 E + S ⇌ ES → E + P，即先形成 ES 复合物，再释放酶与 product。
points.en: The scheme is E + S ⇌ ES → E + P: the ES complex forms first, then enzyme and product are released.

points.zh: 假设一：产物生成这一步不可逆，product 不会再回头变成 ES，所以逆向常数被略去。
points.en: Assumption one: product formation is irreversible, product does not revert to ES, so the reverse constant is dropped.

points.zh: 假设二：稳态 (steady state)，ES 的生成速率等于其消耗速率，即 d[ES]/dt = 0。
points.en: Assumption two: steady state, ES is formed as fast as it is consumed, i.e. d[ES]/dt = 0.

points.zh: 生成项只有一个：k₁[E][S]；消耗项有两个：解离回 E+S 与转化成 E+P，合为 (k₋₁ + k₂)[ES]。
points.en: There is one formation term, k₁[E][S], and two loss terms, dissociation back to E+S and turnover to E+P, together (k₋₁ + k₂)[ES].

points.zh: 式中出现三个难以单独测量的速率常数，实验上真正能测到的只有转化那一步的常数。
points.en: Three individually hard-to-measure rate constants appear; the only one accessible experimentally is the turnover step.

points.zh: 解决办法是定义一个复合常数 Km = (k₋₁ + k₂)/k₁，把三个未知常数一次性替换掉。
points.en: The fix is to define a composite constant Km = (k₋₁ + k₂)/k₁, replacing all three unknowns at once.

points.zh: 游离酶 [E] 与 [ES] 同样测不到，再用总酶守恒 [E]T = [E] + [ES] 把它们消去。
points.en: Free [E] and [ES] are equally unmeasurable, so the conservation relation [E]T = [E] + [ES] eliminates them.

points.zh: 最终方程里只剩下容易测的 [S]，加上两个常数 Km 与 Vmax，这正是推导的目的。
points.en: The final equation contains only the easily measured [S] plus the two constants Km and Vmax, which is the whole point of the derivation.

extra.zh: 课上两次把 Km 说成「消耗速率除以生成速率」。那是速率常数之比，不是速率之比：Km = (k₋₁ + k₂)/k₁。这也解释了量纲——分子是单分子步骤的常数（s⁻¹），分母是双分子步骤的常数（M⁻¹s⁻¹），相除得到浓度单位 M，所以 Km 才能在 [S] 轴上读出。若真是两个速率相除，稳态下两者相等，结果恒为 1。
extra.en: Km is twice described in class as a consumption rate divided by a formation rate. It is a ratio of rate CONSTANTS, not of rates: Km = (k₋₁ + k₂)/k₁. That also explains the dimensions: a unimolecular constant (s⁻¹) over a bimolecular one (M⁻¹s⁻¹) gives concentration units, which is why Km can be read off the [S] axis. Had it truly been a ratio of rates, the steady state makes those two equal and the result would be exactly 1.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 板书写作 KM = K1(K2+K3)/K1，前面多出一个 K1；正确形式是 (K2+K3)/K1。老师的编号对应关系：K1 = k₁（结合），K2 = k₋₁（解离），K3 = k₂ = kcat（转化），而他提到「K4 没有了」指的是 E+P → ES 的逆向常数，被假设一设为 0。
extra.en: The board reads KM = K1(K2+K3)/K1 with a stray leading K1; the correct form is (K2+K3)/K1. His numbering maps as K1 = k₁ (binding), K2 = k₋₁ (dissociation), K3 = k₂ = kcat (turnover), and the K4 he says has disappeared is the reverse constant for E+P → ES, set to zero by the first assumption.

extra.zh: ES 被称为「中间态」，但它是基态的 Michaelis complex，位于反应坐标上的能量谷，不是能垒顶端的 transition state。酶的催化力恰恰来自对 transition state 的结合强于对 ES 的结合。
extra.en: ES is called an intermediate state in class, but it is the ground-state Michaelis complex sitting in an energy well on the reaction coordinate, not the transition state at the top of the barrier. Catalytic power comes precisely from the enzyme binding the transition state more tightly than it binds ES.

extra.zh: 稳态推导 (Briggs-Haldane) 比更早的快速平衡假设 (Michaelis-Menten) 更普适。只有当 k₂ << k₋₁ 时 Km → k₋₁/k₁ = Ks，才等同于解离常数；否则催化步骤也会把 Km 抬高。
extra.en: The steady-state derivation (Briggs-Haldane) is more general than the earlier rapid-equilibrium treatment (Michaelis-Menten). Only when k₂ << k₋₁ does Km reduce to k₋₁/k₁ = Ks, the true dissociation constant; otherwise the catalytic step inflates Km as well.

quiz.q_zh: Km 的正确定义式是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which expression correctly defines Km?

options.zh: Km = (k₋₁ + k₂) / k₁
options.en: Km = (k₋₁ + k₂) / k₁

options.zh: Km = (k₋₁ + k₂) × k₁
options.en: Km = (k₋₁ + k₂) × k₁

options.zh: Km = k₁ / (k₋₁ + k₂)
options.en: Km = k₁ / (k₋₁ + k₂)

options.zh: Km = (k₁ + k₂) / k₋₁
options.en: Km = (k₁ + k₂) / k₋₁

quiz.explain_zh: ES 的两条消耗途径常数之和放在分子，唯一的生成常数 k₁ 放在分母。写成相乘会得到 s⁻²·M⁻¹ 这样无意义的量纲；把 k₁ 放到分子上得到的是浓度的倒数，无法在 [S] 轴上读出；把 k₁ 与 k₂ 相加则混淆了双分子结合常数与单分子转化常数，二者单位不同不能相加。
quiz.explain_en: The two loss constants of ES sum in the numerator and the single formation constant k₁ sits in the denominator. Multiplying gives the meaningless dimensions s⁻²·M⁻¹; putting k₁ on top yields reciprocal concentration, which cannot be read off the [S] axis; and adding k₁ to k₂ mixes a bimolecular binding constant with a unimolecular turnover constant, whose units differ and cannot be summed.

quiz.q_zh: 稳态假设 (steady-state assumption) 断言的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the steady-state assumption actually assert?

options.zh: ES 的浓度随反应时间线性升高
options.en: The concentration of ES rises linearly with time

options.zh: 每个酶分子同时结合两个底物分子
options.en: Each enzyme molecule binds two substrate molecules

options.zh: 酶与底物的结合完全不可逆转
options.en: Binding of enzyme to substrate is wholly irreversible

options.zh: ES 的生成速率等于其消耗速率
options.en: ES is formed exactly as fast as it is consumed

quiz.explain_zh: 稳态就是 d[ES]/dt = 0，生成与消耗相抵，[ES] 保持恒定，正因如此才能把左右两边联立。[ES] 线性升高恰恰与恒定相反；一酶结合两底物属于反应级数问题，与本推导的单底物模型无关；结合不可逆则否定了 k₋₁，而 k₋₁ 正出现在 Km 的分子里。
quiz.explain_en: Steady state means d[ES]/dt = 0: formation and loss cancel and [ES] stays constant, which is exactly what lets the two sides be equated. A linearly rising [ES] is the opposite of constant; binding two substrates per enzyme is a question of reaction order irrelevant to this single-substrate scheme; and irreversible binding would abolish k₋₁, the very term sitting in the numerator of Km.

quiz.q_zh: 在反应坐标上，ES 复合物属于什么？
quiz.q_en: On the reaction coordinate, what is the ES complex?

options.zh: 催化完成后的 enzyme-product 复合物
options.en: The enzyme-product complex after catalysis

options.zh: 偏离反应路径的 dead-end 抑制复合物
options.en: A dead-end inhibitory complex off the pathway

options.zh: 基态能谷中的 Michaelis complex
options.en: The Michaelis complex, a ground-state energy well

options.zh: 能垒最高点的 transition state
options.en: The transition state at the top of the barrier

quiz.explain_zh: ES 是底物结合后落入的能量低谷，寿命足够长才能被稳态处理，因此是基态复合物。transition state 是能垒顶点，寿命在键振动量级，无法当作可积累的物种；enzyme-product 复合物出现在催化步之后而非之前；dead-end 复合物不通向产物，而 ES 正是通向产物的必经中间体。
quiz.explain_en: ES is the energy well the substrate falls into on binding, long-lived enough to be treated by a steady state, hence a ground-state complex. The transition state is the barrier summit, lasting a bond vibration and never accumulating as a species; the enzyme-product complex comes after the catalytic step rather than before it; and a dead-end complex does not lead to product, whereas ES is the obligatory intermediate on the way to it.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：Km 的物理意义与酶–底物亲和力
title_en: Review: the physical meaning of Km and enzyme-substrate affinity

points.zh: 在固定温度、pH 下，Km 对某一酶与某一底物是特征常数，Vmax 同样是常数。
points.en: At fixed temperature and pH, Km is a characteristic constant for a given enzyme-substrate pair, and so is Vmax.

points.zh: 两个常数确定后，方程里只剩速率 v 与底物浓度 [S] 两个变量。
points.en: Once both constants are fixed, only the rate v and the substrate concentration [S] remain as variables.

points.zh: 米氏方程的先进性在于预测：任意给定 [S]，都能算出对应的反应速率。
points.en: The strength of the equation is prediction: for any given [S] it returns the corresponding rate.

points.zh: Km 的物理意义是使反应速率达到 ½Vmax 所需的底物浓度，因为 [S] = Km 时 v = ½Vmax。
points.en: Physically Km is the substrate concentration giving half-maximal rate, since v = ½Vmax when [S] = Km.

points.zh: Km 越小，说明用很低的 [S] 就能跑到半数最大速率，酶对该底物的表观亲和力越高。
points.en: The smaller the Km, the less substrate is needed to reach half-maximal rate, and the higher the enzyme's apparent affinity for that substrate.

points.zh: 反过来，需要很高的 [S] 才达到 ½Vmax，就说明亲和力低——Km 与亲和力成反比。
points.en: Conversely, needing a high [S] to reach ½Vmax means low affinity: Km is inversely related to apparent affinity.

points.zh: 老师认为「半数最大速率所需底物浓度」这一说法比抽象定义好理解，也是答题时的落点。
points.en: The teacher finds the half-maximal-rate wording easier to grasp than the abstract definition, and it is what to write in an exam.

points.zh: 注意 Km 刻画的是酶–底物这一对组合，同一个酶对不同底物有不同的 Km。
points.en: Note that Km characterises the enzyme-substrate pair: one enzyme has a different Km for each of its substrates.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上说推导前提是「底物浓度远远大于酶的浓度」。[S]T >> [E]T 只是实验条件，保证游离底物近似等于投入的总底物，从而可以用 [S]T 代替 [S]。真正决定曲线走到饱和的是 [S] 与 Km 的比较，与 [E]T 无关。
extra.en: Class gives the precondition as substrate far exceeding enzyme. In fact [S]T >> [E]T is only an experimental condition ensuring free substrate is approximately the total added, so [S]T can stand in for [S]. Whether the curve saturates is decided by [S] against Km, not against [E]T.

extra.zh: 课上说 kcat 不太重要，但从可比性看正相反：Vmax = kcat[E]T，加倍酶量 Vmax 就加倍，是与样品有关的量；kcat（周转数，单位 s⁻¹）和 kcat/Km（特异性常数）与酶量无关，是酶的内在常数，跨实验、跨文献比较必须用它们。kcat/Km 的上限受扩散控制。
extra.en: Class calls kcat unimportant, but for comparability the reverse holds: Vmax = kcat[E]T, so doubling the enzyme doubles Vmax, making it a sample-dependent quantity. kcat (turnover number, s⁻¹) and kcat/Km (the specificity constant) are independent of enzyme amount and are the enzyme's intrinsic constants, the only valid basis for comparing across assays and papers. kcat/Km 's ceiling is set by diffusion.

extra.zh: Km 反映的是「表观」亲和力。只有当催化步远慢于解离 (k₂ << k₋₁) 时 Km 才近似解离常数 Kd；若催化很快，ES 大量走向产物，Km 会明显大于 Kd，此时用 Km 谈结合强弱要加限定。
extra.en: Km reports apparent affinity. Only when catalysis is much slower than dissociation (k₂ << k₋₁) does Km approximate the dissociation constant Kd. If catalysis is fast, ES drains to product and Km substantially exceeds Kd, so any statement about binding strength based on Km needs that caveat.

quiz.q_zh: 某酶对底物 A 的 Km 为 0.1 mM，对底物 B 为 5 mM，可以推出什么？
quiz.q_en: An enzyme has Km = 0.1 mM for substrate A and 5 mM for substrate B. What follows?

options.zh: 该酶转化 A 的 kcat 高于转化 B
options.en: Its kcat for turning over A is higher than for B

options.zh: 该酶转化 B 的 kcat 高于转化 A
options.en: Its kcat for turning over B is higher than for A

options.zh: 该酶对 A 的表观亲和力高于对 B
options.en: Its apparent affinity for A is higher than for B

options.zh: 该酶对 B 的表观亲和力高于对 A
options.en: Its apparent affinity for B is higher than for A

quiz.explain_zh: Km 与表观亲和力成反比：A 只需 0.1 mM 就达到半数最大速率，说明结合得更好。认为 B 亲和力更高是把关系读反了。Km 与 kcat 是相互独立的参数，低 Km 完全可以配低 kcat，因此从这两个 Km 值推不出任何关于周转速度的结论。
quiz.explain_en: Km runs inversely to apparent affinity: A reaches half-maximal rate at just 0.1 mM, so it is bound better. Claiming higher affinity for B reads the relation backwards. Km and kcat are independent parameters and a low Km may well pair with a low kcat, so these two Km values say nothing about turnover speed either way.

quiz.q_zh: 向测定体系中把酶量加倍，下列哪个量随之加倍？
quiz.q_en: If the amount of enzyme in the assay is doubled, which quantity doubles with it?

options.zh: kcat/Km（特异性常数）
options.en: kcat/Km, the specificity constant

options.zh: Vmax（最大反应速率）
options.en: Vmax, the maximal velocity

options.zh: Km（米氏常数）
options.en: Km, the Michaelis constant

options.zh: kcat（转换数）
options.en: kcat, the turnover number

quiz.explain_zh: Vmax = kcat[E]T，与总酶浓度成正比，所以加酶就加倍。Km 由三个速率常数决定，与酶浓度无关；kcat 是每个酶分子每秒的周转数，本身已按酶量归一；kcat/Km 由这两个与酶量无关的量组成，同样不变。
quiz.explain_en: Vmax = kcat[E]T is proportional to total enzyme, so it doubles. Km is fixed by three rate constants and does not depend on enzyme concentration; kcat is turnovers per enzyme molecule per second and is already normalised to enzyme amount; and kcat/Km, built from those two enzyme-independent quantities, is likewise unchanged.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：双倒数作图与抑制剂分类
title_en: Review: the double-reciprocal plot and the classes of inhibitor

points.zh: 米氏方程本身是双曲线，未知数同时出现在分子和分母上，直接作图不便判读。
points.en: The equation itself is a hyperbola with the variable in both numerator and denominator, awkward to read off a plot.

points.zh: 两边同取倒数即得双倒数 (Lineweaver-Burk) 形式，[S] 被约成一元一次方程。
points.en: Taking reciprocals of both sides gives the double-reciprocal (Lineweaver-Burk) form, a straight line in 1/[S].

points.zh: 直线方程为 1/v = (Km/Vmax)(1/[S]) + 1/Vmax：斜率 Km/Vmax，纵截距 1/Vmax，横截距 −1/Km。
points.en: The line is 1/v = (Km/Vmax)(1/[S]) + 1/Vmax: slope Km/Vmax, y-intercept 1/Vmax, x-intercept −1/Km.

points.zh: 老师强调：文献里凡是真去测算米氏参数的工作，几乎一定会给出双倒数图。
points.en: He stresses that any paper actually measuring Michaelis parameters will almost certainly show a double-reciprocal plot.

points.zh: 抑制剂先按可逆性分两类：不可逆抑制剂结合上去就不再脱落，可逆的可以解离。
points.en: Inhibitors split first by reversibility: an irreversible one does not come off once bound, a reversible one dissociates.

points.zh: 可逆抑制剂再分三种：竞争性 competitive、非竞争性 non-competitive、反竞争性 uncompetitive。
points.en: Reversible inhibitors then split three ways: competitive, non-competitive and uncompetitive.

points.zh: 命名陷阱：non- 与 un- 两个前缀都表否定，但对应的中文与机制完全不同，务必逐一对应记住。
points.en: Naming trap: the prefixes non- and un- both read as negations, yet the two mechanisms are entirely different and must be matched up one by one.

points.zh: 竞争性抑制剂通常与天然底物结构相似，因而结合在同一个活性位点，与底物直接竞争。
points.en: A competitive inhibitor usually resembles the natural substrate and therefore binds the same active site, competing with it directly.

points.zh: 非竞争性抑制剂与底物可以长得不像，结合在底物结合位点以外的位点。
points.en: A non-competitive inhibitor need not resemble the substrate and binds at a site other than the substrate-binding site.

extra.zh: 课上说非竞争性抑制剂「其实也可以发挥不抑制酶活的作用」。对活性没有影响的分子就不叫 inhibitor。结合在同类非活性位点却提高活性的分子是别构激活剂 allosteric activator；同一个位点既可以坐激活剂也可以坐抑制剂，但两者要分开命名。
extra.en: Class says a non-competitive inhibitor can also act without inhibiting activity. A molecule with no effect on activity is not an inhibitor. Something that binds the same kind of non-active site and raises activity is an allosteric activator; one site may accept either an activator or an inhibitor, but the two must be named separately.

extra.zh: 三类可逆抑制在双倒数图上的签名：competitive 只结合游离 E，Km 表观升高、Vmax 不变，各线交于纵轴；non-competitive 对 E 和 ES 亲和相同，Vmax 降、Km 不变，各线交于横轴；uncompetitive 只结合 ES，Km 与 Vmax 同比例下降，斜率不变，因而是一组平行线。
extra.en: Signatures on a double-reciprocal plot: competitive inhibitors bind only free E, raising apparent Km at unchanged Vmax, so the lines meet on the y-axis; non-competitive inhibitors bind E and ES equally, lowering Vmax at unchanged Km, so the lines meet on the x-axis; uncompetitive inhibitors bind only ES, lowering Km and Vmax by the same factor and leaving the slope alone, giving parallel lines.

extra.zh: 反竞争性之所以降低 Km，不是因为「Vmax 降了所以底物需要得少」，而是抑制剂只结合 ES，把 E+S ⇌ ES 的平衡向 ES 拉，表观亲和力因而上升。Km 与 Vmax 同时除以 α′ = 1 + [I]/Ki，比值 Vmax/Km 不变，这正是双倒数图上线条平行的原因。
extra.en: Uncompetitive inhibition lowers Km not because a lower Vmax means less substrate is needed, but because the inhibitor binds only ES and pulls the E+S ⇌ ES equilibrium forward, raising apparent affinity. Km and Vmax are both divided by α′ = 1 + [I]/Ki, leaving the ratio Vmax/Km unchanged, which is exactly why the lines run parallel.

extra.zh: 不可逆抑制通常是对酶的共价修饰（或结合紧到在实验时间内不解离），效果是降低有效酶浓度，因此在双倒数图上看起来像非竞争性抑制；其效力用 kinact/KI 描述，而不是可逆抑制的 Ki。
extra.en: Irreversible inhibition is normally covalent modification of the enzyme, or binding so tight it does not dissociate on the experiment's timescale. It lowers the effective enzyme concentration, so on a double-reciprocal plot it mimics non-competitive inhibition, and its potency is quoted as kinact/KI rather than the Ki used for reversible inhibitors.

quiz.q_zh: 在双倒数 (Lineweaver-Burk) 图上，横轴截距等于什么？
quiz.q_en: On a Lineweaver-Burk plot, what does the x-intercept equal?

options.zh: −1/Vmax
options.en: −1/Vmax

options.zh: Km/Vmax
options.en: Km/Vmax

options.zh: −1/Km
options.en: −1/Km

options.zh: 1/Km
options.en: 1/Km

quiz.explain_zh: 令 1/v = 0 解 (Km/Vmax)(1/[S]) + 1/Vmax = 0，得 1/[S] = −1/Km，负号来自直线向左延长交轴。正的 1/Km 落在轴的另一侧；−1/Vmax 把纵截距的量错安到横轴上；Km/Vmax 是这条直线的斜率。
quiz.explain_en: Setting 1/v = 0 in (Km/Vmax)(1/[S]) + 1/Vmax = 0 gives 1/[S] = −1/Km, the minus sign arising because the line is extrapolated leftwards to the axis. A positive 1/Km lies on the wrong side of the axis, −1/Vmax misplaces the y-intercept quantity onto the x-axis, and Km/Vmax is the slope of the line.

quiz.q_zh: 竞争性抑制剂的典型特征是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the characteristic feature of a competitive inhibitor?

options.zh: 结构类似产物，占据同一变构位点
options.en: Resembles the product and occupies the same allosteric site

options.zh: 只结合 ES 复合物，不结合游离酶
options.en: Binds only the ES complex and never the free enzyme

options.zh: 与酶形成共价键，抑制不可逆转
options.en: Forms a covalent bond and inhibits irreversibly

options.zh: 结构类似底物，占据同一活性位点
options.en: Resembles the substrate and occupies the same active site

quiz.explain_zh: 竞争性抑制剂靠与底物形似而占据活性位点，因此提高 [S] 可以把它挤开。只结合 ES 是反竞争性 uncompetitive 的定义；与酶共价成键属于不可逆抑制，与三种可逆抑制并列而非其一；结合变构位点则是非竞争性一类的特点，且与底物形似恰恰不是变构结合的理由。
quiz.explain_en: A competitive inhibitor occupies the active site by resembling the substrate, which is why raising [S] displaces it. Binding only ES defines uncompetitive inhibition; forming a covalent bond makes it irreversible, a category alongside the three reversible types rather than one of them; and binding an allosteric site belongs to the non-competitive class, where resemblance to the substrate is precisely not the reason for binding.

quiz.q_zh: non-competitive 与 uncompetitive 抑制剂的关键区别在哪里？
quiz.q_en: What is the key difference between non-competitive and uncompetitive inhibitors?

options.zh: uncompetitive 只结合 E，non-competitive 兼结合 ES 与 P
options.en: Uncompetitive binds only E, non-competitive binds both ES and P

options.zh: 两者都只结合游离 E，区别在于是否可逆
options.en: Both bind only free E, differing in whether they are reversible

options.zh: 两者都只结合 ES，区别在于是否共价
options.en: Both bind only ES, differing in whether binding is covalent

options.zh: uncompetitive 只结合 ES，non-competitive 兼结合 E 与 ES
options.en: Uncompetitive binds only ES, non-competitive binds both E and ES

quiz.explain_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂的结合位点只在 ES 上出现，所以必须先有底物结合；非竞争性抑制剂对游离酶和 ES 都能结合，因而与底物浓度无关。说反竞争性只结合游离 E 正好说反；把区别归到可逆性或共价性也不对——这两类同属可逆、非共价抑制，共价通常意味着不可逆抑制。
quiz.explain_en: An uncompetitive inhibitor's site only exists on ES, so substrate must bind first, whereas a non-competitive inhibitor binds free enzyme and ES alike and is therefore insensitive to substrate concentration. Saying uncompetitive binds only free E states the opposite of the truth, and pinning the difference on reversibility or covalency fails too: both classes are reversible and non-covalent, covalent binding usually meaning irreversible inhibition.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：可逆与不可逆抑制的界线，以及看抑制剂的「四个点」
title_en: Review: reversible vs irreversible inhibition, and the four points to check for each inhibitor

points.zh: 老师给的不可逆抑制定义：E 加 S 生成 ES 之后「ES 就不会再变了」，既不解离也不生成 product，可以理解成酶被失活或变性了。
points.en: The definition the lecturer gives for irreversible inhibition: E + S forms ES and then ES never changes again — it neither dissociates nor gives product, so the enzyme can be regarded as inactivated or denatured.

points.zh: 本讲讨论的三种抑制（competitive、non-competitive、uncompetitive）都属于 reversible：每个反应式里 ES 那一步都画着可逆的双向箭头。
points.en: All three inhibition types under discussion (competitive, non-competitive, uncompetitive) are reversible: every scheme has the two-way arrow on the ES step.

points.zh: 老师的理由：不可逆抑制「没有什么动力学可言」，所以不放进 Michaelis-Menten / Lineweaver-Burk 的比较里。
points.en: His reason for setting irreversible inhibition aside: it has no kinetics to speak of, so it is left out of the Michaelis-Menten / Lineweaver-Burk comparison.

points.zh: 复习方法的建议：这一块最好从感性上去理解，不要试图纯粹从数学或化学上硬推。
points.en: His study advice: get an intuitive grip on this material rather than trying to force it through the maths or the chemistry alone.

points.zh: 每种抑制剂只需要记四个点：① 影响反应式的哪一步 ② 因子乘在哪个参数上 ③ 双倒数曲线（Lineweaver-Burk plot）哪个交点固定 ④ Km 与 Vmax 各自怎么变。
points.en: For each inhibitor only four points are needed: which step of the scheme it hits, which parameter the factor multiplies, which intercept stays fixed on the Lineweaver-Burk plot, and how Km and Vmax each change.

points.zh: 因子 (1 + [I]/Ki) 在三种抑制里形式完全相同：[I] 是游离抑制剂浓度，Ki 是 inhibition constant（抑制常数），概念上和 Km 类似，每种抑制剂有自己的数值。
points.en: The factor (1 + [I]/Ki) has the same form in all three cases: [I] is the free inhibitor concentration and Ki is the inhibition constant, a concept similar to Km, with its own value for each inhibitor.

points.zh: 差别只在这个因子乘在哪里 —— competitive 抑制剂只作用于游离酶 E（第一步），因子只乘在 Km 上，底物那一项不变。
points.en: The difference is only where that factor sits — a competitive inhibitor acts only on free enzyme E (the first step), so the factor multiplies Km alone and the substrate term is untouched.

points.zh: competitive 的双倒数曲线：与 y 轴（1/v 轴）的交点不变，直线整体往上抬（斜率变大）。
points.en: On the double-reciprocal plot for competitive inhibition the intercept on the y axis (1/v) is unchanged and the line tilts upwards (steeper slope).

points.zh: 老师明确说不必去背「斜率改变、截距改变」这类描述，抓住四个点就够了。
points.en: He explicitly says not to memorise phrasings like 'the slope changes, the intercept changes' — the four points are enough.

extra.zh: 不可逆抑制不是「E 加 S 生成 ES 后不再变化」，那描述的是一个 dead-end complex。不可逆抑制通常是对酶的共价修饰（或结合极紧、在实验时间尺度上不解离），它降低的是有效酶浓度 [E]，因此在 Lineweaver-Burk 图上表现得像 non-competitive（Vmax 下降、Km 不变），其强度用 kinact/KI 描述而不是 Ki。老师两句之前刚说过「这三种都是可逆的」，是对的，两处互相冲突。
extra.en: Irreversible inhibition is not 'E + S gives ES and then nothing changes' — that describes a dead-end complex. Irreversible inhibition is normally covalent modification of the enzyme (or binding so tight it does not dissociate on the experiment's timescale); it lowers the effective enzyme concentration [E], so on a Lineweaver-Burk plot it mimics non-competitive inhibition (Vmax down, Km unchanged), and its potency is quoted as kinact/KI rather than Ki. Two sentences earlier he correctly says all three types under discussion are reversible, so the two statements conflict.

extra.zh: Ki 的严格定义是 EI 复合物的 dissociation constant：Ki = [E][I]/[EI]，数值越小结合越紧。整个因子常写作 α = 1 + [I]/Ki；当 [I] = Ki 时 α = 2。
extra.en: Ki is strictly the dissociation constant of the EI complex, Ki = [E][I]/[EI]; the smaller it is, the tighter the binding. The whole factor is usually written α = 1 + [I]/Ki, so α = 2 when [I] = Ki.

extra.zh: Ki 与 IC50 不是一回事。Ki 是常数，IC50 依赖实验条件：对 competitive 抑制剂，[S] 越高测得的 IC50 越大（Cheng-Prusoff 关系）；对 uncompetitive 抑制剂反而随 [S] 升高而降低。
extra.en: Ki and IC50 are not the same. Ki is a constant; IC50 depends on assay conditions — for a competitive inhibitor the measured IC50 rises with [S] (the Cheng-Prusoff relation), whereas for an uncompetitive inhibitor it falls as [S] rises.

quiz.q_zh: 三种可逆抑制共有的因子 (1 + [I]/Ki) 中，Ki 指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the factor (1 + [I]/Ki) common to all three reversible inhibition types, what is Ki?

options.zh: 抑制剂产生半数抑制的浓度
options.en: the inhibitor concentration giving half-maximal inhibition

options.zh: 抑制剂被酶转化的速率常数
options.en: the rate constant for turnover of the inhibitor by the enzyme

options.zh: 抑制剂与底物的结合比例
options.en: the ratio in which inhibitor and substrate bind the enzyme

options.zh: 抑制剂与酶结合的解离常数
options.en: the dissociation constant of the enzyme-inhibitor complex

quiz.explain_zh: Ki = [E][I]/[EI]，是 EI 复合物的解离常数，越小表示结合越紧。「半数抑制的浓度」说的是 IC50，它依赖 [S] 与实验条件；抑制剂不是被酶转化的底物，也不存在固定的与底物结合比例。
quiz.explain_en: Ki = [E][I]/[EI], the dissociation constant of the EI complex; smaller means tighter binding. The half-maximal inhibition option describes IC50, which depends on [S] and assay conditions; the inhibitor is not a substrate turned over by the enzyme, and there is no fixed inhibitor-to-substrate binding ratio.

quiz.q_zh: 不可逆抑制在 Lineweaver-Burk 图上最像哪一种可逆抑制？
quiz.q_en: Which reversible inhibition type does irreversible inhibition mimic on a Lineweaver-Burk plot?

options.zh: 非竞争性抑制：Vmax 减小，Km 不变
options.en: non-competitive: Vmax falls, Km unchanged

options.zh: 竞争性抑制：Km 增大，Vmax 不变
options.en: competitive: Km rises, Vmax unchanged

options.zh: 反竞争性抑制：Km 与 Vmax 同时减小
options.en: uncompetitive: Km and Vmax both fall

options.zh: 混合型抑制：Km 增大，Vmax 减小
options.en: mixed: Km rises while Vmax falls

quiz.explain_zh: 共价修饰把一部分酶永久拿掉，等于降低有效 [E]，Vmax 按比例下降，而剩下的酶分子性质不变、Km 不变，所以图形与非竞争性一致。它的强度用 kinact/KI 描述，不能用 Ki。
quiz.explain_en: Covalent modification permanently removes part of the enzyme, i.e. lowers effective [E]: Vmax falls proportionally while the surviving molecules are unchanged, so Km stays the same and the plot looks non-competitive. Its potency is described by kinact/KI, not Ki.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：竞争性抑制剂为什么 Km 增大而 Vmax 不变
title_en: Review: why a competitive inhibitor raises Km but leaves Vmax unchanged

points.zh: 先把 Km 的定义摆正：Km 是反应速率达到 ½Vmax 时的底物浓度，不是速率本身。
points.en: Start from the definition: Km is the substrate concentration at which the rate reaches half of Vmax — it is a concentration, not a rate.

points.zh: competitive 抑制剂使表观 Km（apparent Km）增大，这是复习时学生先答对的一点。
points.en: A competitive inhibitor raises the apparent Km — the point the student gets right first.

points.zh: Vmax 不变的理由：真正测到的 Vmax 来自 ES → E + P 这一步，而抑制剂完全不碰这一步。
points.en: Why Vmax is unchanged: the Vmax actually measured comes from the ES → E + P step, and the inhibitor does not touch that step at all.

points.zh: 能形成的 ES 照样 100% 转化成 product，「有多少 ES 就有多少 P」，所以最大速率的上限没有被改变。
points.en: Whatever ES does form is still converted to product with the same efficiency — as much ES as there is, that much P — so the ceiling on rate is untouched.

points.zh: 但要达到 ½Vmax 就需要更多底物，因为一部分酶「已经被抑制剂给弄走了」。
points.en: Reaching half Vmax, however, now needs more substrate, because part of the enzyme has been taken away by the inhibitor.

points.zh: 写成方程就是 v = Vmax[S] / (αKm + [S])，α = 1 + [I]/Ki 只乘在 Km 上。
points.en: As an equation: v = Vmax[S] / (αKm + [S]), with α = 1 + [I]/Ki multiplying Km only.

points.zh: 双倒数图上：1/Vmax 的 y 截距不变，直线绕这一点上抬，所以加不同浓度抑制剂的几条线交于 1/v 轴。
points.en: On the double-reciprocal plot the y intercept 1/Vmax is fixed and the lines pivot upward about it, so lines at different inhibitor concentrations meet on the 1/v axis.

points.zh: 复习的顺序是固定的：先问 Km 怎么变，再问 Vmax 怎么变，最后核对双倒数图 —— 四个点里的后两个。
points.en: The drill order is fixed: first how Km changes, then how Vmax changes, then check it against the plot — the last two of the four points.

extra.zh: apparent Km = αKm，α = 1 + [I]/Ki，Vmax 不变。因此 catalytic efficiency kcat/Km 被降低 α 倍 —— competitive 抑制剂损害的是低底物浓度下的效率。
extra.en: Apparent Km = αKm with α = 1 + [I]/Ki, and Vmax is unchanged. The catalytic efficiency kcat/Km therefore drops by the factor α — a competitive inhibitor hurts performance at low substrate concentration.

extra.zh: competitive 抑制可以被足够高的底物浓度完全克服（surmountable），这是它与另外两类最有判别力的性质，也是临床上乙醇治疗甲醇中毒（争夺 alcohol dehydrogenase）的原理。
extra.en: Competitive inhibition can be overcome completely by high enough substrate (it is surmountable) — the most discriminating property against the other two types, and the basis of treating methanol poisoning with ethanol competing at alcohol dehydrogenase.

extra.zh: 「Vmax 不变」指的是外推到 [S] → ∞ 的最大速率不变。在任何有限的 [S] 下，加了 competitive 抑制剂的实测速率都是下降的 —— 考试里常被误读成「加了抑制剂速率不变」。
extra.en: 'Vmax unchanged' refers to the maximum rate extrapolated to infinite [S]. At any finite [S] the measured rate is still lower with a competitive inhibitor present — often misread in exams as 'the rate does not change'.

quiz.q_zh: 加入不同浓度的 competitive 抑制剂后，双倒数曲线呈现什么形态？
quiz.q_en: What do double-reciprocal plots look like at several competitive inhibitor concentrations?

options.zh: 各条直线交于 1/[S] 轴上同一点
options.en: the lines all meet at one point on the 1/[S] axis

options.zh: 各条直线互相平行并向上平移
options.en: the lines stay parallel and shift upward

options.zh: 各条直线交于第一象限内一点
options.en: the lines all meet at one point in the first quadrant

options.zh: 各条直线交于 1/v 轴上同一点
options.en: the lines all meet at one point on the 1/v axis

quiz.explain_zh: Vmax 不变意味着 y 截距 1/Vmax 固定，直线绕它上抬。交于 1/[S] 轴是非竞争性（Km 不变），互相平行是反竞争性（Km 与 Vmax 同比例变化）。
quiz.explain_en: Unchanged Vmax fixes the y intercept 1/Vmax and the lines pivot about it. Meeting on the 1/[S] axis is non-competitive (Km unchanged); staying parallel is uncompetitive (Km and Vmax change by the same factor).

quiz.q_zh: competitive 抑制剂为什么不改变 Vmax？
quiz.q_en: Why does a competitive inhibitor leave Vmax unchanged?

options.zh: 底物足量时可把抑制剂从游离酶上排挤掉
options.en: enough substrate outcompetes the inhibitor for free enzyme

options.zh: 抑制剂结合后的酶仍能把底物变成产物
options.en: enzyme with inhibitor bound still turns substrate into product

options.zh: 抑制剂与酶之间形成的是共价结合
options.en: the inhibitor is bound to the enzyme covalently

options.zh: 抑制剂使 Km 与 Vmax 同比例地下降
options.en: the inhibitor lowers Km and Vmax by the same factor

quiz.explain_zh: EI 是可逆的，底物浓度趋于无穷时游离酶几乎全部被底物占据，最大速率恢复到原值。EI 无法再结合底物，所以「结合抑制剂的酶仍能生成产物」不成立；共价结合属于不可逆抑制；同比例下降是反竞争性的特征。
quiz.explain_en: EI is reversible, so as [S] goes to infinity substrate occupies essentially all the enzyme and the maximum rate is restored. EI cannot bind substrate, so the option about inhibited enzyme still making product is false; covalent binding would be irreversible inhibition; equal-factor changes describe uncompetitive inhibition.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：非竞争性抑制剂与 EIS 三元复合物
title_en: Review: non-competitive inhibition and the EIS ternary complex

points.zh: 四个点的第一点：非竞争性抑制剂结合在底物结合位点以外的位置，因此 E + S ⇌ ES 这条线「该结合结合、不结合不结合」，完全不受干扰。
points.en: First of the four points: a non-competitive inhibitor binds somewhere other than the substrate site, so the E + S ⇌ ES line proceeds exactly as before.

points.zh: 它另外开出一条通路：酶先结合抑制剂生成 EI，EI 仍能结合底物，生成酶-抑制剂-底物的三元复合物 EIS。
points.en: It opens a second route: enzyme binds inhibitor to give EI, EI can still bind substrate, and an enzyme-inhibitor-substrate ternary complex EIS forms.

points.zh: 模型默认 EIS 不会继续变成 E + P —— 它是一个死端复合物。
points.en: The model assumes EIS does not go on to E + P — it is a dead-end complex.

points.zh: 所以 Km 不变：无论是 E 还是 EI，对底物的结合行为一样，达到 ½Vmax 所需的底物浓度不动。
points.en: Hence Km is unchanged: E and EI bind substrate alike, so the substrate concentration needed for half-maximal rate does not move.

points.zh: 而 Vmax 一定变小：总的 ES 里有一部分变成了 EIS，这部分不产生产物。
points.en: Vmax must fall: part of what would have been ES is diverted into EIS, which yields no product.

points.zh: 因子 (1 + [I]/Ki) 同时作用于两条通路，写在整个式子外面，等价于只把 Vmax 除以 α。
points.en: The factor (1 + [I]/Ki) applies to both routes and sits outside the whole expression, which amounts to dividing Vmax by α.

points.zh: 双倒数曲线：固定的是 x 轴（1/[S] 轴）上的交点，即 −1/Km 不变；这正好和 competitive 固定 y 轴形成对照 —— 「记住这个就 OK 了」。
points.en: On the double-reciprocal plot the fixed point is on the x axis (1/[S]), i.e. −1/Km does not move — the mirror image of competitive inhibition fixing the y axis, which is all he asks you to remember.

extra.zh: v = Vmax[S] / [α(Km + [S])]：Vmax 降为 Vmax/α，Km 不变。所以 y 截距变成 α/Vmax（升高），x 截距仍是 −1/Km，斜率 αKm/Vmax 变陡。
extra.en: v = Vmax[S] / [α(Km + [S])]: Vmax becomes Vmax/α while Km is unchanged. The y intercept rises to α/Vmax, the x intercept stays at −1/Km, and the slope αKm/Vmax gets steeper.

extra.zh: 严格的「经典 non-competitive」要求抑制剂对 E 和对 ES 的亲和力相同（Ki 与 Ki′ 相等）。两者不等时叫 mixed inhibition，Km 会被一并改变，双倒数线的交点离开 1/[S] 轴、落在第二象限。教科书上的「Km 不变」是这一特例。
extra.en: Classical non-competitive inhibition strictly requires equal affinity for E and for ES (Ki = Ki'). When they differ it is mixed inhibition: Km changes as well and the intersection leaves the 1/[S] axis into the second quadrant. The textbook 'Km unchanged' is that special case.

extra.zh: 非竞争性抑制不能靠提高底物浓度克服（insurmountable），这与 competitive 恰好相反；许多别构抑制剂和重金属离子（结合游离巯基）在动力学上表现为这一类。
extra.en: Non-competitive inhibition cannot be overcome by raising substrate (it is insurmountable), the opposite of competitive; many allosteric inhibitors and heavy-metal ions binding free thiols behave this way kinetically.

quiz.q_zh: 经典非竞争性抑制对动力学参数的影响是？
quiz.q_en: How does classical non-competitive inhibition affect the kinetic parameters?

options.zh: Km 不变，Vmax 减小
options.en: Km unchanged, Vmax lower

options.zh: Km 增大，Vmax 不变
options.en: Km higher, Vmax unchanged

options.zh: Km 减小，Vmax 减小
options.en: Km lower, Vmax lower

options.zh: Km 增大，Vmax 减小
options.en: Km higher, Vmax lower

quiz.explain_zh: 抑制剂结合在活性位点之外，不改变底物结合，所以 Km 不变；被拉进死端 EIS 的那部分酶不产生产物，Vmax 下降。Km 增大 Vmax 不变是竞争性，双双减小是反竞争性，Km 增大且 Vmax 减小是 mixed inhibition。
quiz.explain_en: Binding outside the active site leaves substrate binding, and therefore Km, untouched, while enzyme pulled into the dead-end EIS makes no product, so Vmax falls. Higher Km with unchanged Vmax is competitive, both falling is uncompetitive, and higher Km with lower Vmax is mixed inhibition.

quiz.q_zh: 在这一模型里，EIS 三元复合物的去向是什么？
quiz.q_en: In this model, what becomes of the EIS ternary complex?

options.zh: 解离出底物后共价失活
options.en: it loses substrate and is inactivated covalently

options.zh: 把抑制剂转变成第二个产物
options.en: it converts the inhibitor into a second product

options.zh: 停在死端，不再生成产物
options.en: it is a dead end and yields no product

options.zh: 以更快的速率生成产物
options.en: it releases product at a faster rate

quiz.explain_zh: 默认 EIS 不能走到 E + P，这正是 Vmax 下降的来源。若 EIS 仍能出产物，那属于部分（partial）抑制；共价失活是不可逆抑制；抑制剂不是被催化的底物。
quiz.explain_en: EIS is assumed unable to reach E + P, which is exactly why Vmax falls. If EIS still made product this would be partial inhibition; covalent inactivation would be irreversible inhibition; and the inhibitor is not a substrate being turned over.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：用「100 个酶、75 个抑制剂」重推竞争性抑制的 Km 增大
title_en: Review: rederiving the competitive Km increase with 100 enzymes and 75 inhibitors

points.zh: 先用米氏方程验证 Km 的含义：令 Km = [S]，分母变成 [S] + [S]，分子 Vmax[S] 约掉，得到 v = ½Vmax。
points.en: First verify what Km means from the Michaelis-Menten equation: set Km = [S], the denominator becomes [S] + [S], the numerator Vmax[S] cancels, and v = Vmax/2.

points.zh: 第一个前提：ES → E + P 这一步不受抑制剂影响，「假设有 50 个 ES，它照样生成 50 个 E + P」。
points.en: Premise one: the ES → E + P step is untouched by the inhibitor — 50 ES still give 50 E + P.

points.zh: 无抑制剂的情形：100 个游离酶，只要 50 个底物就能形成 50 个 ES，速率达到 ½Vmax。
points.en: Without inhibitor: with 100 free enzymes, 50 substrate molecules give 50 ES and the rate reaches half Vmax.

points.zh: 加入 75 个抑制剂：抑制剂先占走 75 个酶，只剩 25 个游离酶，同样的 50 个底物再也形不成 50 个 ES。
points.en: Add 75 inhibitor molecules: they take 75 enzymes, leaving 25 free, and the same 50 substrate molecules can no longer form 50 ES.

points.zh: 要重新达到 ½Vmax，必须把底物浓度提上去，比如提到 75，让底物与抑制剂「一半一半」地瓜分游离酶。
points.en: To get back to half Vmax the substrate concentration must be raised — say to 75 — so substrate and inhibitor split the free enzyme evenly.

points.zh: 结论：½Vmax 所对应的底物浓度变大了，而这个浓度就是 Km —— 这就是 apparent Km 增大的含义。
points.en: Conclusion: the substrate concentration corresponding to half Vmax has gone up, and that concentration is Km — this is what the rise in apparent Km means.

points.zh: 模型的简化：不比较底物与抑制剂夺取游离酶的能力，只按数量比例算 —— 数量越多，溶液里自然碰撞形成复合物的几率越大。
points.en: The simplification: the relative ability of substrate and inhibitor to capture free enzyme is ignored, and only their numbers count — more molecules means more random collisions and more complex formed.

points.zh: 整段讨论始终锁定在同一个条件下：反应速率为 ½Vmax 时的底物浓度，参数比较才有意义。
points.en: The whole argument stays pinned to one condition — the substrate concentration at half-maximal rate — which is what makes the comparison meaningful.

extra.zh: 严格的分配比例由 Km 与 Ki 共同决定：游离酶在底物与抑制剂之间的分配取决于 [S]/Km 与 [I]/Ki 的比值，老师「一半一半」的算法隐含了两者亲和力相同。规范结果是 apparent Km = Km(1 + [I]/Ki)，[I] = Ki 时 Km 恰好加倍。
extra.en: The real partition is set by Km and Ki together: free enzyme divides between substrate and inhibitor according to [S]/Km versus [I]/Ki, and the lecturer's fifty-fifty arithmetic tacitly assumes equal affinity. The formal result is apparent Km = Km(1 + [I]/Ki), so Km exactly doubles when [I] = Ki.

extra.zh: 「抑制剂夺走了 75 个酶」是动态平衡而不是永久占据 —— EI 不断结合又解离，正因为如此，底物过量时速率能完全恢复。若真是永久占据，那就是不可逆抑制，Vmax 会下降。
extra.en: 'The inhibitor took 75 enzymes' describes a dynamic equilibrium, not permanent occupancy — EI keeps forming and dissociating, which is exactly why excess substrate restores the full rate. Permanent occupancy would be irreversible inhibition and Vmax would fall.

extra.zh: Km 是浓度而不是速率，可以直接在 [S] 轴上于 ½Vmax 处读出；这一点由它的构成决定：Km = (k₋₁ + k₂)/k₁，是一个单分子步骤的速率常数除以一个双分子步骤的速率常数，量纲正好是浓度。
extra.en: Km is a concentration, not a rate, and can be read straight off the [S] axis at half Vmax; this follows from its make-up, Km = (k₋₁ + k₂)/k₁, a unimolecular rate constant over a bimolecular one, whose dimensions are exactly concentration.

quiz.q_zh: 老师用「100 个酶、75 个抑制剂」的数字模型是为了说明什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the 100-enzymes-and-75-inhibitors numerical model meant to show?

options.zh: 竞争性抑制下能达到的 Vmax 明显下降
options.en: competitive inhibition lowers the Vmax that can be reached

options.zh: 非竞争性抑制下 Km 保持不变的原因
options.en: why Km stays the same under non-competitive inhibition

options.zh: 反竞争性抑制下 Km 会减小的原因
options.en: why Km falls under uncompetitive inhibition

options.zh: 竞争性抑制下达到 ½Vmax 需要更多底物
options.en: competitive inhibition needs more substrate to reach half Vmax

quiz.explain_zh: 抑制剂占走一部分游离酶后，原来的底物量形不成同样多的 ES，必须提高底物浓度才能回到 ½Vmax，而 ½Vmax 对应的底物浓度就是 Km。Vmax 在竞争性抑制下并不下降。
quiz.explain_en: With part of the free enzyme tied up, the original amount of substrate no longer makes the same amount of ES, so [S] must be raised to return to half Vmax — and that substrate concentration is Km. Vmax itself does not fall under competitive inhibition.

quiz.q_zh: 这个数字模型明确地简化掉了哪一项？
quiz.q_en: Which factor does this numerical model explicitly leave out?

options.zh: 反应体系的温度与 pH 是否发生变化
options.en: whether the temperature and pH of the system change

options.zh: 底物与抑制剂争夺游离酶的亲和力差异
options.en: the difference in affinity with which substrate and inhibitor capture free enzyme

options.zh: ES 转化成产物这一步是否会被拖慢
options.en: whether the conversion of ES into product is slowed down

options.zh: 酶与底物结合时是否发生构象变化
options.en: whether enzyme and substrate change conformation on binding

quiz.explain_zh: 老师原话是「先不考虑底物和抑制剂抢夺游离酶的能力，只考虑它们占的比例」，即默认两者亲和力相同；严格处理需要 Km 与 Ki 的比较。ES 生成产物不受影响是模型的前提而非被忽略的项。
quiz.explain_en: He says outright that the competition strength of substrate versus inhibitor is set aside and only their proportions are counted, i.e. equal affinity is assumed; a rigorous treatment compares Km with Ki. That ES still gives product normally is a stated premise, not an omission.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：反竞争性抑制剂 —— 只结合 ES，Km 与 Vmax 双双减小
title_en: Review: uncompetitive inhibition — binds only ES, lowering both Km and Vmax

points.zh: 老师称之为「最折磨人、很反直觉」的一类：Km 减小、Vmax 减小，是三类里唯一的双减小。
points.en: He calls this the most punishing and counter-intuitive type: Km down and Vmax down, the only case where both fall.

points.zh: 第一个点：反竞争性抑制剂只和 ES 复合物结合，不结合游离的酶，也不结合底物本身。
points.en: First point: an uncompetitive inhibitor binds only the ES complex, not free enzyme and not substrate.

points.zh: 第二个点：因子 (1 + [I]/Ki) 只和 substrate 那一项乘在一起。
points.en: Second point: the factor (1 + [I]/Ki) multiplies the substrate term only.

points.zh: 第三个点：双倒数曲线是整条线向上平移，与原来的直线平行，不发生相交。
points.en: Third point: the double-reciprocal line shifts up bodily, staying parallel to the original and never crossing it.

points.zh: Vmax 减小容易理解：抑制剂夺走了一部分 ES，能走到 E + P 的少了，最大反应速率降低。
points.en: The drop in Vmax is easy: the inhibitor removes part of the ES pool, less of it reaches E + P, and the maximum rate falls.

points.zh: Km 减小 = 表观上对底物的亲和力升高，这是老师反复说「很抽象」的那一点。
points.en: The drop in Km means the apparent affinity for substrate has gone up — the part he repeatedly calls abstract.

points.zh: 老师给出的感性链条：Vmax 已经降低了 → 只需要更少的 ES 就能达到降低后的 ½Vmax → 酶浓度不变时也就只需要更少的底物 → ½Vmax 对应的 [S] 变小。
points.en: His intuitive chain: Vmax is already lower, so less ES suffices to reach the lowered half-Vmax, so with enzyme concentration fixed less substrate is needed, so the [S] at half Vmax is smaller.

points.zh: 他自评这是「从后边往前倒的一个逻辑，很复杂，不能理解就记吧」，并给出记忆口诀：竞争性 Km 增大、非竞争性 Km 不变，只有反竞争性 Km 减小。
points.en: He grades his own argument as reasoning backwards and says to memorise it if it will not click, with the mnemonic: competitive raises Km, non-competitive leaves it, only uncompetitive lowers it.

points.zh: 他随后想用 KRAS 抑制剂当作现实例子，说明确实存在必须结合到酶-底物复合物上的分子（网站太慢没打开）。
points.en: He then reaches for KRAS inhibitors as a real-world example that molecules really do have to bind the enzyme-substrate complex — the website was too slow to load.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 老师的因果链是倒着推的（Vmax 降低 → 需要更少 ES → 需要更少底物），他自己也承认。正向的机制是：抑制剂只结合 ES，把 E + S ⇌ ES 的平衡向右拉（Le Chatelier），所以表观亲和力升高。定量上 Km 与 Vmax 同时除以 α′ = 1 + [I]/Ki，Vmax/Km 因此不变，这正是双倒数线平行的原因 —— 他说「不能理解就记吧」的地方，恰恰有一句话能讲清的机制。
extra.en: His causal chain runs backwards (Vmax falls, so less ES is needed, so less substrate), as he himself concedes. Forwards, the mechanism is: the inhibitor binds only ES and pulls the E + S ⇌ ES equilibrium to the right (Le Chatelier), which raises the apparent affinity. Quantitatively Km and Vmax are both divided by α' = 1 + [I]/Ki, so Vmax/Km is unchanged — which is exactly why the lines are parallel. The point he tells you to memorise has a one-sentence mechanism.

extra.zh: v = Vmax[S] / (Km + α′[S])，即 Vmax_app = Vmax/α′、Km_app = Km/α′。双倒数图上斜率 Km/Vmax 保持不变（所以平行），y 截距升到 α′/Vmax，x 截距从 −1/Km 移到 −α′/Km（往左）。
extra.en: v = Vmax[S] / (Km + α'[S]), i.e. Vmax_app = Vmax/α' and Km_app = Km/α'. On the double-reciprocal plot the slope Km/Vmax is unchanged (hence parallel lines), the y intercept rises to α'/Vmax, and the x intercept moves from −1/Km to −α'/Km, further to the left.

extra.zh: 临床上的 KRAS G12C 抑制剂（sotorasib、adagrasib）与教科书的 uncompetitive 不是一回事：它们共价修饰突变来的 Cys12，且只结合 GDP 结合态（失活态）的 switch-II 口袋，属于状态选择性的共价抑制。「必须结合到某种复合物上」的直觉是对的，动力学归类不同。
extra.en: The clinical KRAS G12C inhibitors (sotorasib, adagrasib) are not textbook uncompetitive inhibitors: they modify the mutant Cys12 covalently and bind only the switch-II pocket of the GDP-bound (inactive) state, making them state-selective covalent inhibitors. The intuition that a drug can require a particular complex is right, but the kinetic classification differs.

extra.zh: 反竞争性抑制在单底物酶里少见，在双底物（bi-substrate）反应里很常见，因为第二个底物必须等第一个结合后才有位点。它也是唯一一类底物浓度越高抑制越强的抑制 —— 提高 [S] 反而帮倒忙。
extra.en: Uncompetitive inhibition is rare for single-substrate enzymes but common in bi-substrate reactions, where the second site only exists after the first substrate binds. It is also the only type whose inhibition deepens as substrate rises — raising [S] makes things worse.

quiz.q_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂结合的对象是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does an uncompetitive inhibitor bind to?

options.zh: 只结合酶-底物复合物 ES
options.en: only the enzyme-substrate complex ES

options.zh: 只结合游离的酶分子 E
options.en: only the free enzyme molecule E

options.zh: 同等地结合游离酶与 ES
options.en: free enzyme and ES equally well

options.zh: 只结合游离的底物分子 S
options.en: only the free substrate molecule S

quiz.explain_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂的定义就是只识别 ES 复合物。只结合游离酶是竞争性，同等结合 E 与 ES 是经典非竞争性，而结合底物本身的分子根本不是酶抑制剂。
quiz.explain_en: By definition an uncompetitive inhibitor recognises the ES complex only. Binding free enzyme alone is competitive, binding E and ES equally is classical non-competitive, and a molecule that binds the substrate itself is not an enzyme inhibitor at all.

quiz.q_zh: 反竞争性抑制的双倒数曲线与无抑制剂时相比是？
quiz.q_en: Compared with the uninhibited case, the double-reciprocal line for uncompetitive inhibition is:

options.zh: 与原直线相交于 1/v 轴上
options.en: intersecting the original on the 1/v axis

options.zh: 与原直线相交于 1/[S] 轴上
options.en: intersecting the original on the 1/[S] axis

options.zh: 与原直线相交于第一象限内
options.en: intersecting the original in the first quadrant

options.zh: 与原直线平行并向上平移
options.en: parallel to the original and shifted upward

quiz.explain_zh: Km 与 Vmax 被同一个因子 α′ 除，斜率 Km/Vmax 不变，所以直线平行上移。交于 1/v 轴是竞争性，交于 1/[S] 轴是非竞争性，交于第一象限对应 mixed inhibition 的一种情形。
quiz.explain_en: Km and Vmax are divided by the same factor α', so the slope Km/Vmax is unchanged and the line moves up in parallel. Intersecting on the 1/v axis is competitive, on the 1/[S] axis is non-competitive, and an intersection in the first quadrant corresponds to a case of mixed inhibition.

quiz.q_zh: 反竞争性抑制下，哪一个量不随抑制剂浓度改变？
quiz.q_en: Under uncompetitive inhibition, which quantity does not change with inhibitor concentration?

options.zh: 双倒数线的 y 截距
options.en: the y intercept of the plot

options.zh: Vmax 与 Km 的比值
options.en: the ratio of Vmax to Km

options.zh: Vmax 的绝对数值
options.en: the absolute value of Vmax

options.zh: Km 的绝对数值
options.en: the absolute value of Km

quiz.explain_zh: Km 与 Vmax 都被 α′ = 1 + [I]/Ki 除，两者的比值（即双倒数图的斜率的倒数）保持不变；Vmax、Km 各自都减小，y 截距 α′/Vmax 则随抑制剂浓度升高。
quiz.explain_en: Km and Vmax are both divided by α' = 1 + [I]/Ki, so their ratio — the reciprocal of the plot's slope — is preserved; Vmax and Km each fall, and the y intercept α'/Vmax rises with inhibitor concentration.

title_zh: 课前闲聊：从总论转入各论，以及 cysteine protease 与 SUMO protease
title_en: Between topics: moving from general to specific enzymes, cysteine proteases and SUMO protease

points.zh: 课程结构的交代：前面讲的都是总论（一大类物质的共同特点），从这一讲开始进入各论（单个酶、单个分子分开讨论）。
points.en: A note on how the course is organised: everything so far has been the general part (properties shared by a whole class), and from here on it is the specific part (individual enzymes and molecules discussed one by one).

points.zh: 老师给的权重：各论的重要性远低于总论，多是理解型、扩大知识面的内容，这一讲「难度非常小、压力很小」。
points.en: His weighting: the specific part matters much less than the general part — mostly comprehension and background — and this session is meant to be easy going.

points.zh: 老板给的任务：关注 cysteine-based enzyme，也就是以半胱氨酸为催化中心的那一大类 protease（cysteine protease）。
points.en: The task from his boss: look into cysteine-based enzymes, i.e. the large family of proteases with cysteine at the catalytic centre.

points.zh: 老师顺口给 protease 下了一句评价（见延伸卡中的更正）。
points.en: He tosses off a one-line assessment of proteases in passing (corrected in an extension card below).

points.zh: 实验室里最常用的这类酶就是 SUMO protease，用来把融合表达的 SUMO 标签切掉，学生实验室冰箱里也冻着。
points.en: The workhorse example in the lab is SUMO protease, used to cut off the SUMO fusion tag; the student has some in the freezer too.

points.zh: 他自己纯化过一批 SUMO protease，知道它的一个特点：这个蛋白酶容易结合核酸，纯化时会被一起带出来。
points.en: Having purified a batch himself, he knows one of its quirks: this protease readily binds nucleic acid and drags it through the purification.

points.zh: 判断方法在 AKTA 上看紫外曲线：同时监测 280 nm 与 260 nm 两条线，老师给出的「干净蛋白」判据见口误卡。
points.en: You check this on the AKTA UV trace, following 280 nm and 260 nm together; the criterion he quotes for clean protein is corrected in a misstatement card.

points.zh: 警示信号：如果峰位置上两条线基本贴到一起，或者 260 的读数高于 280，很可能蛋白和核酸是被一起纯化出来的。
points.en: The warning sign: if the two traces sit almost on top of each other across the peak, or 260 reads higher than 280, protein and nucleic acid have most likely come through together.

extra.zh: 「280 比 260 要在 0.6 左右说明才是干净的蛋白」把比值说反了（两位校对独立标出）。纯蛋白是 A260/A280 ≈ 0.57–0.6，也就是 A280/A260 ≈ 1.7–1.8。A260/A280 升高到 0.6 以上才是核酸污染的信号；纯核酸的 A260/A280 约为 1.8–2.0。
extra.en: 'A280 over A260 around 0.6 means clean protein' has the ratio inverted (flagged independently by two proofreaders). Pure protein gives A260/A280 ≈ 0.57–0.6, i.e. A280/A260 ≈ 1.7–1.8. It is a rise of A260/A280 above about 0.6 that signals nucleic-acid contamination; pure nucleic acid has A260/A280 ≈ 1.8–2.0.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 「protease 就是最广泛的 enzyme」是一句随口的夸大。protease 只是 EC 3 水解酶（hydrolase）之下的一支；按 EC 六大类看，oxidoreductase 与 transferase 所辖的酶数量同样庞大，也没有哪一类可以称作「最广泛」。
extra.en: 'Proteases are just the most widespread enzymes' is an offhand overstatement. Proteases are one branch under EC 3, the hydrolases; across the six EC classes, oxidoreductases and transferases are equally vast, and no single class is 'the most widespread'.

extra.zh: cysteine protease 的催化机制：Cys-His(-Asn/Asp) 催化三联体，Cys 的巯基作为亲核体进攻羰基碳，形成共价的酰基-酶中间体，再由水解开。代表成员有 papain、caspase、calpain 以及 SUMO protease（Ulp1/SENP）。与 serine protease 的 Ser-His-Asp 三联体是同一逻辑、不同亲核体。
extra.en: Mechanism of cysteine proteases: a Cys-His(-Asn/Asp) catalytic triad in which the cysteine thiol attacks the carbonyl carbon as nucleophile, forming a covalent acyl-enzyme intermediate that water then hydrolyses. Members include papain, the caspases, calpain and SUMO protease (Ulp1/SENP). It is the same logic as the Ser-His-Asp triad of serine proteases with a different nucleophile.

extra.zh: SUMO protease 识别的是 SUMO 的三维折叠而不是一段线性序列，在 SUMO C 端的 Gly-Gly 之后切开，目标蛋白因此不留下任何额外残基 —— 这是它在需要天然 N 端时比 TEV protease（切 ENLYFQ↓G，会留一个 Gly）更受欢迎的原因。
extra.en: SUMO protease recognises the folded three-dimensional structure of SUMO rather than a linear motif, cutting immediately after the C-terminal Gly-Gly so the target protein keeps a native N terminus with no extra residues — the reason it is preferred over TEV protease (which cuts ENLYFQ↓G and leaves a glycine) when a native N terminus is required.

quiz.q_zh: 紫外吸收上，纯净蛋白样品的比值应接近哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which UV absorbance ratio indicates a clean protein sample?

options.en: A260/A280 of about 0.6
A260/A280 of about 1.8
A280/A260 of about 0.6
A280/A260 of about 1.0

quiz.explain_zh: 纯蛋白 A260/A280 ≈ 0.57–0.6，等价于 A280/A260 ≈ 1.7–1.8。A260/A280 约 1.8 是纯核酸的特征；A280/A260 约 0.6 恰好是课上说反了的版本，对应核酸污染；两者约为 1.0 表示蛋白与核酸各占一部分。
quiz.explain_en: Pure protein has A260/A280 ≈ 0.57–0.6, equivalently A280/A260 ≈ 1.7–1.8. An A260/A280 near 1.8 is the signature of pure nucleic acid; A280/A260 near 0.6 is the inverted version stated in the lecture and would mean nucleic-acid contamination; a ratio near 1.0 either way means a mixture.

quiz.q_zh: SUMO protease 属于下列哪一类蛋白酶？
quiz.q_en: SUMO protease belongs to which class of proteases?

options.zh: cysteine protease，以 Cys 为亲核体
options.en: cysteine protease, with Cys as nucleophile

options.zh: serine protease，以 Ser 为亲核体
options.en: serine protease, with Ser as nucleophile

options.zh: aspartic protease，以 Asp 为催化残基
options.en: aspartic protease, with Asp as catalytic residue

options.zh: metalloprotease，以 Zn²⁺ 为催化中心
options.en: metalloprotease, with Zn²⁺ at the centre

quiz.explain_zh: SUMO protease（Ulp1/SENP 家族）用 Cys-His-Asn 三联体，巯基作亲核体形成共价酰基-酶中间体，正是老板让老师关注的 cysteine-based enzyme。胰凝乳蛋白酶属 serine protease，胃蛋白酶属 aspartic protease，羧肽酶 A 属 metalloprotease。
quiz.explain_en: SUMO protease (the Ulp1/SENP family) uses a Cys-His-Asn triad whose thiol nucleophile forms a covalent acyl-enzyme intermediate — precisely the cysteine-based enzyme his boss asked him to look into. Chymotrypsin is a serine protease, pepsin an aspartic protease, and carboxypeptidase A a metalloprotease.

title_zh: 课前闲聊：蛋白酶为什么会缠上核酸，以及为什么补加核酸酶来不及
title_en: Between topics: why a protease drags nucleic acid along, and why adding nuclease afterwards is too late

points.zh: 后果先说：结合了核酸的蛋白酶常常失活，因为核酸缠在酶的表面，挡住了底物与酶的接触。
points.en: The consequence first: a protease that has picked up nucleic acid is often inactive, because the nucleic acid wraps around its surface and blocks substrate access.

points.zh: 纯化完成之后再补加核酸酶意义不大：核酸与蛋白缠得很紧，核酸酶不一定接触得到；就算切断了，也不一定能把碎片从蛋白表面分开。
points.en: Adding nuclease after the purification is largely pointless: the nucleic acid is wound on tightly, the nuclease may not reach it, and even after cutting, the fragments do not necessarily come off the protein surface.

points.zh: 分子层面的原因：这类蛋白表面带正电的氨基酸多（精氨酸 arginine、组氨酸 histidine、赖氨酸 lysine），而核酸的磷酸骨架带大量负电。
points.en: The molecular reason: these proteins carry many positively charged residues on the surface (arginine, histidine, lysine), while the phosphate backbone of nucleic acid is heavily negative.

points.zh: 两者之间形成的是很强的离子相互作用（ionic interaction）；老师引用他前面讲过的数量级：离子相互作用的作用能约为氢键的十倍。
points.en: What forms between them is a strong ionic interaction; he cites the order of magnitude he gave earlier — an ionic interaction is worth about ten times a hydrogen bond.

points.zh: 而且不是单个电荷：核酸的每一个 nucleotide 都带一个磷酸基团，一整条链上就有几十上百个负电荷。
points.en: And it is not a single charge: every nucleotide carries a phosphate group, so a whole strand presents tens or hundreds of negative charges.

points.zh: 老师顺手画了核酸的结构来说明：磷酸—五碳糖（核糖）—碱基（base）—磷酸，正电氨基酸就在这一串磷酸上「络合」住，多点结合非常难拆开。
points.en: He sketches the structure to make the point: phosphate, five-carbon sugar, base, phosphate — and the positively charged residues clamp onto that run of phosphates, a multi-point grip that is very hard to prise apart.

points.zh: 正确做法是在源头解决：裂解一开始就加 DNase / RNase，国内俗称「超级核酸酶」，商品名 Benzonase。
points.en: The fix belongs at the start: add DNase/RNase from the moment of lysis — the reagent known in Chinese labs as 'super nuclease', sold under the trade name Benzonase.

points.zh: 老师的实操建议：大肠杆菌里表达的 SUMO protease 如果发现带着核酸，与其费时费力去除、还要损失蛋白，不如直接重新纯化一批。
points.en: His practical advice: if a SUMO protease expressed in E. coli comes out carrying nucleic acid, repurifying a fresh batch beats spending time and losing protein trying to strip it off.

extra.zh: 260/280 判据的物理基础：核酸的吸收峰在 260 nm，来自嘌呤嘧啶碱基；蛋白的 280 nm 吸收几乎全部来自色氨酸（Trp）和酪氨酸（Tyr），少量来自胱氨酸。比值实质是这两组发色团的相对含量，所以不含 Trp 的蛋白在 280 nm 处吸收极弱，这一判据对它并不灵敏。
extra.en: Why the 260/280 test works: nucleic acid absorbs at 260 nm through its purine and pyrimidine bases, while protein absorption at 280 nm comes almost entirely from tryptophan and tyrosine with a small cystine contribution. The ratio really reports the relative amount of the two chromophore sets, so a protein without tryptophan absorbs very weakly at 280 nm and the test is insensitive for it.

extra.zh: 去除结合核酸的常规手段正是针对离子相互作用：提高盐浓度（0.5–1 M NaCl）屏蔽电荷、用聚乙烯亚胺（PEI）或硫酸链霉素沉淀核酸、走阴离子交换或肝素柱把两者分开。Benzonase 是一种非特异的核酸内切酶，需要 Mg²⁺，能把 DNA 和 RNA 切成 3–5 个碱基的寡核苷酸。
extra.en: The standard ways of stripping bound nucleic acid all attack the ionic interaction: raise the salt (0.5–1 M NaCl) to screen the charges, precipitate the nucleic acid with polyethyleneimine or streptomycin sulfate, or separate the two on anion-exchange or heparin columns. Benzonase itself is a non-specific endonuclease, requires Mg²⁺, and digests both DNA and RNA down to oligonucleotides of three to five bases.

extra.zh: 「离子相互作用是氢键的十倍」只在真空或低介电环境下成立。水的介电常数很高，加上离子的水合作用，水溶液中单个盐桥的净贡献往往只和一个氢键相当。蛋白-核酸复合物之所以拆不开，靠的是几十个接触点的累加（avidity），不是单个键特别强。
extra.en: 'An ionic interaction is worth ten hydrogen bonds' holds in vacuum or a low-dielectric environment. In water the high dielectric constant plus ion hydration usually cut a single salt bridge down to about the worth of one hydrogen bond. What makes a protein-nucleic acid complex so hard to break is the sum of dozens of contacts (avidity), not the strength of any one bond.

quiz.q_zh: 蛋白酶容易带着核酸一起被纯化出来，分子基础是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the molecular basis for a protease co-purifying with nucleic acid?

options.zh: 表面正电氨基酸与磷酸骨架的离子相互作用
options.en: ionic interaction between surface positive residues and the phosphate backbone

options.zh: 表面负电氨基酸与磷酸骨架的离子相互作用
options.en: ionic interaction between surface negative residues and the phosphate backbone

options.zh: 疏水口袋与核酸磷酸骨架的疏水相互作用
options.en: hydrophobic interaction between a hydrophobic pocket and the phosphate backbone

options.zh: 半胱氨酸与磷酸骨架之间形成的共价键
options.en: a covalent bond between cysteine and the phosphate backbone

quiz.explain_zh: 精氨酸、赖氨酸、组氨酸在生理 pH 下带正电，与核酸每个 nucleotide 上带负电的磷酸形成多点离子相互作用。负电氨基酸会与磷酸相斥；磷酸骨架高度亲水，不参与疏水结合；半胱氨酸也不与磷酸成共价键。
quiz.explain_en: Arginine, lysine and histidine are positively charged at physiological pH and form multi-point ionic contacts with the negatively charged phosphate on every nucleotide. Negatively charged residues would be repelled; the phosphate backbone is highly hydrophilic and does not drive hydrophobic binding; and cysteine forms no covalent bond with phosphate.

quiz.q_zh: 针对纯化出的蛋白带有核酸，最有效的处理是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the most effective way to deal with nucleic acid carried through a purification?

options.zh: 把缓冲液的盐浓度降低后重新上柱
options.en: lower the salt in the buffer and rerun the column

options.zh: 在细胞裂解一开始就加入 Benzonase
options.en: add Benzonase right at the start of cell lysis

options.zh: 在纯化完成之后再加入 Benzonase
options.en: add Benzonase once the purification is finished

options.zh: 把纯化后的样品在室温放置过夜
options.en: leave the purified sample at room temperature overnight

quiz.explain_zh: 核酸必须在还没有和蛋白缠紧之前就被切碎，所以核酸酶要在裂解液里就加。纯化后再加，酶接触不到缠绕的核酸，切断了也难分离；室温过夜只会让蛋白降解；降低盐浓度反而加强离子相互作用，把核酸绑得更牢。
quiz.explain_en: The nucleic acid has to be chopped up before it winds tightly onto the protein, so the nuclease belongs in the lysis buffer. Added afterwards it cannot reach the wound-on strands, and cutting them does not release them; leaving the sample warm overnight only degrades the protein; and lowering the salt strengthens the ionic interaction, binding the nucleic acid still more tightly.

title_zh: 【实验室讨论·可跳过】裂解液里的核酸污染与 benzonase、lysozyme
title_en: [Lab digression - skippable] Nucleic-acid contamination in the lysate: benzonase and lysozyme

points.zh: 大肠杆菌 (E. coli) 表达的蛋白如果已经带着核酸出来，与其费力把核酸从蛋白上剥掉，不如直接重新纯化一批——省下的时间和蛋白损失更划算。
points.en: If a protein purified from E. coli comes out carrying nucleic acid, it is usually cheaper to re-purify a fresh batch than to strip the nucleic acid off, once you count the time and the protein you lose.

points.zh: 正确做法是预防：在裂解 (lysis) 这一步就往裂解液里加 DNase / RNase，或者加一种通用核酸酶，国内叫「超级核酸酶」，商品名 benzonase。
points.en: The fix is prevention: add DNase/RNase at the lysis step, or a universal nuclease - what is sold in China as 超级核酸酶, trade name benzonase.

points.zh: 课上查到的规格是 100 U/µL，用量大约是每 100 mL 裂解液加 1 µL 这个量级就够。
points.en: The stock they looked up on the spot is 100 U/uL, and roughly 1 uL per 100 mL of lysate is enough.

points.zh: 为什么核酸会牢牢跟着目标蛋白走：这个蛋白酶表面正电荷氨基酸多——lysine、arginine（还有 histidine）——而核酸骨架是带负电的磷酸基团，静电相互作用很强。
points.en: Why the nucleic acid follows the protein: this protease has a surface rich in positively charged residues - lysine, arginine (and histidine) - while the nucleic-acid backbone is negatively charged phosphate, so the electrostatic binding is strong.

points.zh: 溶菌酶 (lysozyme) 是在同一步加的：收菌到 EP 管底、往里加裂解液的时候，把 lysozyme 一起加进去破壁。
points.en: Lysozyme goes in at the same step: after pelleting the cells, it is added together with the lysis buffer to break the cell wall.

points.zh: 另一类「纯化好的酶用着用着不管用了」的原因是保存问题：没加甘油 (glycerol)、或者反复冻融 (freeze-thaw)。
points.en: A separate reason a purified enzyme "stops working" is storage: no glycerol added, or repeated freeze-thaw cycles.

points.zh: 老师强调这是自己亲手纯化这个酶时踩过的坑，属于很 particular 的实操知识，而不是课本内容。
points.en: The teacher stresses this is a pothole he hit purifying this very enzyme himself - very particular hands-on knowledge, not textbook material.

extra.zh: 判断蛋白纯度的紫外比值要记对方向：纯蛋白的 A260/A280 ≈ 0.57–0.6，也就是 A280/A260 ≈ 1.7–1.8；纯核酸的 A260/A280 ≈ 1.8–2.0。A260/A280 往上爬才是核酸污染的信号。
extra.en: Get the direction of the UV ratio right: pure protein has A260/A280 ~ 0.57-0.6, i.e. A280/A260 ~ 1.7-1.8; pure nucleic acid has A260/A280 ~ 1.8-2.0. A rising A260/A280 is the signal of nucleic-acid contamination.

extra.zh: benzonase 来自 Serratia marcescens，是非特异性核酸内切酶 (endonuclease)，DNA/RNA、单链双链通吃，把核酸切成 3–5 nt 的小片段，需要 Mg²⁺ 作辅因子。它的直接好处除了去污染，还有让黏稠的裂解液变稀，离心时上清好取。
extra.en: Benzonase comes from Serratia marcescens: a non-specific endonuclease that digests DNA and RNA, single- and double-stranded alike, down to 3-5 nt fragments, with Mg2+ as cofactor. Besides removing contamination it drops the viscosity of the lysate so the supernatant can actually be pipetted.

extra.zh: lysozyme 和 benzonase 在同一管里加，但打的靶完全不同：lysozyme 水解肽聚糖 (peptidoglycan) 中 NAM–NAG 之间的 β-1,4 糖苷键，是破壁；benzonase 降解核酸，是去污染。
extra.en: Lysozyme and benzonase go into the same tube but hit different targets: lysozyme hydrolyses the beta-1,4 glycosidic bond between NAM and NAG in peptidoglycan (cell-wall lysis), while benzonase degrades nucleic acid (decontamination).

quiz.q_zh: 纯化时核酸紧紧跟着目标蛋白走，主要原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why does nucleic acid stay bound to the target protein during purification?

options.zh: 蛋白疏水口袋与碱基发生堆积作用
options.en: Hydrophobic pockets stack against the bases

options.zh: 蛋白表面正电荷残基结合磷酸骨架
options.en: Positive surface residues bind the phosphate backbone

options.zh: 蛋白二硫键与核酸糖环形成共价键
options.en: Disulfide bonds form covalent links to the sugars

options.zh: 蛋白的金属中心与碱基发生配位结合
options.en: A metal centre coordinates directly to the bases

quiz.explain_zh: 该蛋白酶表面 lysine、arginine 等正电荷残基多，核酸骨架是带负电的磷酸基团，靠离子相互作用强结合。碱基堆积、共价成键、金属配位都不是这里的主要作用力。
quiz.explain_en: The protease surface is rich in lysine and arginine, and the nucleic-acid backbone is negatively charged phosphate, so the two are held by ionic interaction. Base stacking, covalent bonding and metal coordination are not the operative force here.

quiz.q_zh: benzonase（超级核酸酶）应该在哪一步加入？
quiz.q_en: At which step should benzonase ("super nuclease") be added?

options.zh: 收菌后加裂解液时一并加入
options.en: With the lysis buffer, right after pelleting

options.zh: 亲和柱洗脱之后加到洗脱液
options.en: Into the eluate after affinity elution

options.zh: 电泳上样前加到样品缓冲液
options.en: Into the sample buffer before running a gel

options.zh: 冻存之前加到甘油保存液中
options.en: Into the glycerol stock before freezing

quiz.explain_zh: 核酸污染要在裂解这一步预防，和 lysozyme 一起加进裂解液；等蛋白已经洗脱下来再补酶，核酸早就跟着蛋白过完柱子了。上样缓冲液和冻存液里加都无法解决纯化过程中的共纯化问题。
quiz.explain_en: Contamination is prevented at lysis, where the nuclease goes in alongside lysozyme. Adding it after elution is too late - the nucleic acid has already co-purified through the column - and adding it to gel-loading or storage buffer does nothing about co-purification.

quiz.q_zh: 一批纯化好的酶放了一段时间活性明显下降，最可能的原因是？
quiz.q_en: A purified enzyme loses much of its activity in storage. Most likely cause?

options.zh: 缓冲液里咪唑浓度偏低
options.en: The imidazole concentration was too low

options.zh: 没加甘油且反复冻融
options.en: No glycerol plus repeated freeze-thaw

options.zh: 裂解时核酸酶加得过量
options.en: Too much nuclease was added at lysis

options.zh: 洗脱时氯化钠浓度过高
options.en: The elution NaCl concentration was too high

quiz.explain_zh: 保存条件是最常见的失活原因：甘油抑制冰晶形成、反复冻融会让蛋白部分变性聚集。咪唑浓度只影响柱上结合与洗脱，核酸酶过量和高盐洗脱都不会造成长期保存中的活性衰减。
quiz.explain_en: Storage is the usual culprit: glycerol suppresses ice-crystal damage, and repeated freeze-thaw partially denatures and aggregates the protein. Imidazole only matters for binding and elution on the column, and neither excess nuclease nor high-salt elution explains a slow loss during storage.

title_zh: 【实验室讨论·可跳过】镍柱纯化的裂解液配方：50 mM HEPES、500 mM NaCl、pH 8
title_en: [Lab digression - skippable] The Ni-column lysis buffer: 50 mM HEPES, 500 mM NaCl, pH 8

points.zh: 老师给出的裂解液主干：50 mM 缓冲盐 + 500 mM NaCl + pH 8，他自己「配过一百遍」，protocol 张口就来。
points.en: The backbone of his lysis buffer: 50 mM buffering salt + 500 mM NaCl at pH 8 - a protocol he says he has made up a hundred times.

points.zh: 缓冲盐推荐 HEPES 而不是 TRIS：用镍 (Ni) 亲和色谱纯 HIS 标签蛋白时，TRIS 对 HIS 标签的结合有一点干扰，HEPES 的干扰更小。
points.en: He recommends HEPES over TRIS: with Ni affinity chromatography of HIS-tagged protein, TRIS interferes somewhat with tag binding, HEPES less so.

points.zh: 为什么用高盐：NaCl 溶在水里天然就是离子对，属于离子相互作用；洗脱时高盐能把吸附在蛋白表面的核酸直接冲下来。
points.en: Why high salt: NaCl in water is simply an ion pair, i.e. an ionic interaction, and during elution the high salt strips the nucleic acid off the protein surface.

points.zh: 关键是时序：目标蛋白这时结合在树脂/柱子上，所以在梯度 imidazole 洗脱的过程中高盐可以把核酸洗掉，而蛋白留在柱上。
points.en: The timing is what makes it work: the target protein is held on the resin, so during the imidazole gradient elution the salt can wash the nucleic acid away while the protein stays bound.

points.zh: 洗脱用 imidazole 梯度洗脱 (gradient elution)，高盐与梯度洗脱是配合使用的。
points.en: Elution is an imidazole gradient, and the high salt works together with that gradient.

points.zh: pH 用 8：偏碱性条件下 HIS 标签蛋白与镍柱的结合能力更好。
points.en: pH 8: on the slightly alkaline side, HIS-tagged protein binds the nickel column better.

points.zh: 这一段是把上一段「核酸污染」问题的解决方案落到具体 buffer 上——加核酸酶是源头，高盐洗脱是补救。
points.en: This stretch turns the previous nucleic-acid problem into a concrete buffer: nuclease at lysis is the source control, high-salt elution is the rescue.

extra.zh: pH 8 的道理在 histidine 侧链：imidazole 的 pKa ≈ 6.0，pH 8 时基本去质子化，氮上的孤对电子才能配位 Ni²⁺；反过来把 pH 降到 4–5 就能靠质子化把 HIS 标签蛋白洗下来，这是 imidazole 之外的另一种洗脱方式。
extra.en: The reason for pH 8 lies in the histidine side chain: the imidazole pKa is about 6.0, so at pH 8 it is largely deprotonated and its nitrogen lone pair can coordinate Ni2+. Conversely, dropping to pH 4-5 protonates it and elutes the HIS-tagged protein - the alternative to imidazole elution.

extra.zh: TRIS 的问题在于它本身是伯胺，能与固定相上的镍离子发生竞争性配位。更硬的禁忌是螯合剂 EDTA 和强还原剂 DTT——它们会把镍从柱上剥下来，需要还原环境时改用低浓度 β-巯基乙醇或 TCEP。
extra.en: The trouble with TRIS is that it is a primary amine and can compete for the immobilised nickel. The harder prohibition is chelators (EDTA) and strong reductants (DTT), which strip nickel off the resin; if a reducing environment is needed, use low-concentration beta-mercaptoethanol or TCEP instead.

extra.zh: 高盐 (0.3–0.5 M NaCl) 还有第二个作用：压制杂蛋白与柱基质、与目标蛋白之间的非特异离子交换结合，降低背景。配套的 imidazole 用法是上样/洗杂用低浓度（十几到几十 mM），洗脱用高浓度（数百 mM）。
extra.en: High salt (0.3-0.5 M NaCl) has a second job: suppressing non-specific ion-exchange binding of contaminants to the resin and to the target, lowering background. The matching imidazole scheme is a low concentration (tens of mM) for loading and washing, a high one (hundreds of mM) for elution.

quiz.q_zh: 镍柱纯化 HIS 标签蛋白时为什么推荐 HEPES 而非 TRIS？
quiz.q_en: Why HEPES rather than TRIS for Ni-affinity purification of a HIS-tagged protein?

options.zh: TRIS 会水解掉蛋白上的 HIS 标签
options.en: TRIS hydrolyses the HIS tag off the protein

options.zh: TRIS 会干扰 HIS 标签与镍的结合
options.en: TRIS interferes with HIS-tag binding to nickel

options.zh: TRIS 会阻止咪唑把蛋白洗脱下来
options.en: TRIS prevents imidazole from eluting the protein

options.zh: TRIS 在 pH 8 附近没有缓冲能力
options.en: TRIS has no buffering capacity near pH 8

quiz.explain_zh: TRIS 是伯胺，会与固定的镍离子竞争配位，对 HIS 标签的结合有干扰，HEPES 干扰小。TRIS 的 pKa 约 8.1，在 pH 8 恰恰缓冲能力很好；它既不切标签，也不妨碍咪唑洗脱。
quiz.explain_en: TRIS is a primary amine that competes for the immobilised nickel and so interferes with tag binding; HEPES interferes less. TRIS actually buffers well at pH 8 (pKa about 8.1), and it neither cleaves the tag nor blocks imidazole elution.

quiz.q_zh: 裂解液和洗脱液用 500 mM NaCl 的直接目的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the direct purpose of 500 mM NaCl in the lysis and elution buffers?

options.zh: 增强 HIS 标签与镍离子的配位
options.en: To strengthen coordination of the tag to nickel

options.zh: 降低缓冲液 pH 以便蛋白洗脱
options.en: To lower the buffer pH so the protein elutes

options.zh: 为核酸酶提供必需的镁离子
options.en: To supply the magnesium the nuclease requires

options.zh: 洗脱时把蛋白表面的核酸冲下来
options.en: To strip nucleic acid off the protein during elution

quiz.explain_zh: 蛋白结合在树脂上时，高盐破坏核酸磷酸骨架与蛋白表面正电荷之间的离子相互作用，把核酸冲走。高盐并不增强配位（反而略微削弱非特异结合），也不改变 pH，镁离子要另外加。
