quiz.explain_en: With the protein held on the resin, high salt breaks the ionic interaction between the phosphate backbone and the positive protein surface and washes the nucleic acid away. Salt does not strengthen the nickel coordination, does not change pH, and magnesium must be supplied separately.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪种成分绝不能加进镍柱纯化用的裂解液？
quiz.q_en: Which component must never go into a lysis buffer for Ni-affinity purification?

options.zh: 500 毫摩尔的氯化钠
options.en: 500 mM sodium chloride

options.zh: 10 毫摩尔的咪唑
options.en: 10 mM imidazole

options.zh: 5 毫摩尔的 EDTA
options.en: 5 mM EDTA

options.zh: 5% 体积比的甘油
options.en: 5% (v/v) glycerol

quiz.explain_zh: EDTA 是螯合剂，会把固定相上的 Ni²⁺ 直接夺走，柱子当场报废。高盐、低浓度咪唑（压背景）和甘油（稳定蛋白）都是标准配方成分。
quiz.explain_en: EDTA is a chelator: it strips the immobilised Ni2+ straight off the resin and ruins the column. High salt, a low imidazole concentration (to suppress background) and glycerol (to stabilise the protein) are all standard ingredients.

title_zh: 【实验室讨论·可跳过】为什么选 SUMO 标签：无痕切除 vs TEV 留下的甘氨酸
title_en: [Lab digression - skippable] Why the SUMO tag: scarless cleavage vs the glycine TEV leaves behind

points.zh: 老师课上说 SUMO 标签「有 20 kDa，不小」——这个数字不对，见 extra。
points.en: In the lecture the SUMO tag is quoted as "20 kDa, not small" - the number is wrong, see extra.

points.zh: SUMO 标签的第一个好处是促溶：它比六个组氨酸 (6×His) 更能帮助目标蛋白正确折叠、可溶表达。
points.en: The first advantage of the SUMO tag is solubility: it helps the target fold and stay soluble far better than a plain six-histidine tag.

points.zh: SUMO 独一无二的优势是「完全光滑的切除」：SUMO protease 切完不会在目标蛋白上残留任何多余氨基酸，得到天然 N 端。
points.en: Its unique advantage is scarless removal: the SUMO protease leaves no extra residue on the target, giving the native N-terminus.

points.zh: 对照的是 TEV 酶（老师把 TEV 展开成「烟草花叶病毒」，说法有误，见 extra）：它的识别标签序列只有 7 个氨基酸。
points.en: The comparison is the TEV protease (which the lecture glosses as tobacco mosaic virus - incorrect, see extra): its recognition site is only seven amino acids long.

points.zh: TEV 切完会在蛋白上多留一个甘氨酸 (glycine)，这就是它和 SUMO 的关键差别。
points.en: TEV cleavage leaves one extra glycine on the protein, and that is the key difference from SUMO.

points.zh: 为什么在意这一个残基：冲正刊或做结构时，审稿人会问「你的蛋白不是完全天然的，你怎么证明这个多出来的甘氨酸不影响构象和功能、不是它让蛋白有活性的？」——这个你没法证明。
points.en: Why one residue matters: for a top-journal paper or a structure, a referee will ask how you can prove the extra glycine does not perturb the conformation or the function - that the activity is the protein's and not the glycine's. You cannot.

points.zh: 怎么知道哪个酶切得干净：切完从 N 端开始测序 (N-terminal sequencing)，看有没有残留氨基酸。
points.en: How you know which protease cuts cleanly: sequence from the N-terminus after cleavage and look for leftover residues.

extra.zh: SUMO 标签不是 20 kDa，而是约 11 kDa（约 100 个氨基酸）。可能的混淆来源是 SUMO protease（Ulp1 催化结构域）本身要大得多，而 20 kDa 那个数量级更接近某些融合表达用的大标签（如 GST 26 kDa、MBP 42 kDa）。
extra.en: The SUMO tag is not 20 kDa but about 11 kDa (roughly 100 residues). The likely source of confusion is that the SUMO protease (Ulp1 catalytic domain) is itself much bigger; 20 kDa is closer to the large fusion tags such as GST (26 kDa) or MBP (42 kDa).

extra.zh: TEV 是 tobacco etch virus，中文烟草蚀纹病毒；烟草花叶病毒是 TMV，另一种病毒。TEV protease 识别 ENLYFQ↓G(或 S)，切在 Q 和 G 之间，所以产物 N 端多出那个甘氨酸。
extra.en: TEV is tobacco etch virus; tobacco mosaic virus is TMV, a different virus. The TEV protease recognises ENLYFQ-down arrow-G (or S) and cuts between Q and G, which is exactly why the product keeps that extra glycine at its N-terminus.

extra.zh: SUMO protease（Ulp1/SENP）识别的不是一段线性序列，而是 SUMO 的三维折叠，切点严格在 SUMO C 端 Gly-Gly 之后——这正是「无痕」的机制。代价：若目标蛋白 N 端第一个残基是脯氨酸 (proline)，切割效率会大幅下降。
extra.en: The SUMO protease (Ulp1/SENP) recognises the three-dimensional fold of SUMO, not a linear sequence, and cuts strictly after the C-terminal Gly-Gly - that is the mechanism of the scarless cut. The price: if the target's first residue is a proline, cleavage becomes very inefficient.

extra.zh: 作为纯化标签的 SUMO tag，和细胞内的 SUMO 化修饰 (SUMOylation) 是两件事：前者是人为融合在 N 端的一段蛋白，后者是通过异肽键接到底物 lysine 上的翻译后修饰。它们用的是同一个蛋白，用途完全不同。
extra.en: The SUMO purification tag and cellular SUMOylation are two different things: the former is a protein segment deliberately fused at the N-terminus, the latter a post-translational modification attached through an isopeptide bond to a substrate lysine. Same protein, entirely different use.

quiz.q_zh: 相比 TEV 蛋白酶，SUMO protease 去标签最大的优势是什么？
quiz.q_en: Compared with TEV protease, what is the chief advantage of the SUMO protease for tag removal?

options.zh: 切割速度比 TEV 快十倍以上
options.en: It cleaves more than ten times faster than TEV

options.zh: 切除后不残留任何多余氨基酸
options.en: It leaves no extra amino acid on the product

options.zh: 可以在完全变性的条件下切割
options.en: It works under fully denaturing conditions

options.zh: 识别的线性序列比 TEV 短得多
options.en: Its linear recognition site is far shorter

quiz.explain_zh: SUMO protease 严格切在 SUMO C 端 Gly-Gly 之后，得到天然 N 端，这是「无痕」的关键。它并不需要变性条件（恰恰相反，它识别 SUMO 的三维折叠，蛋白变性就切不动），也没有更短的线性识别序列。
quiz.explain_en: The SUMO protease cuts strictly after the C-terminal Gly-Gly, giving a native N-terminus - that is what "scarless" means. It does not need denaturing conditions (the opposite: it reads the folded SUMO domain, so denaturation abolishes cleavage), and it has no shorter linear site.

quiz.q_zh: TEV 蛋白酶切割后，目标蛋白 N 端会留下什么？
quiz.q_en: After TEV cleavage, what remains at the N-terminus of the target protein?

options.zh: 一个多余的半胱氨酸 (cysteine)
options.en: One extra cysteine residue

options.zh: 一个多余的甘氨酸 (glycine)
options.en: One extra glycine residue

options.zh: 没有任何多余的氨基酸残基
options.en: No extra amino acid residue at all

options.zh: 完整的七个氨基酸识别序列
options.en: The complete seven-residue recognition site

quiz.explain_zh: TEV 识别 ENLYFQ↓G，切在 Q 与 G 之间，前六个残基随标签走掉，甘氨酸留在目标蛋白这一侧。「不留残基」是 SUMO 的特点，不是 TEV 的。
quiz.explain_en: TEV recognises ENLYFQ-down arrow-G and cuts between Q and G: the first six residues leave with the tag and the glycine stays on the target. Leaving nothing behind is SUMO's property, not TEV's.

quiz.q_zh: TEV 蛋白酶的 TEV 全称是哪种病毒？
quiz.q_en: Which virus does the "TEV" in TEV protease stand for?

options.zh: 烟草蚀纹病毒 tobacco etch virus
options.en: Tobacco etch virus

options.zh: 烟草花叶病毒 tobacco mosaic virus
options.en: Tobacco mosaic virus

options.zh: 烟草坏死病毒 tobacco necrosis virus
options.en: Tobacco necrosis virus

options.zh: 烟草环斑病毒 tobacco ringspot virus
options.en: Tobacco ringspot virus

quiz.explain_zh: TEV = tobacco etch virus，烟草蚀纹病毒，其 NIa 蛋白酶就是实验室常用的 TEV protease。烟草花叶病毒的缩写是 TMV，是完全不同的病毒，课上把两者说混了。
quiz.explain_en: TEV is tobacco etch virus, whose NIa protease is the enzyme used in the lab. Tobacco mosaic virus abbreviates to TMV and is an entirely different virus; the lecture conflated the two.

title_zh: 【穿插】非特异蛋白酶、KRAS 作为反竞争抑制剂实例、泛素化与 SUMO 化
title_en: [Interlude] Non-specific proteases, KRAS as the uncompetitive example, ubiquitylation and SUMOylation

points.zh: 与 TEV/SUMO 这种位点严格的酶相对，胰蛋白酶 (trypsin)、木瓜蛋白酶 (papain) 被老师归为「非特异性」的蛋白酶，切出来「毫无章法」。
points.en: Set against site-strict enzymes like TEV and SUMO protease, the teacher groups trypsin and papain as "non-specific" proteases whose cuts follow no pattern.

points.zh: 老师顺势预告：紧接着这一章就要讲丝氨酸蛋白酶 (serine protease)，学生的提问正好撞上了教材的下一节。
points.en: He flags that serine proteases are the very next item in the chapter - the student's question landed on what the text was about to say.

points.zh: 回头补讲反竞争性抑制剂 (uncompetitive inhibitor) 为什么叫这个名字，举的例子是 KRAS，他认为这是最典型的一个。
points.en: He then circles back to explain the name "uncompetitive inhibitor", using KRAS as what he calls the most typical case.

points.zh: 机制图景：酶先与天然底物结合，结合后构象变化产生一个额外的口袋 (pocket)，抑制剂才有地方结合进去——所以它只作用于 ES 复合物，不结合游离酶。
points.en: The picture: the enzyme binds its natural substrate first, the resulting conformational change opens an extra pocket, and only then can the inhibitor bind - so it acts on the ES complex, never on free enzyme.

points.zh: SUMO 的来历：它其实是一类「类泛素化」修饰，SUMO modification 是 reversible 的过程，由特定的酶催化，也能在信号通路里发挥作用。
points.en: Where SUMO comes from: it is a ubiquitin-like modification, SUMO modification is a reversible process carried out by dedicated enzymes, and it also functions in signalling pathways.

points.zh: 泛素 (ubiquitin, Ub) 因为在各种生物体内普遍存在而得名「泛素」；老师做烟草时用过 ubiquitin promoter（因表达广泛而常被拿来当组成型强启动子）。
points.en: Ubiquitin is named for being ubiquitous across organisms; the teacher used a ubiquitin promoter in his tobacco work, precisely because it is expressed everywhere and so serves as a strong constitutive promoter.

points.zh: 课上讲的泛素化级联：E1 先给蛋白上很多泛素，E2 负责连接识别，E3「是个降解酶」，把连上多聚泛素的蛋白拖到溶酶体降解——后半句有两处错误，见 extra。
points.en: The cascade as told in class: E1 loads ubiquitin, E2 handles conjugation and recognition, and E3 "is a degrading enzyme" that drags the polyubiquitylated protein to the lysosome. The second half contains two errors, see extra.

extra.zh: E3 是泛素连接酶 (ubiquitin ligase)，它转移泛素、决定底物特异性，本身不降解任何东西。分工是：E1 活化酶（耗 ATP 形成 Ub-E1 硫酯键）、E2 结合酶（携带泛素）、E3 连接酶（识别底物、催化泛素接到底物 lysine 的 ε-氨基上）。
extra.en: E3 is a ubiquitin ligase: it transfers ubiquitin and confers substrate specificity, and it degrades nothing. The division of labour is E1 activating enzyme (ATP-dependent thioester with Ub), E2 conjugating enzyme (carries the ubiquitin), E3 ligase (recognises the substrate and catalyses transfer onto a substrate lysine epsilon-amino group).

extra.zh: K48 连接的多聚泛素链把底物送到 26S 蛋白酶体 (proteasome)，不是溶酶体。溶酶体是自噬 (autophagy) 和内吞 (endocytosis) 途径的终点；单泛素化和 K63 链更多是把膜蛋白送去内吞/溶酶体，或起非降解的信号作用。
extra.en: A K48-linked polyubiquitin chain delivers the substrate to the 26S proteasome, not the lysosome. The lysosome is the endpoint of the autophagy and endocytic routes; mono-ubiquitylation and K63 chains more often route membrane proteins to endocytosis/lysosome or carry non-degradative signals.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: KRAS 结合的核苷酸是 GTP/GDP（它是一个 GTPase），不是 ATP。临床上的 KRAS G12C 抑制剂结合的是 GDP 状态下才打开的 switch-II 口袋，并与 Cys12 形成共价键，属于不可逆共价抑制剂。拿它做「底物结合后才出现额外口袋」的直观例子可以，但不要当成教科书式的反竞争动力学案例。
extra.en: KRAS binds GTP/GDP - it is a GTPase - not ATP. The clinical KRAS G12C inhibitors bind a switch-II pocket that only opens in the GDP-bound state and form a covalent bond with Cys12, making them irreversible covalent inhibitors. It is a fine intuitive picture of "a pocket that appears only after nucleotide binding", but not a textbook case of uncompetitive kinetics.

extra.zh: trypsin 其实是高度特异的：它只切 lysine 和 arginine 之后的肽键（所以质谱鉴定才能预测肽段）。papain 才是宽特异性的。老师说的「非特异」是相对 TEV/SUMO 那种识别一整段序列或一个折叠的酶而言。
extra.en: Trypsin is in fact highly specific - it cuts only after lysine and arginine, which is why mass-spec identification can predict its peptides. Papain is the genuinely broad one. "Non-specific" here means relative to enzymes like TEV and SUMO protease that read a whole sequence or fold.

quiz.q_zh: 泛素化级联中 E3 的作用是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does E3 do in the ubiquitylation cascade?

options.zh: 作为水解酶把已连上的泛素链去掉
options.en: Hydrolase: removes ubiquitin chains already attached

options.zh: 作为活化酶消耗 ATP 活化泛素
options.en: Activating enzyme: activates ubiquitin using ATP

options.zh: 作为连接酶识别底物并转移泛素
options.en: Ligase: recognises the substrate and transfers ubiquitin

options.zh: 作为降解酶把标记的底物切碎
options.en: Degrading enzyme: chops up the marked substrate

quiz.explain_zh: E3 是泛素连接酶，决定哪个底物被泛素化，是特异性的来源。活化泛素是 E1 的工作，降解由 26S 蛋白酶体完成，去泛素化由 DUB（去泛素化酶）负责。
quiz.explain_en: E3 is the ubiquitin ligase: it decides which substrate gets ubiquitylated and is the source of specificity. Activating ubiquitin is E1's job, degradation is done by the 26S proteasome, and removal of chains is done by deubiquitinases.

quiz.q_zh: 被 K48 多聚泛素链标记的蛋白被送到哪里降解？
quiz.q_en: Where is a protein tagged with a K48-linked polyubiquitin chain degraded?

options.zh: 过氧化物酶体 (peroxisome)
options.en: The peroxisome

options.zh: 26S 蛋白酶体 (proteasome)
options.en: The 26S proteasome

options.zh: 线粒体基质 (matrix)
options.en: The mitochondrial matrix

options.zh: 溶酶体 (lysosome)
options.en: The lysosome

quiz.explain_zh: K48 链是送往 26S 蛋白酶体的经典降解信号，全过程在胞质中并消耗 ATP。溶酶体降解走的是自噬和内吞途径；过氧化物酶体和线粒体基质各有自己的蛋白酶体系，与泛素-蛋白酶体系统不是一回事。
quiz.explain_en: A K48 chain is the classic signal for the 26S proteasome, an ATP-dependent cytosolic process. Lysosomal degradation is reached through autophagy and endocytosis; the peroxisome and mitochondrial matrix have their own proteolytic systems unrelated to the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway.

quiz.q_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂 (uncompetitive inhibitor) 结合的对象是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does an uncompetitive inhibitor bind to?

options.zh: 只结合酶-底物 ES 复合物
options.en: Only the enzyme-substrate ES complex

options.zh: 只结合没有底物的游离酶
options.en: Only free enzyme without substrate

options.zh: 游离酶和 ES 复合物都结合
options.en: Both free enzyme and the ES complex

options.zh: 只结合没有反应的游离底物
options.en: Only free, unreacted substrate

quiz.explain_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂只结合 ES，所以 Km 和 Vmax 按同一个因子下降、双倒数作图呈平行线。只结合游离酶是竞争性抑制，两者都结合是经典非竞争性抑制，结合底物则根本不是酶抑制剂。
quiz.explain_en: An uncompetitive inhibitor binds only ES, which is why Km and Vmax fall by the same factor and the Lineweaver-Burk lines are parallel. Binding only free enzyme is competitive inhibition, binding both is classical non-competitive inhibition, and binding the substrate is not enzyme inhibition at all.

title_zh: 不可逆的非专一性抑制剂：有机磷与沙林、重金属、氰化物与 CO
title_en: Irreversible non-specific inhibitors: organophosphates and sarin, heavy metals, cyanide and CO

points.zh: 回到课本正题，抑制剂个论第一类是不可逆的非专一性抑制剂：「非专一」的意思是它不针对某一种特定的酶，对很多种酶都能起作用。
points.en: Back to the textbook: the first class is the irreversible, non-specific inhibitors - "non-specific" meaning they do not target one particular enzyme but act on many.

points.zh: 最经典的是含磷的一大类化合物，历史上有大量的杀伤性用途，代表是沙林毒气 (sarin)。
points.en: The classic group is the phosphorus-containing compounds, historically used as weapons, with sarin as the representative.

points.zh: 沙林带一个氟原子，很容易进攻蛋白的丝氨酸 (serine)，与丝氨酸的羟基形成非常牢固的结合，这是共价的、不可逆的。
points.en: Sarin carries a fluorine atom, readily attacks a protein serine, and forms a very firm bond with the serine hydroxyl - covalent, and irreversible.

points.zh: 很多农药也是以磷元素为主导的，所以农药对人毒性同样很大；现在的农药已经基本抛弃了有机磷类。
points.en: Many pesticides are likewise organophosphorus-based, which is why they are also very toxic to humans; modern pesticides have largely abandoned this class.

points.zh: 对人的关键靶点是胆碱酯酶 (cholinesterase)：它是一种丝氨酸酶，靠活性中心丝氨酸的羟基发挥催化活性，羟基被磷酰化后酶就废了。
points.en: The key human target is cholinesterase, a serine enzyme whose catalytic activity depends on the active-site serine hydroxyl; once that hydroxyl is phosphorylated the enzyme is dead.

points.zh: 另一大类广谱抑制剂是重金属盐、有机汞 (mercury)、砷 (arsenic)：它们本质上是蛋白变性剂，能把酶变性，所以既广谱又不可逆。
points.en: The other broad class is heavy-metal salts, organic mercury and arsenic: essentially protein denaturants, so they inactivate enzymes broadly and irreversibly.

points.zh: 氰化物 (cyanide，苦杏仁味) 和一氧化碳 (CO) 与血红蛋白、肌红蛋白中的铁卟啉 (heme iron) 结合，亲和力很强，因此也是不可逆的；两种蛋白都含铁卟啉，差别在一级结构。
points.en: Cyanide (the bitter-almond smell) and carbon monoxide bind the heme iron of haemoglobin and myoglobin with very high affinity, hence irreversibly; both proteins carry a heme, and differ in their primary structure.

points.zh: 亚硝酸盐 (nitrite) 被明确排除在外：它主要不是抑制酶，而是直接在基因层面起作用（与 DNA/RNA 形成异常配对），属于致癌机理。
points.en: Nitrite is explicitly set apart: it does not mainly inhibit enzymes but acts at the level of the genome (abnormal pairing with DNA/RNA), which is a carcinogenic mechanism.

extra.zh: 有机磷把乙酰胆碱酯酶 (AChE) 活性丝氨酸磷酰化 → 乙酰胆碱在突触堆积 → 胆碱能危象（瞳孔缩小、流涎、支气管痉挛、肌颤）。解毒是 atropine 拮抗受体 + 肟类（解磷定 2-PAM）重活化酶；但磷酰基一旦「老化 (aging)」脱去一个烷基，就再也不能重活化——这正是不可逆抑制随时间加深的教科书例子。
extra.en: Organophosphates phosphorylate the active-site serine of acetylcholinesterase, acetylcholine accumulates at synapses, and a cholinergic crisis follows (miosis, salivation, bronchospasm, fasciculation). Treatment is atropine at the receptor plus an oxime reactivator (pralidoxime); but once the phosphoryl adduct "ages" by losing an alkyl group, reactivation is impossible - a textbook case of irreversible inhibition deepening with time.

extra.zh: 氰化物真正的致死靶点不是血红蛋白，而是线粒体呼吸链复合物 IV（细胞色素 c 氧化酶）血红素中的 Fe³⁺，电子传递被卡住造成「组织内窒息」——静脉血因此变得鲜红。CO 则主要占据 hemoglobin 的氧结合位点，其亲和力约为 O₂ 的两百多倍，并使氧解离曲线左移，使剩余的氧更放不出来。
extra.en: Cyanide's lethal target is not haemoglobin but the Fe3+ of the heme in mitochondrial complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase); blocking electron transport causes histotoxic hypoxia, which is why venous blood turns bright red. CO instead occupies the oxygen site of haemoglobin with a couple of hundred times oxygen's affinity, and left-shifts the dissociation curve so the remaining oxygen is released even less readily.

extra.zh: 重金属/变性剂型的失活与竞争性、非竞争性、反竞争性那三类不在一个维度上：后者是可逆抑制，用 Km 和 Vmax 的变化描述，效力用 Ki；不可逆抑制降低的是有效酶浓度，效力用 kinact/KI 描述，双倒数图上表现得像非竞争性抑制。
extra.en: Denaturant-type inactivation by heavy metals is not on the same axis as competitive, non-competitive and uncompetitive inhibition: those are reversible, described by shifts in Km and Vmax with potency as Ki. Irreversible inhibition lowers the effective enzyme concentration, its potency is kinact/KI, and on a Lineweaver-Burk plot it mimics non-competitive inhibition.

extra.zh: 亚硝酸盐补两条：化学上它使碱基脱氨（C→U、A→次黄嘌呤），造成转换突变；在胃酸下还与胺生成 N-亚硝胺，是明确的致癌物。急性大量摄入的致死机制则是把血红蛋白的 Fe²⁺ 氧化为 Fe³⁺，形成高铁血红蛋白 (methemoglobin) 而不能载氧——这一点确实与「抑制酶」无关，老师的判断方向是对的。
extra.en: Two additions on nitrite: chemically it deaminates bases (C to U, A to hypoxanthine), producing transition mutations, and under stomach acid it forms N-nitrosamines with amines, established carcinogens. Acute lethal poisoning works differently again: it oxidises haemoglobin Fe2+ to Fe3+, giving methaemoglobin that cannot carry oxygen. Either way it is not enzyme inhibition, so the teacher's instinct was right.

quiz.q_zh: 沙林等有机磷化合物在人体内的主要作用靶点是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the main target of sarin and other organophosphates in humans?

options.zh: 血红蛋白亚基中的铁卟啉铁原子
options.en: The heme iron atom in haemoglobin subunits

options.zh: 胰蛋白酶活性中心的组氨酸咪唑
options.en: The active-site histidine imidazole of trypsin

options.zh: 碳酸酐酶活性中心的锌离子
options.en: The active-site zinc ion of carbonic anhydrase

options.zh: 胆碱酯酶活性中心的丝氨酸羟基
options.en: The active-site serine hydroxyl of cholinesterase

quiz.explain_zh: 有机磷带有易离去的基团（沙林是氟），磷原子被活性丝氨酸的羟基进攻后形成稳定的磷酰化酶，胆碱酯酶不可逆失活。铁卟啉是氰化物和 CO 的靶点，与有机磷无关。
quiz.explain_en: Organophosphates carry a good leaving group (fluorine in sarin); the active-site serine hydroxyl attacks the phosphorus and a stable phosphorylated enzyme results, inactivating cholinesterase irreversibly. Heme iron is the target of cyanide and CO, not of organophosphates.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项的毒性主要不是通过抑制酶实现的？
quiz.q_en: Which of these exerts its toxicity mainly by something other than enzyme inhibition?

options.zh: 亚硝酸盐（改变 DNA 的碱基）
options.en: Nitrite (chemically alters DNA bases)

options.zh: 氰化物（结合血红素的铁）
options.en: Cyanide (binds the iron of heme)

options.zh: 有机汞盐（使蛋白发生变性）
options.en: Organic mercury salt (denatures proteins)

options.zh: 有机磷（磷酰化活性丝氨酸）
options.en: Organophosphate (phosphorylates active serine)

quiz.explain_zh: 亚硝酸盐主要在基因层面起作用——使碱基脱氨、并生成 N-亚硝胺致癌，急性中毒则是形成高铁血红蛋白，都不是酶抑制。其余三项分别通过磷酰化、配位结合血红素铁和蛋白变性使酶失活。
quiz.explain_en: Nitrite acts at the level of the genome - deaminating bases and forming carcinogenic N-nitrosamines - while acute poisoning produces methaemoglobin; neither is enzyme inhibition. The other three inactivate enzymes by phosphorylation, coordination to heme iron and protein denaturation respectively.

quiz.q_zh: 重金属盐和有机汞、砷属于哪一类抑制剂？
quiz.q_en: Heavy-metal salts, organic mercury and arsenic belong to which class of inhibitor?

options.zh: 不可逆的专一性抑制剂
options.en: Irreversible specific inhibitors

options.zh: 不可逆的非专一性抑制剂
options.en: Irreversible non-specific inhibitors

options.zh: 可逆的竞争性抑制剂
options.en: Reversible competitive inhibitors

options.zh: 可逆的反竞争性抑制剂
options.en: Reversible uncompetitive inhibitors

quiz.explain_zh: 它们本质是蛋白变性剂，对多种酶都起作用且不能通过稀释或透析恢复，所以既是非专一性的也是不可逆的。专一性抑制剂指结合到某个酶活性中心的那一类，与它们的作用方式不同。
quiz.explain_en: They are essentially protein denaturants: they hit many enzymes and activity is not restored by dilution or dialysis, so they are both non-specific and irreversible. Specific inhibitors are those that bind the active site of one particular enzyme, which is a different mode of action.

title_zh: 专一性不可逆抑制剂、可逆抑制剂为主的药物，以及「最适温度不是特征常数」
title_en: Specific irreversible inhibitors, drugs as mostly reversible inhibitors, and why optimal temperature is not a characteristic constant

points.zh: 不可逆抑制剂里还有专一性的一类：它结合到某个酶的活性中心、活性口袋里去，只针对这个酶。
points.en: Among irreversible inhibitors there is also a specific class: it binds into the active site or active pocket of one particular enzyme.

points.zh: 课本把它再分成 Ks 型和 kcat 型，老师明确说不必理解——两者区别本来就不大，现在基本没人再提这个划分。
points.en: The textbook subdivides it into Ks-type and kcat-type; the teacher says explicitly not to bother - the distinction is small and essentially nobody raises it any more.

points.zh: 可逆性抑制剂是占比最大的一类：目前几乎所有治疗疾病的药物都是可逆抑制剂，只有一部分共价抑制剂是不可逆的。
points.en: Reversible inhibitors are by far the biggest group: nearly all therapeutic drugs today are reversible inhibitors, with only some covalent drugs being irreversible.

points.zh: 老师认为抑制剂的分类本身不很重要，重点是各类在动力学上的表现，前面的米氏方程部分才是核心。
points.en: He treats the taxonomy itself as not very important; what matters is how each class behaves kinetically, which the Michaelis-Menten section already covered.

points.zh: 接下来讲影响酶反应的因素，第一个是温度——温度当然很重要。
points.en: The lecture then turns to the factors that affect enzyme reactions, starting with temperature, which obviously matters.

points.zh: 但要划重点：温度不是酶的特征常数——任意一种酶的最适反应温度都不是它的特征常数。
points.en: But the point to underline: temperature is not a characteristic constant of an enzyme - no enzyme's optimal reaction temperature is one.

points.zh: 理由：同一种酶在不同底物、不同缓冲液条件下可以有不同的最适温度。老师说这一点比较反直觉，需要稍微理解一下。
points.en: The reason: the same enzyme can have different optima with different substrates and different buffers. He calls this counter-intuitive and worth a moment's thought.

extra.zh: 「不可逆共价抑制剂」在药物里有真实的经典例子：aspirin 乙酰化 COX 的 Ser530，penicillin 酰化转肽酶 (PBP) 的活性丝氨酸，omeprazole 与胃 H⁺/K⁺-ATPase 形成二硫键。它们的效力用 kinact/KI 而不是 Ki 衡量，停药后恢复靠的是新蛋白合成，而不是药物解离——这正是 aspirin 抑制血小板能持续整个血小板寿命的原因。
extra.en: Irreversible covalent drugs have real classic examples: aspirin acetylates Ser530 of COX, penicillin acylates the active serine of the transpeptidase (PBP), omeprazole forms a disulfide with the gastric H+/K+-ATPase. Their potency is measured as kinact/KI rather than Ki, and recovery after stopping the drug requires new protein synthesis rather than dissociation - which is exactly why aspirin's effect on a platelet lasts the platelet's whole lifetime.

extra.zh: 「特征常数」指只由酶（或酶-底物对）本身决定、可以用来鉴别这个酶的量，例如 Km、kcat、kcat/Km。最适温度和最适 pH 依赖于测定体系（底物、缓冲液、离子强度、保温时间），所以不算特征常数。注意 Km 也只在给定底物和给定条件下才是常数，这个前提不能丢。
extra.en: A "characteristic constant" is a quantity determined by the enzyme (or enzyme-substrate pair) alone and usable to identify it: Km, kcat, kcat/Km. Optimal temperature and optimal pH depend on the assay system - substrate, buffer, ionic strength, incubation time - so they do not qualify. Note that Km too is only constant for a given substrate under given conditions; that proviso must not be dropped.

extra.zh: 所谓「最适温度」是两个相反效应叠加的表观结果：升温按 Arrhenius 关系加快反应（常温附近大致每升高 10 °C 快 1.5–2 倍），同时也加速酶的热变性失活。因此测得的最适温度会随保温时间变短而升高——它是动力学与稳定性的折中，而不是一个热力学常数。
extra.en: The "optimum" is the apparent result of two opposing effects: heating speeds the reaction (Arrhenius; roughly 1.5-2 fold per 10 degrees C near room temperature) while also accelerating thermal denaturation. The measured optimum therefore rises as the assay is shortened - it is a compromise between kinetics and stability, not a thermodynamic constant.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么说最适温度不是酶的特征常数？
quiz.q_en: Why is the optimal temperature not a characteristic constant of an enzyme?

options.zh: 它对同一种酶无法测量出来
options.en: It cannot be measured for a given enzyme

options.zh: 它只对多亚基的酶才有意义
options.en: It is meaningful only for multi-subunit enzymes

options.zh: 它随底物和缓冲条件而改变
options.en: It changes with substrate and buffer conditions

options.zh: 它随酶的浓度而线性改变
options.en: It changes linearly with enzyme concentration

quiz.explain_zh: 同一种酶催化不同底物、在不同缓冲液里可以有不同的最适温度，它还随保温时间变化，因此依赖于测定体系而非只由酶决定。最适温度是完全可以测的，也与酶浓度和亚基数目没有这种关系。
quiz.explain_en: The same enzyme can show different optima with different substrates and buffers, and the value also shifts with assay duration, so it depends on the system rather than on the enzyme alone. It is perfectly measurable, and it bears no such relation to enzyme concentration or subunit count.

quiz.q_zh: 目前绝大多数治疗疾病的酶抑制剂药物属于哪一类？
quiz.q_en: Most therapeutic enzyme-inhibitor drugs today belong to which class?

options.zh: 广谱的重金属类抑制剂
options.en: Broad-spectrum heavy-metal inhibitors

options.zh: 不可逆的共价抑制剂
options.en: Irreversible covalent inhibitors

options.zh: 非专一性的蛋白变性剂
options.en: Non-specific protein denaturants

options.zh: 可逆性的酶活抑制剂
options.en: Reversible enzyme inhibitors

quiz.explain_zh: 绝大多数药物是可逆抑制剂，作用可以随血药浓度下降而解除，安全性更可控；共价不可逆抑制剂只占一部分（如 aspirin、penicillin）。变性剂和重金属没有选择性，不能作药。
quiz.explain_en: The great majority of drugs are reversible inhibitors, whose effect wears off as plasma concentration falls, which is easier to control safely; covalent irreversible drugs (aspirin, penicillin) are the minority. Denaturants and heavy metals have no selectivity and cannot be drugs.

quiz.q_zh: 专一性的不可逆抑制剂结合在酶的什么部位？
quiz.q_en: Where does a specific irreversible inhibitor bind on the enzyme?

options.zh: 底物分子上的反应性基团
options.en: A reactive group on the substrate molecule

options.zh: 酶表面的变构调节位点
options.en: An allosteric site on the enzyme surface

options.zh: 酶的活性中心活性口袋
options.en: The active site pocket of the enzyme

options.zh: 酶疏水核心的内部区域
options.en: The interior of the hydrophobic core

quiz.explain_zh: 「专一性」正是因为它结合到某个酶的活性中心口袋，再共价修饰催化残基，所以只对这个酶起作用。结合变构位点属于变构调节，疏水核心不可及，结合底物则不是酶抑制。
quiz.explain_en: It is called specific precisely because it enters the active-site pocket of one enzyme and then covalently modifies a catalytic residue. Binding an allosteric site is allosteric regulation, the hydrophobic core is inaccessible, and binding the substrate is not enzyme inhibition.

title_zh: 温度与 pH 的实证（含 KOD/Phusion 的 PCR 实操插叙）：pH 同样不是特征常数
title_en: Temperature and pH evidence (with a KOD/Phusion PCR digression): pH is not a characteristic constant either

points.zh: 用 PCR 酶来证明「最适温度不是特征常数」：KOD（日本公司的产品，贵但很强）和 Phusion 是两个竞争的高保真 (high fidelity) 聚合酶。
points.en: PCR enzymes are used to make the point that the optimum is not a constant: KOD (a Japanese product, expensive but excellent) and Phusion are two competing high-fidelity polymerases.

points.zh: 两者发挥的功能基本一样，但最适酶活温度就是不一样——延伸那一步一个大约 68 °C、一个大约 72 °C。
points.en: They do essentially the same job, yet their optimal working temperatures differ - the extension step is around 68 degrees C for one and around 72 degrees C for the other.

points.zh: 延伸速度很快：扩 500–600 bp 的片段，延伸给五秒都够，甚至两三秒。
points.en: Extension is fast: for a 500-600 bp fragment, five seconds of extension is plenty, sometimes two or three.

points.zh: 反直觉的是短模板更难扩：只有约 100 bp 的合成文库，退火 (annealing) 那一步要给到 40 秒左右。
points.en: Counter-intuitively the short templates are the hard ones: for a synthetic library of only about 100 bp, the annealing step is given around 40 seconds.

points.zh: 原因：KOD 需要一定长度的模板才能稳定结合并高效延伸，模板太短时它还没接上几个 nucleotide 就掉下来了，效率很低。
points.en: The reason: KOD needs a certain template length to bind stably and extend efficiently; on a very short template it falls off after adding only a few nucleotides.

points.zh: 代价与取舍：拉长退火时间确实会多出引物二聚体 (primer dimer)，但相比「到底能不能扩出来」，这个代价可以接受，产物质量另说。
points.en: The trade-off: a longer annealing step does produce more primer dimer, but next to the question of whether the product amplifies at all that cost is acceptable; product quality is a separate matter.

points.zh: pH 同样不是酶的特征常数：同一种酶催化不同底物、进行不同反应时，可以有不同的最适 pH。
points.en: pH likewise is not a characteristic constant: the same enzyme can have different optima for different substrates and different reactions.

points.zh: 极端例子是多功能酶：一个酶在酸性条件下发挥一种功能、在碱性条件下发挥另一种功能，于是可以有两个都算「最适」的 pH。
points.en: The extreme case is a multifunctional enzyme that performs one function under acidic and another under alkaline conditions, so two different pH values can both count as optimal.

points.zh: 小结：按米氏方程推断，影响酶促反应最主要的是底物浓度 [S] 和抑制剂；温度和 pH 有很大影响但不是决定性的，也不像纯化学反应那样「加温就一定变快」。
points.en: Summary: from the Michaelis-Menten treatment, the dominant factors are substrate concentration and inhibitors; temperature and pH matter a great deal but are not decisive, and an enzyme reaction does not simply speed up on heating the way a plain chemical reaction does.

extra.zh: KOD 和 Phusion 都是古菌来源的 B 家族 DNA 聚合酶，带 3'→5' 外切核酸酶的校对活性 (proofreading)，这就是「高保真」的分子基础。Taq 属 A 家族、没有校对活性，错误率高一个数量级以上，而且会在产物 3' 端多加一个 A（适合 TA 克隆）；高保真酶给的是平末端产物。
extra.en: KOD and Phusion are both archaeal family-B DNA polymerases with 3'-to-5' exonuclease proofreading, which is the molecular basis of "high fidelity". Taq is family A, has no proofreading, has an error rate more than an order of magnitude higher, and adds an extra 3' A to the product (convenient for TA cloning); high-fidelity enzymes give blunt ends.

extra.zh: pH 影响酶活的三条通路要分开记：(1) 活性中心催化基团的质子化状态（His 的咪唑、Asp/Glu 的羧基、Ser 的羟基是否能被去质子化）；(2) 底物本身的解离状态是否还能被识别；(3) 极端 pH 下酶的变性。前两条是可逆的，第三条不可逆——这也是为什么最适 pH 曲线通常是钟形。
extra.en: Keep the three routes by which pH acts separate: (1) the protonation state of catalytic groups in the active site (the His imidazole, Asp/Glu carboxylates, whether the Ser hydroxyl can be deprotonated); (2) the ionisation state of the substrate and whether it is still recognised; (3) denaturation at extreme pH. The first two are reversible, the third is not - which is why the pH-activity curve is typically bell-shaped.

extra.zh: 「最适 pH 不是特征常数」不等于「pH 不重要」。老师的意思是这个数值依赖于底物和体系，不能拿来鉴别一个酶。实际差别可以很大：pepsin 在胃里最适 pH 约 2，胰蛋白酶约 8，多数胞内酶在 pH 7 附近，这些都是在各自生理条件下测得的。
extra.en: "The pH optimum is not a characteristic constant" does not mean pH is unimportant. His point is that the number depends on substrate and system and cannot be used to identify an enzyme. The real spread is large: pepsin is optimal near pH 2 in the stomach, trypsin near 8, most intracellular enzymes near 7 - each measured under its own physiological conditions.

extra.zh: PCR 参数的实用关系：高保真酶的延伸速度通常在每 kb 十几到几十秒的量级（所以 500 bp 几秒就够是合理的），而退火时间的常规值只有 15–30 秒。100 bp 模板需要 40 秒退火并不是常规——它反映的是引物长度与模板长度相当时，引物-模板复合物太不稳定，延长退火是在用时间换结合概率。
extra.en: Useful PCR relationships: high-fidelity polymerases extend at the order of tens of seconds per kb (so a few seconds for 500 bp is reasonable), while a normal annealing step is only 15-30 seconds. The 40-second anneal for a 100 bp template is not routine - it reflects that when the primers are nearly as long as the template the primer-template duplex is unstable, so time is being traded for binding probability.

quiz.q_zh: KOD 和 Phusion 的例子是用来说明什么的？
quiz.q_en: What point is the KOD versus Phusion comparison making?

options.zh: 延伸温度必须等于退火温度
options.en: Extension temperature must equal annealing

options.zh: 高保真酶一定比普通酶更快
options.en: High-fidelity enzymes are always faster

options.zh: 最适温度由酶的分子量决定
options.en: The optimum is set by molecular weight

options.zh: 功能相同的酶最适温度可不同
options.en: Enzymes with the same job can differ in optimum

quiz.explain_zh: 两个酶做的是同一件事（高保真扩增 DNA），但最适延伸温度分别在 68 °C 和 72 °C 附近，说明最适温度是酶各自的性质与体系条件的结果，不是这一类酶的通用常数。分子量和保真度都不决定最适温度。
quiz.explain_en: The two enzymes do the same job - high-fidelity DNA amplification - yet their optimal extension temperatures sit near 68 and 72 degrees C, showing the optimum reflects each enzyme and its conditions rather than a constant of the class. Neither molecular weight nor fidelity sets it.

quiz.q_zh: 扩增约 100 bp 的短模板时把退火时间延长到 40 秒，主要代价是什么？
quiz.q_en: Extending the anneal to 40 seconds for a 100 bp template mainly costs you what?

options.zh: 产生更多的引物二聚体
options.en: More primer dimer is produced

options.zh: 酶的校对活性被破坏掉
options.en: The proofreading activity is destroyed

options.zh: 模板发生不可逆的变性
options.en: The template is irreversibly denatured

options.zh: 产物的碱基错配率上升
options.en: The base misincorporation rate rises

quiz.explain_zh: 退火时间长，引物之间互相退火并被延伸的机会也变多，primer dimer 增加。这是老师明确接受的取舍：先保证扩得出来。校对活性和错误率由酶本身决定，模板在退火温度下不会变性。
quiz.explain_en: A longer anneal also gives primers more opportunity to anneal to each other and be extended, so primer dimer increases - the trade-off the teacher explicitly accepts in order to get any product at all. Proofreading and error rate are properties of the enzyme, and the template does not denature at annealing temperature.

quiz.q_zh: 根据米氏方程的推断，影响酶促反应速率最主要的因素是什么？
quiz.q_en: From the Michaelis-Menten treatment, which factors dominate the rate of an enzymatic reaction?

options.zh: 缓冲液种类和离子强度
options.en: Buffer species and ionic strength

options.zh: 反应温度和缓冲液 pH
options.en: Reaction temperature and buffer pH

options.zh: 底物浓度和抑制剂
options.en: Substrate concentration and inhibitors

options.zh: 酶的分子量和等电点
options.en: Enzyme molecular weight and isoelectric point

quiz.explain_zh: 米氏方程 v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) 把速率直接写成底物浓度的函数，抑制剂则通过改变表观 Km 或 Vmax 进入方程，这两者是决定性的。温度、pH、缓冲液成分影响很大但不是方程里的自变量，也不是酶的特征常数。
quiz.explain_en: The Michaelis-Menten equation v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]) makes rate an explicit function of substrate concentration, and inhibitors enter it by changing apparent Km or Vmax; these two are decisive. Temperature, pH and buffer composition matter a great deal but are not variables of the equation, nor characteristic constants of the enzyme.

title_zh: 温度、pH 的次要作用与反竞争性抑制剂实例
title_en: Temperature and pH as minor factors; an uncompetitive inhibitor example

points.zh: 温度和 pH 可以把酶活性从 10% 拉到 100%，但在人体内不是决定性因素——体温和体液 pH 都被稳定维持
points.en: Temperature and pH can swing activity from 10% to 100%, but inside the body they are not decisive: body temperature and fluid pH are held constant

points.zh: 按米氏方程，真正决定酶促反应速率的变量是底物浓度 [S] 和抑制剂 inhibitor
points.en: By the Michaelis-Menten equation the variables that actually set the rate are substrate concentration [S] and inhibitor

points.zh: 反竞争性抑制剂 uncompetitive inhibitor 只结合 ES complex，不结合游离酶 E
points.en: An uncompetitive inhibitor binds only the ES complex, never free enzyme E

points.zh: 课上实例是一个激酶 kinase：底物 ATP（碱基 + 核糖 + 磷酸）先结合到活性中心
points.en: The lecture example is a kinase: the substrate ATP (base + ribose + phosphates) binds the active site first

points.zh: ATP 结合后酶发生构象改变，旁边才「露出一个口子」，人工设计的抑制剂才贴得进去
points.en: ATP binding changes the conformation, which only then exposes an adjacent cleft into which the designed inhibitor can slot

points.zh: 所以这类抑制剂的结合位点在 ES 形成之后才存在，这是构象变化 conformational change 的直接后果
points.en: So this inhibitor's binding site exists only after ES has formed, a direct consequence of the conformational change

points.zh: 反竞争性抑制使 Km 下降、Vmax 也下降，表观上提高了酶对天然底物的亲和力
points.en: Uncompetitive inhibition lowers both Km and Vmax, so the enzyme's apparent affinity for its natural substrate rises

points.zh: 该激酶在肿瘤组织中过量异常表达 overexpression，因此药物对肿瘤细胞影响最大，对正常细胞也有作用但较小
points.en: The kinase is abnormally overexpressed in tumour tissue, so the drug hits tumour cells hardest while still affecting normal cells

extra.zh: 反竞争性抑制中 Km 和 Vmax 被同一个因子 α' = 1 + [I]/Ki 除掉，因此 Vmax/Km 不变，双倒数图 Lineweaver-Burk 的斜率不变，加抑制剂后得到一组平行线。
extra.en: In uncompetitive inhibition both Km and Vmax are divided by the same factor α' = 1 + [I]/Ki, so Vmax/Km is unchanged, the Lineweaver-Burk slope is unchanged, and adding inhibitor gives a set of parallel lines.

extra.zh: 反竞争性抑制剂的效力随 [S] 升高而增强，因为底物越多、ES 越多、可结合的靶越多；竞争性抑制剂正相反，会被高浓度底物竞争掉。这才是它在底物通量高的组织里格外有效的严格理由。
extra.en: An uncompetitive inhibitor gets more potent as [S] rises, since more substrate means more ES and more target; a competitive inhibitor does the opposite and is outcompeted. That, rather than affinity talk, is the rigorous reason it works well where substrate flux is high.

extra.zh: 反竞争性 uncompetitive 与非竞争性 noncompetitive 只差一个字：前者只结合 ES，Km 和 Vmax 同降；后者 E 和 ES 都结合，Vmax 降而 Km 不变。中文名极易记反。
extra.en: Uncompetitive and noncompetitive differ by one syllable: the former binds only ES and lowers Km and Vmax together, the latter binds both E and ES and lowers Vmax with Km unchanged.

extra.zh: 经典药理实例是锂离子 lithium 对肌醇单磷酸酶 inositol monophosphatase 的反竞争性抑制，长期被用来解释锂盐的作用机制。
extra.en: The classic pharmacological case is lithium's uncompetitive inhibition of inositol monophosphatase, long invoked to explain how lithium salts act.

quiz.q_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂结合的对象是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does an uncompetitive inhibitor bind?

options.zh: 只结合游离的底物 S
options.en: Only free substrate S

options.zh: 只结合 ES 复合物
options.en: Only the ES complex

options.zh: 只结合游离的酶 E
options.en: Only free enzyme E

options.zh: 既结合 E 也结合 ES
options.en: Both free E and ES

quiz.explain_zh: 只结合 ES 是反竞争性抑制的定义。「只结合游离的酶 E」描述的是竞争性抑制，「既结合 E 也结合 ES」是非竞争性抑制，而结合底物本身的分子根本不作用于酶。
quiz.explain_en: Binding only ES is the definition of uncompetitive inhibition. Binding only free E describes competitive inhibition, binding both E and ES describes noncompetitive inhibition, and a molecule that binds the substrate itself does not act on the enzyme at all.

quiz.q_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂对动力学参数的影响是？
quiz.q_en: How does an uncompetitive inhibitor change the kinetic parameters?

options.zh: Km 不变而 Vmax 下降
options.en: Km is unchanged while Vmax falls

options.zh: Km 与 Vmax 同比例下降
options.en: Km and Vmax fall by the same factor

options.zh: Km 下降而 Vmax 升高
options.en: Km falls while Vmax rises

options.zh: Km 升高而 Vmax 不变
options.en: Km rises while Vmax is unchanged

quiz.explain_zh: 两者同被 α' = 1 + [I]/Ki 除掉，所以同比例下降、双倒数图平行。「Km 升高而 Vmax 不变」是竞争性抑制，「Km 不变而 Vmax 下降」是非竞争性抑制，而任何抑制剂都不会抬高 Vmax。
quiz.explain_en: Both are divided by α' = 1 + [I]/Ki, so they fall together and the double-reciprocal lines are parallel. Km rising with Vmax unchanged is competitive inhibition, Km unchanged with Vmax falling is noncompetitive, and no inhibitor raises Vmax.

quiz.q_zh: 课上的激酶实例中，抑制剂口袋出现的条件是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the kinase example, what makes the inhibitor pocket appear?

options.zh: 酶结合 ATP 后构象改变
options.en: The enzyme changes shape on binding ATP

options.zh: 酶被磷酸化修饰之后
options.en: The enzyme is phosphorylated first

options.zh: 酶从二聚体解离成单体
options.en: The enzyme dissociates into monomers

options.zh: 酶所处环境的 pH 降低
options.en: The pH around the enzyme drops

quiz.explain_zh: 口袋是 ATP 结合诱导的构象变化的产物，底物不结合口袋就不存在。磷酸化修饰、解离成单体、pH 下降都没有在这个例子中出现，也都不能解释「只抑制 ES」的动力学。
quiz.explain_en: The pocket is created by the conformational change ATP binding induces; without substrate it does not exist. Phosphorylation, dissociation into monomers and a pH drop play no part here and none would explain kinetics that target only ES.

title_zh: 酶的活性中心：小体积、三维实体
title_en: The enzyme active site: small and three-dimensional

points.zh: 酶与底物结合的部位（活性中心 active site）在整个酶分子里只占很小一块，课上给的估计是 1%–2%
points.en: The site that binds substrate (the active site) is a small piece of the whole enzyme; the lecture's estimate is 1-2%

points.zh: 其余绝大多数残基不直接催化，但负责折叠和把催化残基摆到正确的几何位置
points.en: The great majority of residues do not catalyse anything; they fold the protein and hold the catalytic residues in the right geometry

points.zh: 活性中心是一个三维实体 three-dimensional entity：由一级序列上相距很远的残基在空间上聚拢而成
points.en: The active site is a three-dimensional entity: residues far apart in the primary sequence are brought together in space

points.zh: 底物特异性来自空间互补，只有满足几何与化学条件的分子才被识别
points.en: Substrate specificity comes from spatial complementarity: only a molecule meeting the geometric and chemical conditions is recognised

points.zh: 活性中心通常是蛋白表面的一个裂隙 cleft/pocket，多为相对疏水的微环境，把体相水排除在外
points.en: The active site is usually a cleft or pocket on the surface, a relatively nonpolar microenvironment that excludes bulk water

points.zh: 教材中「研究酶的方法」一节写得笼统，课上判断背下来意义不大，可略过
points.en: The textbook section on methods for studying enzymes is judged too vague to be worth memorising and is skipped

points.zh: 研究活性中心真正重要的手段是定点诱变 site-directed mutagenesis
points.en: The method that matters for probing an active site is site-directed mutagenesis

extra.zh: 活性中心包含结合部位 binding site 与催化部位 catalytic site 两部分：前者决定特异性，后者决定催化速率。二者可以被突变分开——存在结合底物却不催化的突变体。
extra.en: The active site has a binding site and a catalytic site: the first sets specificity, the second sets rate. Mutation can separate them, giving variants that bind substrate but do not turn it over.

extra.zh: 1%–2% 是数量级估计，重点在于比例极小：一个几百残基的酶通常只有 2–5 个残基直接参与化学步骤，其余提供骨架与微环境。
extra.en: The 1-2% figure is an order-of-magnitude estimate; the point is how small the fraction is. An enzyme of a few hundred residues usually has only 2-5 residues doing the chemistry.

extra.zh: 活性中心 active site 与别构位点 allosteric site 不同：别构位点在空间上与活性中心分开，通过构象变化间接改变酶活，是调节位点而非催化位点。
extra.en: The active site is not the allosteric site: an allosteric site sits elsewhere on the protein and changes activity indirectly through conformation. It regulates, it does not catalyse.

quiz.q_zh: 说酶的活性中心是「三维实体」，含义是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does it mean that the active site is a three-dimensional entity?

options.zh: 只存在于三聚体酶的亚基界面
options.en: It exists only at trimeric subunit interfaces

options.zh: 序列上远离的残基在空间聚拢
options.en: Residues far apart in sequence meet in space

options.zh: 由连续排列的一段氨基酸构成
options.en: It is built from one continuous stretch of residues

options.zh: 必须由三条不同的肽链围成
options.en: It must be enclosed by three separate chains

quiz.explain_zh: 折叠把一级序列上相隔很远的残基带到同一个空间位置，这正是活性中心的定义。由一段连续氨基酸构成、必须三条肽链围成、只存在于三聚体界面，都不是酶活性中心的普遍性质。
quiz.explain_en: Folding brings residues that are distant in sequence into one place, which is exactly what the term means. A single continuous stretch, three separate chains, and trimeric interfaces are none of them general properties of active sites.

quiz.q_zh: 酶的活性中心通常处于什么样的微环境？
quiz.q_en: What sort of microenvironment is an active site usually in?

options.zh: 富含磷酸的强负电区域
options.en: A phosphate-rich negatively charged patch

options.zh: 嵌在膜脂中的跨膜区段
options.en: A transmembrane segment inside the lipid

options.zh: 排除体相水的疏水裂隙
options.en: A nonpolar cleft that excludes water

options.zh: 完全暴露的强亲水表面
options.en: A fully exposed hydrophilic surface

quiz.explain_zh: 裂隙状的疏水微环境把水排除在外，能显著改变残基的 pKa 和静电作用，这是催化的前提。完全暴露的亲水表面、富磷酸的负电区、跨膜区段都只见于个别酶，不是普遍规律。
quiz.explain_en: A water-excluding cleft shifts residue pKa values and electrostatics, which catalysis depends on. A fully exposed hydrophilic surface, a phosphate-rich patch and a transmembrane segment occur in particular enzymes but are not the general rule.

title_zh: 实验室话题：用竞争性抑制剂筛选高产菌株（工业发酵，非考点）
title_en: Lab talk: selecting high-yield strains with a competitive inhibitor (industrial fermentation, not exam material)

points.zh: 这一段是工业发酵的经验做法，不是课程要考的定义，听懂逻辑即可
points.en: This stretch is industrial fermentation practice rather than examinable definitions; follow the logic and move on

points.zh: 背景：我们吃的氨基酸主要靠微生物发酵法生产，工业上希望催化速率越快越好
points.en: Background: dietary amino acids are made mostly by microbial fermentation, and industry wants the catalytic step as fast as possible

points.zh: 宿主是工程微生物，课上举的例子是链霉菌 Streptomyces，也可以是大肠杆菌 E. coli
points.en: The host is an engineered microbe; the lecture names Streptomyces, and E. coli would do as well

points.zh: 做法：在培养体系中加入少量该酶的竞争性抑制剂，人为制造选择压力
points.en: The method: add a small amount of a competitive inhibitor of that enzyme to the culture, creating a selection pressure

points.zh: 抑制剂压低氨基酸产量，只有酶活更强或表达更高的个体还能长得好
points.en: The inhibitor depresses amino-acid output, so only cells with a stronger or more highly expressed enzyme still grow well

points.zh: 经过多轮传代，整个菌群被这些高活性变体取代，酶「自己进化」成更强的酶
points.en: Over successive passages the population is taken over by these variants, and the enzyme evolves into a better one on its own

points.zh: 前提是该酶由这株微生物自身基因组编码，而不是人工导入的外源蛋白
points.en: This works only if the enzyme is encoded by the microbe's own genome, not introduced as a foreign protein

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上把这套「加抑制剂再筛菌群」的做法叫做定点诱变。定点诱变 site-directed mutagenesis 指用带错配的引物做 PCR，把某个指定密码子改成指定的氨基酸——位点和替换都是事先决定的。课上描述的是随机突变加选择压力，标准名称是定向进化 directed evolution，在发酵工业里叫抗类似物筛选。
extra.en: The lecture calls this inhibitor-plus-selection scheme site-directed mutagenesis. Site-directed mutagenesis means using mismatched primers in PCR to change one named codon to one named amino acid, with both the position and the substitution decided in advance. What is described here is random mutation under selection, properly called directed evolution, or analogue-resistance screening in fermentation industry.

extra.zh: 工业上常用的选择压力其实是氨基酸类似物 amino-acid analogue（如用 AEC 筛赖氨酸高产株）：类似物冒充终产物触发反馈抑制 feedback inhibition，能长起来的突变体恰好是反馈抑制失灵、终产物过量合成的那些。
extra.en: The selection pressure actually used in industry is usually an amino-acid analogue (AEC for lysine overproducers, for instance): the analogue mimics the end product and triggers feedback inhibition, so the survivors are exactly the mutants whose feedback inhibition has been lost and which overproduce.

extra.zh: 真正的定点诱变经典流程是 Kunkel 法，或全质粒 PCR（QuikChange 型）后用 DpnI 消化甲基化的模板链，只留下含突变的新链。
extra.en: Real site-directed mutagenesis runs by the Kunkel method, or by whole-plasmid PCR (the QuikChange type) followed by DpnI digestion of the methylated template so only the newly synthesised mutant strand survives.

quiz.q_zh: 定点诱变 site-directed mutagenesis 的定义是什么？
quiz.q_en: What defines site-directed mutagenesis?

options.zh: 用抑制剂筛出高活性突变株
options.en: Screening out high-activity strains with an inhibitor

options.zh: 用紫外照射随机产生点突变
options.en: Making random point mutations with UV light

options.zh: 用转座子随机插入破坏基因
options.en: Disrupting genes by random transposon insertion

options.zh: 把指定密码子改成指定氨基酸
options.en: Changing a named codon to a named residue

quiz.explain_zh: 位点和替换都预先指定，才叫定点。用抑制剂筛菌群属于定向进化，紫外照射和转座子插入都是随机诱变，三者都没有指定要改哪个残基。
quiz.explain_en: Both the position and the substitution are specified in advance; that is what makes it site-directed. Inhibitor screening is directed evolution, and UV or transposons mutate at random. None of the three names the residue to be changed.

quiz.q_zh: 课上「加少量竞争性抑制剂培养菌群」在方法学上属于？
quiz.q_en: Methodologically, what is culturing a population with a little competitive inhibitor?

options.zh: 同源重组介导的基因敲除
options.en: A gene knockout by homologous recombination

options.zh: 定向进化中的选择压力
options.en: A selection pressure in directed evolution

options.zh: 定点诱变中的引物设计
options.en: The primer design step of site-directed mutagenesis

options.zh: 别构调节的体外重建实验
options.en: An in vitro reconstitution of allosteric control

quiz.explain_zh: 抑制剂只是筛掉低活性个体，突变本身仍是随机发生的，这正是定向进化的选择环节。引物设计要求预知突变位点，体外重建和基因敲除都需要人为改动基因，本例中都没有做。
quiz.explain_en: The inhibitor only removes low-activity cells while mutation stays random, which is the selection step of directed evolution. Primer design presupposes a known target site, and reconstitution or knockout both require deliberate genetic manipulation, none of which happens here.

title_zh: 临近效应与定向效应
title_en: Proximity and orientation effects

points.zh: 临近效应 proximity effect：酶与底物靠近时存在一种驱动力，把底物拉向活性中心
points.en: Proximity effect: as enzyme and substrate approach, a driving force pulls the substrate toward the active site

points.zh: 其效果等价于把底物的局部浓度提高很多倍，反应速率随之上升
points.en: Its effect is equivalent to raising the local substrate concentration many-fold, which raises the rate

points.zh: 定向效应 orientation effect：底物本可以以任意角度靠近，但口袋周围氨基酸的电荷排布迫使它以唯一正确的姿势结合
points.en: Orientation effect: the substrate could approach at any angle, but the charge layout around the pocket forces it into the one correct pose

points.zh: 两者共同把一个双分子反应变成近似单分子的反应，是酶与底物亲和力高的原因
points.en: Together they turn a bimolecular reaction into an effectively unimolecular one, and account for the high enzyme-substrate affinity

points.zh: 课上强调这两条是被广泛接受的假说，目前没有很好的办法直接证明
points.en: The lecture stresses these are widely accepted hypotheses with no good way to prove them directly

points.zh: 形变 strain 与诱导契合 induced fit 在教材上并列，课上认为已讲过、不再展开
points.en: Strain and induced fit are listed alongside them in the textbook; the lecture treats them as already covered

points.zh: 酸碱催化 acid-base catalysis、共价催化 covalent catalysis、金属离子催化 metal-ion catalysis 课上判断为不重要，直接跳到溶菌酶实例
points.en: Acid-base, covalent and metal-ion catalysis are judged unimportant here, and the lecture jumps to the lysozyme example

extra.zh: 临近与定向的本质是降低活化熵 ΔS‡：两个分子相遇要付出平动与转动自由度的代价，酶在结合底物时先把这笔账付掉，过渡态就不必再付，速率因此大幅提升。
extra.en: Proximity and orientation work by cutting the activation entropy: two molecules meeting must pay in translational and rotational freedom, and the enzyme pays that bill at the binding step so the transition state does not have to.

extra.zh: 更统一的解释是：酶结合最紧的不是底物而是过渡态 transition state（Pauling）。临近、定向、形变、诱导契合都是过渡态稳定化的不同侧面，过渡态类似物 transition-state analogue 因此是最强的抑制剂。
extra.en: The unifying account is Pauling's: what an enzyme binds most tightly is not the substrate but the transition state. Proximity, orientation, strain and induced fit are facets of transition-state stabilisation, which is why transition-state analogues make the tightest inhibitors.

extra.zh: 诱导契合 induced fit 是酶随底物结合而改变自身构象；锁钥模型 lock-and-key 假定酶的形状是刚性的、预先成形的。定向效应说的是底物的取向，不是酶的形变，三者不要混为一谈。
extra.en: Induced fit is the enzyme changing shape as substrate binds; the lock-and-key model assumes a rigid, pre-formed shape. The orientation effect is about how the substrate is turned, not about the enzyme deforming.

quiz.q_zh: 定向效应 orientation effect 指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the orientation effect?

options.zh: 让酶随底物结合而改变自身构象
options.en: Letting the enzyme change its own shape as substrate binds

options.zh: 使底物的糖环被扭曲成半椅式
options.en: Twisting the substrate ring into a half-chair shape

options.zh: 迫使底物以正确取向进入活性中心
options.en: Forcing the substrate into the active site the right way round

options.zh: 把底物从溶液中拉近到活性中心
options.en: Drawing the substrate out of solution toward the active site

quiz.explain_zh: 定向效应说的是底物的角度，由口袋周围的电荷排布决定。把底物拉近描述的是临近效应，酶随底物改变构象是诱导契合，糖环扭曲是形变学说，三者都是另外的概念。
quiz.explain_en: The orientation effect concerns the angle of approach, set by the charge layout around the pocket. Drawing the substrate closer is the proximity effect, the enzyme reshaping itself is induced fit, and ring twisting is the strain hypothesis.

quiz.q_zh: 临近效应与定向效应主要降低了反应的哪一项代价？
quiz.q_en: Which cost do the proximity and orientation effects mainly reduce?

options.zh: 产物离开活性中心的速率
options.en: The rate at which product leaves

options.zh: 底物在水中的溶解度极限
options.en: The solubility limit of substrate in water

options.zh: 活化过程的熵代价 ΔS‡
options.en: The entropic cost of activation, ΔS‡

options.zh: 反应总的自由能变 ΔG
options.en: The overall free energy change, ΔG

quiz.explain_zh: 把两个分子预先摆好位置和角度，等于提前支付了平动转动自由度的损失，降低的是活化熵。酶不改变反应总的自由能变 ΔG，也不改变平衡位置；产物释放速率和底物溶解度都不是这两条效应针对的量。
quiz.explain_en: Pre-positioning two molecules pays the translational and rotational penalty up front, which is an entropic term. An enzyme never changes the overall ΔG or the equilibrium position, and neither product release nor substrate solubility is what these effects address.

title_zh: 溶菌酶的底物：细菌细胞壁与切割位点
title_en: The lysozyme substrate: bacterial cell wall and cleavage site

points.zh: 溶菌酶 lysozyme 在纯化蛋白时非常常用，miniprep 的裂解液里就有这一成分
points.en: Lysozyme is a workhorse of protein purification, and it is a component of miniprep lysis buffer

points.zh: 它的作用对象是细菌的细胞壁 cell wall，成分是肽聚糖 peptidoglycan（课上称为几丁质）
points.en: Its target is the bacterial cell wall, made of peptidoglycan (the lecture calls it chitin)

points.zh: 糖链由 NAM（N-乙酰胞壁酸）与 NAG（N-乙酰葡糖胺）交替连成，二者只是侧链修饰不同
points.en: The chain alternates NAM (N-acetylmuramic acid) with NAG (N-acetylglucosamine), differing only in side-chain modification

points.zh: 溶菌酶特异性水解 NAM 与 NAG 之间的 β-1,4 糖苷键 glycosidic bond
points.en: Lysozyme specifically hydrolyses the β-1,4 glycosidic bond between NAM and NAG

points.zh: 结合沟里排得下 6 个糖单元，至少 6 个糖连在一起时水解效率最高
points.en: The binding groove holds six sugar units, and hydrolysis is fastest when at least six are strung together

points.zh: 切割发生在第 4 与第 5 个糖之间，即亚位点 D 与 E 之间
points.en: Cleavage falls between the fourth and fifth sugar, that is between subsites D and E

points.zh: 肽聚糖是一张很密的网状结构，革兰氏阴性菌在它外面还有一层脂多糖 LPS
points.en: Peptidoglycan is a dense mesh; in Gram-negative bacteria a layer of LPS lies outside it

points.zh: 实验流程：先超声打破外层，再加溶菌酶把这张糖网拆散，菌体才真正裂解
points.en: In practice: sonicate to break the outer layer, then add lysozyme to take the sugar mesh apart so the cells truly lyse

extra.zh: 课上说溶菌酶溶解的是细胞膜，并把这张多糖网放在革兰氏阴性菌的膜表面。溶菌酶水解的是肽聚糖细胞壁，不是膜；而对溶菌酶真正敏感的是革兰氏阳性菌——它们的肽聚糖又厚又直接暴露，革兰氏阴性菌的肽聚糖被外膜遮住，所以必须先用 EDTA 或超声破外膜。课上同一段里别处用的是「细胞壁」，属于口误。
extra.en: The lecture says lysozyme dissolves the cell membrane and places the sugar mesh on the Gram-negative membrane surface. Lysozyme hydrolyses the peptidoglycan cell wall, not a membrane, and the truly susceptible organisms are Gram-positive, whose thick peptidoglycan is directly exposed; in Gram-negative bacteria the outer membrane shields it, which is why EDTA or sonication must come first. The same passage uses 细胞壁 correctly elsewhere, so this is a slip.

extra.zh: 几丁质 chitin 是纯 NAG 的 β-1,4 聚合物（虾壳、真菌壁），溶菌酶确实带一点几丁质酶活性，但细菌细胞壁上的底物是 NAM 与 NAG 交替的肽聚糖，考试要写肽聚糖。
extra.en: Chitin is a β-1,4 polymer of NAG alone (shells and fungal walls), and lysozyme does have weak chitinase activity, but the bacterial cell wall substrate is peptidoglycan with alternating NAM and NAG. Write peptidoglycan in the exam.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上把超声后菌液变黏稠归给脂多糖。实验上这份黏稠主要来自破碎时释放的基因组 DNA，所以对策是加 DNase I 或继续超声打断 DNA，而不是加更多溶菌酶。
extra.en: The lecture attributes the viscosity after sonication to LPS. In practice it comes mostly from genomic DNA released on lysis, which is why the fix is DNase I or further sonication to shear the DNA rather than more lysozyme.

extra.zh: 青霉素 penicillin 与溶菌酶都作用于肽聚糖，方式相反：青霉素抑制转肽酶 transpeptidase，阻止交联的合成，只对生长中的细菌有效；溶菌酶直接水解已经存在的糖骨架。
extra.en: Penicillin and lysozyme both act on peptidoglycan but from opposite ends: penicillin inhibits the transpeptidase and blocks cross-link synthesis, so it only works on growing cells, while lysozyme hydrolyses the existing sugar backbone.

quiz.q_zh: 溶菌酶水解的是哪一种化学键？
quiz.q_en: Which bond does lysozyme hydrolyse?

options.zh: 脂多糖上的糖与脂酯键
options.en: The ester bond joining sugar and lipid in LPS

options.zh: 膜磷脂骨架的磷酸酯键
options.en: The phosphoester bond of a membrane phospholipid

options.zh: NAM 与 NAG 之间的糖苷键
options.en: The glycosidic bond between NAM and NAG

options.zh: 肽聚糖交联桥上的肽键
options.en: The peptide bond in the cross-linking bridge

quiz.explain_zh: 溶菌酶是糖苷酶，切的是糖骨架上 NAM 与 NAG 之间的 β-1,4 键。交联桥上的肽键由内肽酶水解，脂多糖的酯键和磷脂的磷酸酯键则属于脂酶和磷脂酶的底物。
quiz.explain_en: Lysozyme is a glycosidase and cuts the β-1,4 bond between NAM and NAG in the backbone. Cross-bridge peptide bonds are the job of endopeptidases, while the LPS ester bond and the phospholipid phosphoester bond belong to lipases and phospholipases.

quiz.q_zh: 哪一类细菌对溶菌酶最敏感？
quiz.q_en: Which bacteria are most susceptible to lysozyme?

options.zh: 革兰氏阳性菌，肽聚糖厚而暴露
options.en: Gram-positive, with thick exposed peptidoglycan

options.zh: 革兰氏阴性菌，外膜包住肽聚糖
options.en: Gram-negative, with peptidoglycan under an outer membrane

options.zh: 分枝杆菌，壁外有分枝菌酸蜡层
options.en: Mycobacteria, with a waxy mycolic acid coat outside

options.zh: 支原体，本身完全没有细胞壁
options.en: Mycoplasma, which have no cell wall at all

quiz.explain_zh: 肽聚糖越厚越暴露就越容易被切开，所以革兰氏阳性菌最敏感。革兰氏阴性菌的外膜、分枝杆菌的分枝菌酸蜡层都是屏障，支原体连底物都没有，三者都不敏感。
quiz.explain_en: The more peptidoglycan is exposed, the easier it is to cut, so Gram-positive cells are most susceptible. The Gram-negative outer membrane and the mycobacterial wax layer are both barriers, and Mycoplasma have no substrate at all.

quiz.q_zh: 溶菌酶达到最高水解效率需要多长的糖链？
quiz.q_en: How long a sugar chain does lysozyme need for maximal rate?

options.zh: 至少 2 个连续的糖单元
options.en: At least two sugar units in a row

options.zh: 至少 20 个连续的糖单元
options.en: At least twenty sugar units in a row

options.zh: 单个游离的糖单元即可
options.en: A single free sugar unit is enough

options.zh: 至少 6 个连续的糖单元
options.en: At least six sugar units in a row

quiz.explain_zh: 结合沟共有 6 个亚位点 A–F，填满时结合能最大、水解最快。两个糖或单个糖填不满结合沟，20 个糖并不比 6 个更快，因为多出来的部分已经伸出结合沟之外。
quiz.explain_en: The groove has six subsites A-F, and filling them gives the most binding energy and the fastest turnover. Two sugars or one sugar cannot fill it, and twenty is no faster than six because the excess hangs outside the groove.

title_zh: 溶菌酶的催化机理：极性/非极性区、半椅式与两个羧基
title_en: Lysozyme catalysis: polar and nonpolar faces, the half-chair, and two carboxylates

points.zh: 活性口袋的上方是极性区 polar region，聚集了很多亲水氨基酸；下方是非极性区 nonpolar region，聚集疏水氨基酸
points.en: Above the pocket lies a polar region rich in hydrophilic residues; below it a nonpolar region rich in hydrophobic ones

points.zh: 糖链上的羟基等亲水基团被吸向极性区，糖环上相对疏水的碳骨架转向非极性区
points.en: The chain's hydroxyls and other polar groups are drawn to the polar face, while the relatively hydrophobic carbon skeleton of the ring turns to the nonpolar face

points.zh: 糖环是六元环（吡喃糖）：5 个碳加 1 个氧共 6 个成员，与 5 元的核糖环 furanose 不同，课上现场纠正过这一点
points.en: The sugar ring is six-membered (pyranose): five carbons plus one oxygen, unlike the five-membered furanose ring, a point corrected on the spot in class

points.zh: 这一取向把待切位点上的糖强行扭成半椅式 half-chair 构象
points.en: This orientation forces the sugar at the scissile site into a half-chair conformation

points.zh: 半椅式不是最稳定构象，糖在进入口袋时就已经变形，糖苷键断裂的能垒被预先降低
points.en: The half-chair is not the stable conformation, so the sugar is already distorted on entry and the barrier to cleaving the glycosidic bond is lowered in advance

points.zh: 口袋里有两个带负电的羧基残基：谷氨酸 glutamic acid (Glu35) 与天冬氨酸 aspartic acid (Asp52)，都以 −COOH／−COO⁻ 作为活性基团
points.en: The pocket holds two acidic residues, glutamic acid (Glu35) and aspartic acid (Asp52), both acting through their carboxyl groups

points.zh: Asp52 位于极性环境、保持解离带负电；Glu35 位于非极性环境、pKa 升高而保持质子化
points.en: Asp52 sits in the polar environment and stays ionised; Glu35 sits in the nonpolar environment, where its pKa is raised and it stays protonated

points.zh: Glu35 把质子交给糖苷键的氧使其断裂，Asp52 稳定生成的带正电中间体，最后由水提供 −OH 完成水解
points.en: Glu35 hands its proton to the glycosidic oxygen so the bond breaks, Asp52 stabilises the resulting positively charged intermediate, and water supplies the −OH that completes hydrolysis

points.zh: 课上归纳为「两步一起干」：先靠口袋的极性分布让糖变形，再靠两个羧基完成化学反应
points.en: The lecture's summary: the pocket's polar layout deforms the sugar first, then the two carboxylates do the chemistry

extra.zh: 课上说这两个羧基给六元糖环「加了一个羟基」，然后把糖环「水解掉／挤爆了」。被切断的是 NAM 与 NAG 之间的糖苷键，糖环本身完好无损。正确顺序是：Glu35 作为广义酸质子化糖苷氧，Asp52 稳定氧鎓离子 oxocarbenium（或与之形成共价的糖基-酶中间体），随后水进攻这个中心。糖被扭成半椅式是能垒下降的真正原因，这也是过渡态稳定化 transition-state stabilization 的教科书插图。
extra.en: The lecture describes the two carboxylates adding an −OH to the six-membered ring, which is then hydrolysed or burst open. What is cleaved is the glycosidic bond between NAM and NAG; the ring stays intact. The correct sequence is Glu35 acting as a general acid on the glycosidic oxygen, Asp52 stabilising an oxocarbenium (or forming a covalent glycosyl-enzyme intermediate), and water then attacking that centre. The half-chair distortion is what actually lowers the barrier, and it is the textbook illustration of transition-state stabilisation.

extra.zh: 溶菌酶属于保持型糖苷酶 retaining glycosidase：两步置换，产物保留 β 构型。保持型酶的两个催化羧基彼此靠得近，翻转型 inverting glycosidase 的两个羧基相距明显更远，中间要塞下一个进攻的水分子。
extra.en: Lysozyme is a retaining glycosidase: two displacement steps leave the product with its β configuration. In retaining enzymes the two catalytic carboxylates sit close together, while in inverting glycosidases they are markedly further apart to make room for the attacking water.

extra.zh: 同样是羧基，微环境决定角色：Glu35 处在疏水口袋中，pKa 明显高于游离谷氨酸，在最适 pH 附近仍以 −COOH 存在，才能当广义酸；Asp52 处在极性环境，pKa 低，以 −COO⁻ 存在，才能稳定正电中间体。
extra.en: Two identical carboxyls, two roles, decided by microenvironment: Glu35 sits in a hydrophobic pocket, so its pKa is well above that of free glutamate and it remains −COOH near the optimum pH and can act as a general acid; Asp52 sits in a polar environment with a low pKa, stays −COO⁻, and stabilises the cationic intermediate.

extra.zh: 半椅式是酶强加给底物的形变（形变学说 strain），不是底物自带的构象；自由溶液里的吡喃糖以椅式 chair 为主。
extra.en: The half-chair is a distortion the enzyme imposes on the substrate (the strain hypothesis), not a shape the substrate arrives with; free in solution a pyranose is mostly in the chair form.

quiz.q_zh: 溶菌酶催化过程中被切断的到底是什么？
quiz.q_en: What exactly is cleaved in the lysozyme reaction?

options.zh: 糖环内部的碳氧成环键
options.en: The carbon-oxygen bond inside the ring

options.zh: 糖上乙酰氨基的酰胺键
options.en: The amide bond of the acetamido group

options.zh: 肽聚糖交联段上的肽键
options.en: The peptide bond in the cross-link

options.zh: 两个糖单元之间的糖苷键
options.en: The glycosidic bond between two sugars

quiz.explain_zh: 糖环全程保持完整，断的是连接 NAM 与 NAG 的糖苷键。环内的碳氧键断裂等于开环，乙酰氨基的酰胺键和交联段的肽键则需要完全不同的酶，都不是溶菌酶做的事。
quiz.explain_en: The ring stays whole throughout; what breaks is the glycosidic bond linking NAM to NAG. Breaking a ring C-O bond would open the ring, while the acetamido amide and the cross-link peptide bond need entirely different enzymes.

quiz.q_zh: Glu35 在溶菌酶催化中扮演什么角色？
quiz.q_en: What role does Glu35 play in lysozyme catalysis?

options.zh: 广义碱，夺取进攻水的质子
options.en: General base, taking a proton from the attacking water

options.zh: 亲核基团，进攻底物的磷原子
options.en: Nucleophile, attacking the phosphorus of the substrate

options.zh: 配位残基，固定活性中心的锌
options.en: Ligand residue, holding a zinc in the active site

options.zh: 广义酸，质子化糖苷键的氧
options.en: General acid, protonating the glycosidic oxygen

quiz.explain_zh: Glu35 在疏水微环境中保持质子化，把质子交给糖苷氧使键断裂，是典型的广义酸催化。夺取水的质子是广义碱的角色，进攻磷原子的底物根本不存在于此，溶菌酶也不含锌。
quiz.explain_en: Glu35 stays protonated in its hydrophobic microenvironment and gives its proton to the glycosidic oxygen, textbook general acid catalysis. Deprotonating water would be a general base role, there is no phosphorus in this substrate, and lysozyme contains no zinc.

quiz.q_zh: 底物糖环被扭成半椅式，意义是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why does it matter that the ring is forced into a half-chair?

options.zh: 使底物构象接近过渡态
options.en: It moves the substrate toward the transition state

options.zh: 使底物与酶结合得更松
options.en: It makes the substrate bind more loosely

options.zh: 使产物更快离开活性中心
options.en: It speeds product release from the site

options.zh: 使酶自身构象更加稳定
options.en: It makes the enzyme itself more stable

quiz.explain_zh: 半椅式接近糖苷键断裂时的氧鎓离子几何，底物提前变形就等于提前爬了一段能垒，这正是过渡态稳定化。结合更松会降低效率，产物释放和酶自身稳定性都不是形变要解决的问题。
quiz.explain_en: The half-chair approaches the oxocarbenium geometry of the breaking bond, so distorting the substrate in advance climbs part of the barrier ahead of time, which is transition-state stabilisation. Looser binding would hurt efficiency, and neither product release nor enzyme stability is what the distortion addresses.

title_zh: 溶菌酶小结与丝氨酸蛋白酶家族的引入
title_en: Wrapping up lysozyme and introducing the serine protease family

points.zh: 半椅式那张构象画法属于化学细节，课上明确说不必掌握画法，只需记住「糖进口袋时已经变形」
points.en: The half-chair drawing is chemical detail; the lecture says not to learn the notation, only that the sugar is already deformed on entering the pocket

points.zh: 整个溶菌酶例子只是用来说明酶如何工作，不是必背内容
points.en: The whole lysozyme case is an illustration of how enzymes work, not material to memorise

points.zh: 丝氨酸蛋白酶 serine protease 家族在人体内极常见：胰蛋白酶 trypsin、胰凝乳蛋白酶 chymotrypsin、弹性蛋白酶 elastase、凝血酶 thrombin
points.en: Serine proteases are everywhere in the body: trypsin, chymotrypsin, elastase and thrombin

points.zh: 这一家族成员的一级序列差异很大，三维结构却高度相似——与血红蛋白和肌红蛋白的关系类似
points.en: Family members differ widely in primary sequence yet share a very similar three-dimensional structure, much as haemoglobin and myoglobin do

points.zh: 结构相似的好处是它们都采用了同一种最高效的催化组织方式
points.en: The shared structure means they all adopt the same highly efficient catalytic arrangement

points.zh: 课上的类比：胰腺里的酶和胃里的酶「老死不相往来」，却演化出很像的三维结构
points.en: The lecture's analogy: enzymes of the pancreas and of the stomach never meet, yet arrive at closely similar structures

points.zh: 三者的差别主要在结合底物的口袋深浅：胰蛋白酶口袋最深，胰凝乳蛋白酶稍浅，弹性蛋白酶的口袋最小
points.en: They differ mainly in the depth of the substrate pocket: deepest in trypsin, slightly shallower in chymotrypsin, smallest in elastase

points.zh: 口袋的形状决定了切割特异性，也就是每种酶认哪一类侧链
points.en: The shape of that pocket sets the cleavage specificity, that is which side chain each enzyme recognises

extra.zh: 课上说「弹性蛋白酶其实就是胃蛋白酶」。二者完全不同：弹性蛋白酶与胰蛋白酶、胰凝乳蛋白酶同属丝氨酸蛋白酶，用 Ser-His-Asp 催化三联体，在小肠的中性偏碱条件下工作；胃蛋白酶 pepsin 是天冬氨酸蛋白酶 aspartic protease，用两个 Asp 催化，最适 pH 在 2 左右。
extra.en: The lecture says elastase is really pepsin. They are unrelated: elastase belongs with trypsin and chymotrypsin among the serine proteases, using a Ser-His-Asp catalytic triad at the near-neutral pH of the small intestine, whereas pepsin is an aspartic protease using two Asp residues with a pH optimum near 2.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上把胰蛋白酶／胰凝乳蛋白酶／弹性蛋白酶的结构相似称为趋同进化。这三者序列可以互相比对、基因明显同源，属于同一祖先分化出来的趋异进化 divergent evolution。教科书里趋同进化 convergent evolution 的标准例子是枯草杆菌蛋白酶 subtilisin 与胰凝乳蛋白酶：折叠完全不同，却各自独立演化出同样的 Ser-His-Asp 三联体。
extra.en: The lecture calls the structural similarity of trypsin, chymotrypsin and elastase convergent evolution. Their sequences align and their genes are plainly homologous, so this is divergent evolution from a common ancestor. The textbook example of convergence is subtilisin versus chymotrypsin: completely different folds that independently evolved the same Ser-His-Asp triad.

extra.zh: S1 口袋的化学细节决定特异性：胰蛋白酶口袋底部是 Asp189，吸引带正电侧链，切 Lys/Arg 之后；胰凝乳蛋白酶口袋深而疏水，切 Phe/Trp/Tyr 之后；弹性蛋白酶口袋被 Val 和 Thr 堵住，只容得下 Ala/Gly 这样的小侧链。
extra.en: The chemistry of the S1 pocket sets specificity: trypsin has Asp189 at the bottom to attract positive side chains and cuts after Lys and Arg; chymotrypsin's pocket is deep and hydrophobic and it cuts after Phe, Trp and Tyr; elastase has the pocket blocked by Val and Thr and takes only small side chains such as Ala and Gly.

extra.zh: 这些消化酶都以酶原 zymogen 的形式分泌（胰蛋白酶原、胰凝乳蛋白酶原等），由肠激酶 enteropeptidase 激活胰蛋白酶原，再由胰蛋白酶级联激活其余酶原，从而避免胰腺自身被消化。
extra.en: These digestive enzymes are all secreted as zymogens (trypsinogen, chymotrypsinogen and so on). Enteropeptidase activates trypsinogen, and trypsin then activates the rest in a cascade, which is what keeps the pancreas from digesting itself.

quiz.q_zh: 胃蛋白酶 pepsin 属于哪一类蛋白酶？
quiz.q_en: Which class of protease is pepsin?

options.zh: 丝氨酸蛋白酶
options.en: Serine protease

options.zh: 半胱氨酸蛋白酶
options.en: Cysteine protease

options.zh: 金属蛋白酶
options.en: Metalloprotease

options.zh: 天冬氨酸蛋白酶
options.en: Aspartic protease

quiz.explain_zh: 胃蛋白酶用两个 Asp 的羧基催化，最适 pH 约为 2。丝氨酸蛋白酶用 Ser-His-Asp 三联体，半胱氨酸蛋白酶用 Cys 的巯基，金属蛋白酶依赖 Zn²⁺，三者的催化机器都与胃蛋白酶不同。
quiz.explain_en: Pepsin catalyses with two Asp carboxyls and has a pH optimum near 2. Serine proteases use a Ser-His-Asp triad, cysteine proteases a Cys thiol, and metalloproteases a Zn²⁺ ion, so all three machineries differ from pepsin's.

quiz.q_zh: 胰蛋白酶切割 Lys/Arg 之后的结构基础是什么？
quiz.q_en: What structural feature makes trypsin cut after Lys and Arg?

options.zh: 口袋中央的 Zn²⁺ 配位点
options.en: A Zn²⁺ coordination site in the pocket

options.zh: S1 口袋底部的 Asp189
options.en: Asp189 at the bottom of the S1 pocket

options.zh: S1 口袋底部的 Ser189
options.en: Ser189 at the bottom of the S1 pocket

options.zh: 被 Val 与 Thr 堵住的口袋
options.en: A pocket blocked by Val and Thr

quiz.explain_zh: 口袋底部的负电荷 Asp189 与 Lys/Arg 的正电侧链形成盐桥，这是胰蛋白酶特异性的来源。Ser189 出现在胰凝乳蛋白酶，被 Val 和 Thr 堵住的是弹性蛋白酶的口袋，而丝氨酸蛋白酶不含 Zn²⁺。
quiz.explain_en: The negatively charged Asp189 at the bottom forms a salt bridge with the positive side chain of Lys or Arg, and that is where trypsin's specificity comes from. Ser189 is chymotrypsin's, the Val-and-Thr blockage is elastase's, and serine proteases contain no zinc.

quiz.q_zh: 以下哪一对是趋同进化 convergent evolution 的标准例子？
quiz.q_en: Which pair is the standard example of convergent evolution?

options.zh: 血红蛋白与肌红蛋白
options.en: Haemoglobin and myoglobin

options.zh: 胰蛋白酶原与胰蛋白酶
options.en: Trypsinogen and trypsin

options.zh: 枯草杆菌蛋白酶与胰凝乳蛋白酶
options.en: Subtilisin and chymotrypsin

options.zh: 胰蛋白酶与胰凝乳蛋白酶
options.en: Trypsin and chymotrypsin

quiz.explain_zh: 枯草杆菌蛋白酶与胰凝乳蛋白酶折叠完全不同，却各自独立演化出同样的 Ser-His-Asp 三联体。胰蛋白酶与胰凝乳蛋白酶、血红蛋白与肌红蛋白都是同源基因分化的趋异进化，而胰蛋白酶原与胰蛋白酶是同一条多肽的酶原与活性形式。
quiz.explain_en: Subtilisin and chymotrypsin have completely different folds yet independently evolved the same Ser-His-Asp triad. Trypsin with chymotrypsin, and haemoglobin with myoglobin, are homologous and therefore divergent, while trypsinogen and trypsin are the zymogen and active form of one chain.

title_zh: 底物口袋深度决定丝氨酸蛋白酶的切割特异性
title_en: S1 pocket depth sets serine-protease specificity

points.zh: 胰蛋白酶 trypsin、胰凝乳蛋白酶 chymotrypsin、弹性蛋白酶 elastase 三者的三维结构高度相似，差别集中在结合底物的口袋。
points.en: Trypsin, chymotrypsin and elastase share nearly the same three-dimensional fold; the difference is concentrated in the substrate-binding pocket.

points.zh: 口袋深度依次递减：trypsin 的口袋最深，chymotrypsin 稍浅，elastase 的口袋最小。
points.en: Pocket depth decreases in order: trypsin's is deepest, chymotrypsin's is somewhat shallower, elastase's is the smallest.

points.zh: 口袋深度不同，决定了它们催化裂解的肽键位置不同，也就是切割特异性 specificity 不同。
points.en: Different pocket depths determine which peptide bond each enzyme cleaves, i.e. different cleavage specificity.

points.zh: trypsin 口袋最深，识别侧链最长的残基——精氨酸 Arg（侧链加一个胍基 guanidinium，很长）和赖氨酸 Lys。
points.en: Trypsin's deep pocket accepts the longest side chains — arginine (a long chain plus a guanidinium group) and lysine.

points.zh: trypsin 口袋底部还有一个带负电的残基，与 Arg、Lys 侧链末端的正电荷配对。
points.en: The bottom of trypsin's pocket carries a negative charge that pairs with the positively charged tips of Arg and Lys side chains.

points.zh: 相对地，elastase 催化的位点侧链都比较短。
points.en: Elastase, by contrast, cleaves after residues with short side chains.

points.zh: 由此引出本段的核心概念：催化三连体 catalytic triad，讲者强调这是必须掌握的重点。
points.en: This leads into the section's core concept, the catalytic triad, which the lecturer flags as essential.

points.zh: 催化三连体不只存在于 serine 蛋白酶家族，cysteine 蛋白酶家族里也有类似结构。
points.en: The catalytic triad is not unique to the serine protease family; the cysteine protease family has an analogous arrangement.

points.zh: 分布上的差别：人体内 serine 家族更广泛，而病毒更偏好用 cysteine 作为活性中心。
points.en: Distribution differs: the serine family is the widespread one in humans, whereas viruses strongly favour a cysteine active-site nucleophile.

extra.zh: 口袋底部那个带负电的残基有名字：trypsin 是 Asp189。chymotrypsin 在同一位置是不带电的 Ser189，口袋疏水，因此切芳香族残基 Phe、Tyr、Trp 之后的肽键。elastase 则被 Val216 和 Thr226 两个大侧链把口袋堵浅，只切 Ala、Gly、Ser 这类小侧链之后的肽键。
extra.en: That negative residue has a name: Asp189 in trypsin. At the equivalent position chymotrypsin has uncharged Ser189, making the pocket hydrophobic, so it cleaves after the aromatics Phe, Tyr and Trp. In elastase the bulky Val216 and Thr226 fill the pocket, restricting it to small residues such as Ala, Gly and Ser.

extra.zh: 口袋和残基有标准命名（Schechter–Berger）：切割位点 N 端一侧的底物残基叫 P1，容纳它的酶上口袋叫 S1。三种酶的全部特异性差别几乎都在 S1 口袋，说"口袋深度"其实说的就是 S1。
extra.en: There is a standard nomenclature (Schechter–Berger): the substrate residue N-terminal to the scissile bond is P1, and the enzyme pocket that holds it is S1. Essentially all specificity differences among the three enzymes sit in S1 — "pocket depth" means the S1 pocket.

extra.zh: trypsin、chymotrypsin、elastase 都是丝氨酸蛋白酶 serine protease；胃蛋白酶 pepsin 不属于这一家族，它是天冬氨酸蛋白酶 aspartic protease，用两个 Asp 活化水分子，最适 pH 是酸性（约 pH 2）。不要把 elastase 与 pepsin 混为一谈。
extra.en: Trypsin, chymotrypsin and elastase are all serine proteases; pepsin is not in this family — it is an aspartic protease that activates a water molecule with two Asp residues and has an acidic pH optimum (around pH 2). Do not equate elastase with pepsin.

extra.zh: 特异性口袋不是绝对的开关而是偏好：改变 trypsin 的 Asp189 会让它对 Arg、Lys 的催化效率 kcat/Km 大幅下降，但并不会立刻变成 chymotrypsin——单点突变不足以搬迁特异性，还需要周围的表面环 loop 一起替换。
extra.en: The specificity pocket is a preference, not a switch: mutating Asp189 in trypsin sharply lowers kcat/Km for Arg and Lys substrates but does not convert it into chymotrypsin — transplanting specificity also requires swapping the surrounding surface loops.

quiz.q_zh: 胰蛋白酶 trypsin 优先切割哪类残基之后的肽键？
quiz.q_en: Trypsin preferentially cleaves the peptide bond after which residues?

options.zh: 精氨酸 Arg、赖氨酸 Lys 之后
options.en: after arginine and lysine

options.zh: 苯丙氨酸 Phe、酪氨酸 Tyr 之后
options.en: after phenylalanine and tyrosine

options.zh: 丙氨酸 Ala、甘氨酸 Gly 之后
options.en: after alanine and glycine

options.zh: 天冬氨酸 Asp、谷氨酸 Glu 之后
options.en: after aspartate and glutamate

quiz.explain_zh: trypsin 的 S1 口袋最深，底部有带负电的 Asp189，因此偏好长而带正电的 Arg、Lys。切 Phe、Tyr 的是 chymotrypsin（口袋疏水），切 Ala、Gly 的是 elastase（口袋被大侧链堵浅），切 Asp、Glu 的是 Glu-C 一类的酸性特异性蛋白酶。
quiz.explain_en: Trypsin has the deepest S1 pocket with a negatively charged Asp189 at the bottom, so it prefers the long, positively charged Arg and Lys. Cleavage after Phe and Tyr belongs to chymotrypsin (hydrophobic pocket), after Ala and Gly to elastase (pocket filled by bulky side chains), and after Asp and Glu to acidic-specificity enzymes such as Glu-C.

quiz.q_zh: 弹性蛋白酶 elastase 只切小侧链残基，结构上的原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why does elastase cleave only after small side chains?

options.zh: 它的活性中心用 Cys 取代了 Ser
options.en: its active site uses Cys instead of Ser

options.zh: S1 口袋被大侧链残基堵得很浅
options.en: bulky residues fill and shallow its S1 pocket

options.zh: S1 口袋底部带负电排斥大侧链
options.en: a negative charge in S1 repels bulky side chains

options.zh: 它的催化三连体缺少组氨酸 His
options.en: its catalytic triad is missing the histidine

quiz.explain_zh: elastase 的 S1 口袋被 Val216、Thr226 两个大侧链占据，只剩容纳 Ala、Gly 的空间。底部带负电描述的是 trypsin 的 Asp189；elastase 的三连体完整，活性中心仍是 Ser，并非换成 Cys。
quiz.explain_en: Elastase's S1 pocket is occupied by the bulky Val216 and Thr226, leaving room only for Ala or Gly. A negatively charged pocket floor describes trypsin's Asp189; elastase's triad is intact and its nucleophile is still Ser, not Cys.

title_zh: 催化三连体：氢键网络与电子传递
title_en: The catalytic triad: hydrogen-bond network and electron relay

points.zh: 催化三连体 catalytic triad（课件上也写作"催化三元体"）是三个氨基酸：aspartic acid Asp、histidine His、serine Ser。
points.en: The catalytic triad (also written 催化三元体 on the slide) is three residues: aspartate, histidine and serine.

points.zh: 这三个氨基酸在蛋白的立体结构中彼此靠得很近，靠折叠而不是靠一级序列相邻实现。
points.en: The three residues sit close together in the folded three-dimensional structure, brought there by folding rather than by being neighbours in sequence.

points.zh: 第一对氢键：Asp 的羧基带负电，与 His 咪唑 imidazole 侧链上的氢形成氢键。
points.en: First hydrogen bond: the negatively charged Asp carboxylate hydrogen-bonds to a hydrogen on the His imidazole side chain.

points.zh: 第二对氢键：His 咪唑再与 Ser 侧链（不是主链）的羟基 hydroxyl 形成氢键。
points.en: Second hydrogen bond: the His imidazole in turn hydrogen-bonds to the hydroxyl on the Ser side chain (side chain, not backbone).

points.zh: 三个侧链共形成两对氢键，实现一种电子的传递。
points.en: The three side chains form two hydrogen bonds in series, giving an electron relay.

points.zh: 这套网络的作用是大大增强 Ser 羟基的催化能力。
points.en: The function of this network is to greatly enhance the catalytic power of the Ser hydroxyl.

points.zh: 因此不是蛋白里随便拉出一个丝氨酸都有酶活；只有处在三连体中的特定 Ser 才有。
points.en: This is why not any serine in a protein has catalytic activity — only the specific Ser sitting in a triad does.

points.zh: 学生提问澄清：三个氨基酸来自同一个蛋白酶的同一个活性口袋，不是三个不同的蛋白。
points.en: Clarified by a student question: the three residues come from one and the same enzyme's active-site pocket, not from three different proteins.

points.zh: 另一个澄清：三连体一直存在，不需要先 activate 才形成——正因为它一直在，酶才能随时催化。
points.en: A second clarification: the triad is permanently present; it does not have to be formed by activation — its constant presence is what lets the enzyme catalyse.

extra.zh: 编号要记住：胰凝乳蛋白酶 chymotrypsin 的三连体是 His57–Asp102–Ser195。完整机制是 His 夺走 Ser 羟基的质子，生成的烷氧负离子 alkoxide 亲核进攻底物羰基碳，形成四面体中间体 tetrahedral intermediate；该中间体的氧负离子由 oxyanion hole（Gly193 与 Ser195 的主链 NH）稳定，随后经酰基酶中间体 acyl-enzyme 被水水解。
extra.en: Learn the numbering: chymotrypsin's triad is His57–Asp102–Ser195. In the full mechanism His removes the proton from the Ser hydroxyl; the resulting alkoxide attacks the substrate carbonyl carbon to give a tetrahedral intermediate whose oxyanion is stabilised by the oxyanion hole (backbone NH groups of Gly193 and Ser195), and the acyl-enzyme intermediate that follows is then hydrolysed by water.

extra.zh: 三连体的贡献可以量化：把 trypsin 的 Asp102 定点突变成 Asn，酶并没有死，但 kcat 下降约四个数量级。这说明 Asp 虽然从不接触底物，对速率的贡献却是决定性的。
extra.en: The triad's contribution is measurable: mutating trypsin's Asp102 to Asn does not kill the enzyme but lowers kcat by roughly four orders of magnitude — the Asp never touches the substrate, yet its contribution to rate is decisive.

extra.zh: 催化三连体是趋同进化 convergent evolution 的教科书例证：枯草杆菌蛋白酶 subtilisin 的三连体是 Asp32–His64–Ser221，它与 chymotrypsin 的折叠、序列顺序完全不同，但三个侧链在空间上的几何排列几乎重合。
extra.en: The triad is the textbook case of convergent evolution: subtilisin's triad is Asp32–His64–Ser221, and although its fold and sequence order differ completely from chymotrypsin's, the geometric arrangement of the three side chains is nearly superimposable.

quiz.q_zh: 催化三连体中两对氢键的正确连接方式是？
quiz.q_en: How are the two hydrogen bonds of the catalytic triad connected?

options.zh: Asp 羧基—Ser 羟基—His 咪唑
options.en: Asp carboxylate—Ser hydroxyl—His imidazole

options.zh: Ser 主链 NH—His 咪唑—Asp 羧基
options.en: Ser backbone NH—His imidazole—Asp carboxylate

options.zh: Asp 羧基—His 咪唑—Ser 羟基
options.en: Asp carboxylate—His imidazole—Ser hydroxyl

options.zh: His 咪唑—Asp 羧基—Ser 羟基
options.en: His imidazole—Asp carboxylate—Ser hydroxyl

quiz.explain_zh: His 位于中间，一侧接 Asp 羧基、另一侧接 Ser 侧链羟基，构成电荷中继。把 Asp 放中间或把 Ser 放中间都破坏了这一串联次序；用 Ser 主链 NH 代替侧链羟基也不对——参与催化的是侧链羟基，主链 NH 属于 oxyanion hole。
quiz.explain_en: His sits in the middle, contacting the Asp carboxylate on one side and the Ser side-chain hydroxyl on the other, forming the charge relay. Placing Asp or Ser in the middle breaks that series; using the Ser backbone NH is also wrong — the side-chain hydroxyl does the catalysis, while backbone NH groups belong to the oxyanion hole.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么蛋白质里只有特定的丝氨酸具有酶活？
quiz.q_en: Why do only particular serines in a protein have catalytic activity?

options.zh: 它被激酶磷酸化后才被激活
options.en: it is switched on by kinase phosphorylation

options.zh: 它与底物之间形成了二硫键
options.en: it forms a disulfide bond to the substrate

options.zh: 它处在三连体的氢键网络中
options.en: it sits in the triad's hydrogen-bond network

options.zh: 它位于多肽链的 N 端第一位
options.en: it occupies the first position of the chain

quiz.explain_zh: 只有被 His 和 Asp 的氢键网络活化的 Ser 羟基才有足够亲核性。位于 N 端第一位与酶活无关；磷酸化修饰的是调节开关而不是产生三连体；Ser 侧链是羟基，根本不能形成二硫键（二硫键来自 Cys）。
quiz.explain_en: Only a Ser hydroxyl activated by the His/Asp hydrogen-bond network is nucleophilic enough. Being the first residue of the chain is irrelevant; phosphorylation is a regulatory switch, not what creates a triad; and a Ser side chain is a hydroxyl, so it cannot form a disulfide at all (those come from Cys).

quiz.q_zh: 关于催化三连体的存在时间，下列哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about when the catalytic triad exists is correct?

options.zh: 只在底物结合的瞬间形成
options.en: it forms only as substrate binds

options.zh: 只在别构剂结合之后形成
options.en: it forms only after an effector binds

options.zh: 每轮催化结束后拆散重建
options.en: it is dismantled and rebuilt each turnover

options.zh: 在折叠好的酶中一直存在
options.en: it is present at all times in the folded enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: 讲者明确回答：三连体一直都在，正因为一直存在，酶才能持续催化。它由折叠决定，不依赖底物或别构剂的到来，也不会在每轮催化后被拆掉。
quiz.explain_en: The lecturer answers this directly: the triad is always there, and its permanence is what allows continuous catalysis. It is set by the fold, does not wait for substrate or an effector, and is not taken apart after each turnover.

title_zh: Asp 的角色，与半胱氨酸蛋白酶的催化二连体（SARS-CoV-2 Mpro）
title_en: The role of Asp, and the cysteine-protease dyad (SARS-CoV-2 Mpro)

points.zh: 讲者的说法：整个催化过程中基本只有 Ser 参与，顶多 His 参与一点，"这个 aspartic 是根本不会参与催化过程的"。
points.en: As taught: throughout catalysis essentially only Ser takes part, with His participating a little at most, and "the aspartate does not take part in the catalytic process at all".
